div.p: samprati yanmārgāśrito yo rogo bhavati taṃ darśayati- tatra gaṇḍetyādi| bahirmārgajāśceti visarpādīnāṃ viśeṣaṇaṃ visarpādayo hyantarmārgabhājo+api sambhavantyatastadvyudāsārtham| pakṣaśabdo vadhagrahābhyāṃ sambadhyate, śoṣo dhātuśoṣaḥ| jvaro yadyapi sarvaśarīraga eva, tathā+api viśeṣeṇāmāśayasamutthatvādihocyate| antarmārgajāśceti visarpādiviśeṣaṇam| arśo bahirvalyāśritaṃ śākhāgatam, anyacca koṣṭhagatam| bahirmārgajo gulmo yo bahiruttuṇḍita upalabhyate bahiśca pacyate sa jñeyaḥ, anyastu sarvaḥ koṣṭhagata eva||49||

div.quote: trividhā bhiṣaja iti- bhiṣakchadmacarāḥ santi santyeke siddhasādhitāḥ
div.p: bhiṣakchadmacarā bhiṣagveśacarāḥ| siddhena prasiddhena sādhitāḥ siddhasādhitāḥ| vaidyabhāṇḍaṃ bastinetrādi| pratirūpakā vaidyasadṛśāḥ| vyapadeśaḥ anyasambandhena kīrtanam| atadvidhā jñānahīnāḥ||50-53||

div.quote: tatra daivavyapāśrayaṃ- mantrauṣadhimaṇimaṅgalabalyupahārahomaniyamaprāyaścittopavāsasvastyayanapraṇipātagamanādi, yuktivyapāśrayaṃ- punarāhārauṣadhadravyāṇāṃ yojanā, sattvāvajayaḥ- punarahitebhyo+arthebhyo manonigrahaḥ
div.p: daivamadṛṣṭaṃ tadvyapāśrayaṃ, tacca yadadṛṣṭajananena vyādhipratyanīkaṃ mantrādi; yadi vā daivaśabdena devā ucyante, tānāśritya yadupakaroti tattathā; mantrādayo hi devaprabhāvādeva vyādhiharāḥ, balyupahārādiprītāśca devā eva prabhāvādvyādhīn ghnanti| atra daivavyapāśrayamādāvuktamāśuvyādhiharatvena| praṇipāto devādīnāṃ śārīro namaskāraḥ, gamanaṃ vidūradevādigamanam||54||

div.quote: śarīradoṣaprakope khalu śarīramevāśritya prāyaśastrividhamauṣadhamicchanti- antaḥparimārjanaṃ, bahiḥparimārjanaṃ, śastrapraṇidhānaṃ ceti
div.p: samprati prakārāntareṇopayuktaṃ bheṣajatraividhyamāha- śarīretyādi| prāyaḥśabdaḥ śarīradoṣakopa ityanena sambadhyate; tena, mānasadoṣaje+apyunmādāpasmārādāvañjanādi bhavatīti darśayati; yadi vā prāyastrividhamityanena śārīre+api daivavyapāśrayaṃ svastyayanādi darśayati||55||

vaidyabhedābhidhānaprasaṅgenāturabhedamāha- prājña ityādi| śarma sukhamārogyamiti yāvat| pramādaḥ buddhvā+api rogamapratīkāraḥ| sañjñā samyagjñānaṃ vyādhirayaṃ tvarayā pratikartavya evamākāram| trātāraṃ vaidyamanāsādya; tathāvidhaṃ hi rogiṇaṃ vaidyo nopasarpatīti bhāvaḥ| bālaḥ ajñaḥ| godhādṛṣṭāntena jīvanārthaṃ yatnaṃ kurvannapi vipadyata iti darśayati| pratikurvīta ‘yatnam’ iti śeṣaḥ||56-63||
div.quote: bhavanti cātra- prājño roge samutpanne bāhyenābhyantareṇa vā
bālastu khalu mohādvā pramādādvā na budhyate
na mūḍho labhate sañjñāṃ‘śraddhāṃ’ iti pā. tāvadyāvanna pīḍyate
tathāvidhaṃ ca kaḥ śakto durbalaṃ vyādhipīḍitam
tasmāt prāgeva rogebhyo rogeṣu taruṇeṣu vā
tatra ślokau- eṣaṇāḥ samupastambhā balaṃ kāraṇamāmayāḥ
div.p: saṅgrahe dhīmatā bhāvā iti chedaḥ; aṣṭau bhāvā iti sambandhaḥ| bhāveṣu viṣayeṣu| asaktena aprasaktena| yeṣu eṣaṇādiṣvaṣṭasu| sarvamiti dharmārthakāmāḥ||64-65||

div.quote: ityagniveśakṛte tantre carakapratisaṃskṛte ślokasthāne tisraiṣaṇīyo nāmaikādaśo+adhyāyaḥ
div.p: iti śrīcakrapāṇidattaviracitāyāṃ carakatātparyavyākhyāyāmāyurvedadīpikākhyāyāṃ sūtrasthāne nirdeśacatuṣke tisraiṣaṇīyo nāmaikādaśo+adhyāyaḥ||11||

pūrvādhyāye rogāḥ svarūpamārgabāhyakāraṇabheṣajairabhihitāḥ, upayuktajñānāstatkāraṇavātādayo bahuvācyatvānnoktāḥ, ataḥ samprati pṛthakprakaraṇe te+abhidhīyante vātakalākalīye; tatrāpi prādhānyādvāyureva prathamamucyate| kalā guṇaḥ, yaduktaṃ- “ṣoḍaśakalam” (sū.a.10) iti; akalā guṇaviruddho doṣaḥ; tena vātakalākalīyo vātaguṇadoṣīya ityarthaḥ; yadi vā kalā sūkṣmo bhāgaḥ, tasyāpi kalā kalākalā; tasyāpi‘vātasyātisūkṣmo bhāgaḥ’ iti pā. sūkṣmo bhāga ityarthaḥ||1-2||

div.quote: vātakalākalājñānamadhikṛtya parasparamatāni jijñāsamānāḥ samupaviśya maharṣayaḥ papracchuranyo+anyaṃ- kiṅguṇo vāyuḥ, kimasya prakopaṇam, upaśamanāni vā+asya kāni, kathaṃ cainamasaṅghātavantamanavasthitamanāsādya prakopaṇapraśamanāni prakopayanti praśamayanti vā, kāni cāsya kupitākupitasya śarīrāśarīracarasya śarīreṣu carataḥ karmāṇi bahiḥśarīrebhyoveti
div.p: atrānekarṣivacanarūpatayā vātādiguṇavacanaṃ bahvṛṣisammatidarśanārthaṃ tantradharmaitihyayuktatvakaraṇārthaṃ ca| asaṅghātamiti pittaśleṣmavadavayavasaṅghātarahitam| anavasthitamiti calasvabhāvam| anāsādyeti calatvenānibiḍāvayatvena ceti mantavyam||3||

div.quote: atrovāca kuśaḥ sāṅkṛtyāyanaḥ- rūkṣalaghuśītadāruṇakharaviśadāḥ ṣaḍime vātaguṇā bhavanti
div.p: rūkṣādayo bhāvapradhānāḥ, tena rūkṣatvādayo guṇā mantavyāḥ| dāruṇatvaṃ calatvaṃ calatvāt, evaṃ dīrghañjīvitīyoktaṃ calatvamuktaṃ bhavati; yadi vā, dāruṇatvaṃ śoṣaṇatvāt kāṭhinyaṃ karotīti||4||

kumāraśirā iti bharadvājaviśeṣaṇamātreyagurubharadvājaniṣedhārtham| evamprabhāvairiti prabhāvādraukṣyādikārakairdhāvanajāgaraṇādibhiḥ, prabhāvābhidhānaṃ ‘prabhāvādvidhānaṃ’ iti pā. ca karmaṇāṃ nirguṇatvāt| abhyasyamānairiti asakṛtprayuktaiḥ||5||
div.quote: tacchrutvā vākyaṃ kumāraśirā bharadvāja uvāca- evametadyathā bhagavānāha, eta eva vātaguṇā bhavanti, sa tvevaṅguṇairevandravyairevamprabhāvaiśca karmabhirabhyasyamānairvāyuḥ prakopamāpadyate, samānaguṇābhyāso hi dhātūnāṃ vṛddhikāraṇamiti

tacchrutvā vākyaṃ kāṅkāyano bāhlīkabhiṣaguvāca- evametadyathā bhagavānāha, etānyeva vātaprakopaṇāni bhavanti; ato viparītāni vātasya praśamanāni bhavanti, prakopaṇaviparyayo hi dhātūnāṃ praśamakāraṇamiti
tacchrutvā vākyaṃ baḍiśo dhāmārgava uvāca- evametadyathā bhagavānāha, etānyeva vātaprakopapraśamanāni bhavanti

yathā hyenamasaṅghātamanavasthitamanāsādya prakopaṇapraśamanāni prakopayanti praśamayanti vā, tathā+anuvyākhyāsyāmaḥ- vātaprakopaṇāni khalu rūkṣalaghuśītadāruṇakharaviśadaśuṣirakarāṇi śarīrāṇāṃ, tathāvidheṣu śarīreṣu vāyurāśrayaṃ gatvā+a+apyāyamānaḥ prakopamāpadyate; vātapraśamanāni punaḥsnigdhagurūṣṇaślakṣṇamṛdupicchilaghanakarāṇi śarīrāṇāṃ, tathāvidheṣu śarīreṣu vāyurasajyamānaścaran praśāntimāpadyate
div.p: śarīrāṇāmiti śarīrāvayavānām| śuṣirakarāṇi randhrakarāṇi| āśrayamiti samānaguṇasthānam| āpyāyamānaḥ cīyamānaḥ| dāruṇaviparīto mṛduḥ, śuṣiraviparīto ghanaḥ| asajyamānaḥ anavatiṣṭhamānaḥ, kṣīyamāṇāvayava iti yāvat| etenaitaduktaṃ bhavati- yadyapi vāyunā vātakāraṇānāṃ vātaśamanānāṃ vā tathā sambandho nāsti, tathā+api śarīrasambaddhaistairvātasya śarīracāriṇaḥ sambandho bhavati, tataśca vātasya samānaguṇayogādvṛddhirviparītaguṇayogācca hrāsa upapanna eveti||6-7||

śarīrāśarīracarasyeti vātasvarūpakathanaṃ, tena śarīreṣu carata iti bahiḥ śarīrebhyo veti ca punaruktaṃ na bhavati| atrāvayavāniti vadan ‘vacanaṃ’ iti pā. kārtsnyābhidhānamaśakyaṃ bahuprapañcatvāditi darśayati| sādhayitvā pratipādya| vātakarmasu pratyakṣāṇi vacanādīni, manaḥpreraṇādyanumeyaṃ, garbhākṛtikaraṇādyāgamagamyam| tantraṃ śarīraṃ, yaduktaṃ- “tantrayantreṣu bhinneṣu tamo+antyaṃ pravivikṣatām” (iṃ. a.12) iti, tadeva yantraṃ; yadi vā, tantrasya yantraṃ sandhayaḥ| prāṇādyātmā prāṇādisvarūpaḥ| ceṣṭāviśeṣaṇam- uccāvacānāṃ, vividhānāmityarthaḥ, kiṃvā śubhāśubhānāmityarthaḥ| niyantā anīpsite viṣaye pravartamānasya manasaḥ, praṇetā ca manasa evepsite+arthe| udyojakaḥ prerakaḥ; kiṃvā ‘udyogakāraka’ iti pāṭhaḥ, so+apyabhinnārthaḥ| abhivoḍhevābhivoḍhā sarvendriyārthagrāhakatvena; taccāsya vāyumayena sparśanendriyeṇa sarvendriyāṇāṃ vyāpakatvāt pūrvādhyāyapratipāditena nyāyena boddhavyam| vyūhakaraḥ saṅghātakaro racanākara iti yāvat‘vyūhaḥ saṅghāto racaneti yāvat’ iti pā.| prakṛtiḥ kāraṇaṃ, śabdakāraṇatvaṃ ca vāyornityamākāśānupraveśāt; uktaṃ hi khādīnyabhidhāya- “teṣāmekaguṇaḥ pūrvo guṇavṛddhiḥ pare pare” (śā. a.1) iti| tathā punaruktaṃ khādīnyabhidhāya “viṣṭaṃ hyaparaṃ pareṇa” (nyā.da. a.2. ā.1.sū.66) iti| śravaṇamūlatvaṃ vāyoḥ karṇaśaṣkulīracanāviśeṣe vyāpriyamāṇatvāt; mūlaṃ pradhānakāraṇam| utsāhaḥ kāryeṣūdyogo manasaḥ| yoniḥ abhivyaktikāraṇam| doṣasaṃśoṣaṇaḥ śarīrakledasaṃśoṣaṇaḥ| bhettā kartā; etacca śarīrotpattikāle| bhūta śabdaḥ svarūpavacanaḥ| upaghātāyeti chedaḥ| garbhāniti vikṛtimāpādayatyatikālaṃ dhārayatītyanena ca sambadhyate| ādityādīnāṃ santānenāvicchedena gatividhānaṃ santānagatividhānam| srotasāmiti nadīnām| pravibhāgo vibhaktalakṣaṇam ‘vibhāgalakṣaṇaṃ’ iti pā.| dhātūnāmiti pṛthivyādīnāṃ, dhātavaḥ kāryadravyāṇi prastarādīni; mānaṃ parimāṇaṃ, saṃsthānamākṛtiḥ, tayorvyaktirabhivyaktiḥ, tatra kāraṇamiti yāvat| bījasya śālyādeḥ, abhisaṃskāro+aṅkurajananaśaktiḥ| avikledaḥ pākakālādarvāgaviklinnatvam, upaśoṣaṇaṃ ca pākena yavādīnāmārdrāṇāmeva, avikledopaśoṣaṇe śasyānāmeva| avaikārikavikāreṇa sarvasminneva jagati prakṛtirūpe kāraṇatvaṃ brūte| śikharī parvataḥ| anokaho vṛkṣaḥ| ūrdhvaṃ vartanamudvartanam| pratisaraṇaṃ pratīpagamanam| visarjanaṃ visargaḥ, sa ca pṛthaṅnīhārādibhiḥ sambadhyate; nīhāraḥ śiśirasamūhaḥ, nirhrādo meghaṃ vinā garjitam, aśaniḥ vajrabhedo+agniḥ| asaṅghātaḥ anutpādo+anupacayo vā| upasargaḥ marakādiprādurbhāvaḥ| meghasūryetyādau visargaḥ sṛṣṭiḥ| vāyuriha devatārūpo+abhipretaḥ, tena tasya bhūtarūpacaturyugāntakarānilakaraṇamaviruddham; evaṃ yadanyadapyanupapadyamānaṃ ‘yadapyanupapadyamānaṃ’ iti pā. vāyostadapi devatārūpatvenaiva samādheyam| samprati sāmānyena punaḥ kupitākupitasya vāyoḥ svarūpamucyate- sa hi bhagavānityādi| prabhavaḥ kāraṇam| avyayaḥ akṣayaḥ| bhūtānāmityuttareṇa sambadhyate| mṛtyuyamādibhedāścāgame jñeyāḥ| sarvatantrāṇāṃ sarvakarmaṇāṃ; tantraśabdaḥ karmavacano+apyasti, yaduktaṃ- “bastistantrāṇāṃ” (sū. a.25); karmaṇāmityarthaḥ||8||
div.quote: tacchrutvā baḍiśavacanamavitathamṛṣigaṇairanumatamuvāca vāryovido rājarṣiḥ- evametat sarvamanapavādaṃ yathā bhagavānāha

yāni tu khalu vāyoḥ kupitākupitasya śarīrāśarīracarasya śarīreṣu carataḥ karmāṇi bahiḥśarīrebhyo vā bhavanti, teṣāmavayavān pratyakṣānumānopadeśaiḥ sādhayitvā namaskṛtya vāyave yathāśakti pravakṣyāmaḥ- vāyustantrayantradharaḥ, prāṇodānasamānavyānāpānātmā, pravartakaśceṣṭānāmuccāvacānāṃ, niyantā praṇetā ca manasaḥ, sarvendriyāṇāmudyojakaḥ, sarvendriyārthānāmabhivoḍhā, sarvaśarīradhātuvyūhakaraḥ, sandhānakaraḥ śarīrasya, pravartako vācaḥ, prakṛtiḥ sparśaśabdayoḥ, śrotrasparśanayormūlaṃ, harṣotsāhayoryoniḥ, samīraṇo+agneḥ, doṣasaṃśoṣaṇaḥ‘saṃśoṣaṇo doṣāṇāṃ’ iti pā., kṣeptā bahirmalānāṃ, sthūlāṇusrotasāṃ bhettā, kartāgarbhākṛtīnām, āyuṣo+anuvṛttipratyayabhūto bhavatyakupitaḥ

kupitastu khalu śarīre śarīraṃ nānāvidhairvikārairupatapati balavarṇasukhāyuṣāmupaghātāya‘upaghātāya bhavati’ iti pā., mano vyāharṣayati‘vyāvartayati’ iti pā., sarvendriyāṇyupahanti, vinihanti garbhān vikṛtimāpādayatyatikālaṃ vā dhārayati, bhayaśokamohadainyātipralāpāñjanayati, prāṇāṃścoparuṇaddhi

prakṛtibhūtasya khalvasya loke carataḥ karmāṇīmāni bhavanti; tadyathā- dharaṇīdhāraṇaṃ, jvalanojjvālanam, ādityacandranakṣatragrahagaṇānāṃ santānagatividhānaṃ, sṛṣṭiśca meghānām, apāṃ visargaḥ, pravartanaṃ srotasāṃ, puṣpaphalānāṃ cābhinirvartanam, udbhedanaṃ caudbhidānām, ṛtūnāṃ pravibhāgaḥ, vibhāgo dhātūnāṃ, dhātumānasaṃsthānavyaktiḥ, bījābhisaṃskāraḥ, śasyābhivardhanamavikledopaśoṣaṇe yogīndranāthasenastu ‘vikledopaśoṣaṇam, avaikārikavikāraśca iti paṭhati; vikledasya upaśoṣaṇaṃ; vaikāriko vātādivikṛtijanyo vikāro marakādiḥ, tadabhāvo+avaikārikavikāraḥ’ iti ca vyākhyānayati; , avaikārikavikāraśceti

prakupitasya khalvasya lokeṣu carataḥ karmāṇīmāni bhavanti; tadyathā- śikhariśikharāvamathanam, unmathanamanokahānām, utpīḍanaṃ sāgarāṇām, udvartanaṃ sarasāṃ, pratisaraṇamāpagānām, ākampanaṃ ca bhūmeḥ, ādhamanamambudānāṃ ‘avadhūnanamambudānām’ iti pā., nīhāranirhrādapāṃśusikatāmatsyabhekoragakṣārarudhirāśmāśanivisargaḥ, vyāpādanaṃ ca ṣaṇṇāmṛtūnāṃ, śasyānāmasaṅghātaḥ, bhūtānāṃ copasargaḥ, bhāvānāṃ cābhāvakaraṇaṃ, caturyugāntakarāṇāṃ meghasūryānalānilānāṃ visargaḥ; sa hi bhagavān prabhavaścāvyayaśca, bhūtānāṃ bhāvābhāvakaraḥ, sukhāsukhayorvidhātā, mṛtyuḥ, yamaḥ, niyantā, prajāpatiḥ, aditiḥ, viśvakarmā, viśvarūpaḥ, sarvagaḥ, sarvatantrāṇāṃ vidhātā, bhāvānāmaṇuḥ, vibhuḥ, viṣṇuḥ, krāntā lokānāṃ, vāyureva bhagavāniti

div.p: tacchrutvetyādi sugamam| varcasvitvaṃ tejasvitvam||9-10||
div.quote: tacchrutvā vāryovidavaco marīciruvāca- yadyapyevametat, kimarthasyāsya vacane vijñāne vā sāmarthyamasti‘sāmarthyamiti prayojanam’ bhiṣagvidyāyāṃ; bhiṣagvidyāmadhikṛtyeyaṃ kathā pravṛtteti‘pravartate’ iti pā.

vāryovida uvāca- bhiṣak pavanamatibalamatiparuṣamatiśīghrakāriṇamātyayikaṃ cennānuniśamyet, sahasā prakupitamatiprayataḥ kathamagre+abhirakṣitumabhidhāsyati prāgevainamatyayabhayāt; vāyoryathārthā stutirapi bhavatyārogyāya balavarṇavivṛddhaye varcasvitvāyopacayāya jñānopapattaye paramāyuḥprakarṣāya ceti

marīciruvāca- agnireva śarīre pittāntargataḥ kupitākupitaḥ śubhāśubhāni karoti; tadyathā- paktimapaktiṃ darśanamadarśanaṃ mātrāmātratvamūṣmaṇaḥ prakṛtivikṛtivarṇau śauryaṃ bhayaṃ krodhaṃ harṣaṃ mohaṃ prasādamityevamādīni cāparāṇi dvandvānīti
div.p: pittāntargata iti vacanena śarīre jvālādiyuktavahniniṣedhena pittoṣmarūpasya vahneḥ sadbhāvaṃ darśayati; na tu pittādabhedaṃ, pittenāgnimāndyasya grahaṇyadhyāye vakṣyamāṇatvāt, tathā pittaharasya sarpiṣo+agnivardhanatvenoktatvāt| paktimapaktimiti avikṛtivikṛtibhedena pācakasyāgneḥ karma, darśanādarśane netragatasyālocakasya, ūṣmaṇo mātrāmātratvaṃ varṇabhedau ca tvaggatasya bhrājakasya, bhayaśauryādayo hṛdayasthasya sādhakasya, rañjakasya tu bahiḥsphuṭakāryādarśanādudāharaṇaṃ na kṛtam||11||

div.quote: tacchrutvā marīcivacaḥ kāpya uvāca- soma eva śarīre śleṣmāntargataḥ kupitākupitaḥ śubhāśubhāni karoti; tadyathā- dārḍhyaṃ śaithilyamupacayaṃ kārśyamutsāhamālasyaṃ vṛṣatāṃ klībatāṃ jñānamajñānaṃ buddhiṃ mohamevamādīni cāparāṇi dvandvānīti
div.p: somo jaladevatā, yadi vā candraḥ||12||

div.quote: tacchrutvā kāpyavaco bhagavān punarvasurātreya uvāca- sarva eva bhavantaḥ samyagāhuranyatraikāntikavacanāt; sarva eva khalu vātapittaśleṣmāṇaḥ prakṛtibhūtāḥ puruṣamavyāpannendriyaṃ balavarṇasukhopapannamāyuṣā mahatopapādayanti samyagevācaritā dharmārthakāmā iva niḥśreyasena mahatā puruṣamiha cāmuṣmiṃśca loke; vikṛtāstvenaṃ mahatā viparyayeṇopapādayanti ṛtavastraya iva vikṛtimāpannā lokamaśubhenopaghātakāla iti
bhavati cātra- tadātreyavacaḥ śrutvā sarva evānumenire
div.p: aikāntikavacanāditi avadhāraṇādityarthaḥ| niḥśreyasena sukhena| ṛtavastraya iti śītoṣṇavarṣalakṣaṇāścaturmāsena ṛtunā| upaghātakāla iti deśocchedakāle||13-15||

div.quote: tatra ślokau- guṇāḥ ṣaḍ dvividho heturvividhaṃ karma yat punaḥ
div.p: saṅgrahe guṇāḥ ṣaḍiti rūkṣādayaḥ| dvividho heturiti vātaprakopaheturvātapraśamahetuśca| vividhaṃ nānāprakāraṃ sannikhilameva vāyoḥ karma, yat punaścaturvidhaṃ kupitākupitaśarīrāśarīracarabhedena bhavati, taduktamiti yojanīyaṃ; na hi caturvidhavyatirekeṇa vāyoḥ pṛthagvidhaṃ karmoktam||16-17||

div.quote: ityagniveśakṛte tantre carakapratisaṃskṛte ślokasthāne vātakalākalīyo nāma dvādaśo+adhyāyaḥ samāptaḥ
div.p: iti śrīcakrapāṇidattaviracitāyāṃ carakatātparyaṭīkāyāmāyurvedadīpikāyāṃ sūtrasthāne nirdeśacatuṣke vātakalākalīyo nāma dvādaśo+adhyāyaḥ||12|| iti nirdeśacatuṣkaḥ||3||

nirdeśavātakalākalīye vātādayo+abhihitāḥ, teṣāṃ bheṣajaṃ yathā kalpanīyaṃ tadupadeṣṭuṃ kalpanācatuṣko+abhidhīyate| bheṣajānāṃ kalpanā bheṣajakalpanā, sā ca kalpanā āśrayadravyābhidhānaṃ vinā na pāryate kalpayitum ‘kathayituṃ’ iti pā.; ; ataḥ snehādidravyagocarā sneha-sveda-vamana-virecanakalpanehābhidhīyate, bastikalpanā tviha bahuvaktavyatvānnoktā| atrāpi vamanādipravṛttau snehasyaiva prathamaṃ vidhīyamānatayā tathā doṣapradhānasya vātasya pradhānabheṣajatvācca tatpratipādaka eva snehādhyāyo+abhidhīyate| snehasya pratipādako+adhyāyaḥ snehādhyāyaḥ||1-2||

saṅkhyā samyagjñānaṃ, tena vyavaharantīti sāṅkhyāḥ| saṅkhyātaṃ jñātaṃ saṅkhyeyaṃ jñeyaṃ yaiste tathā; yadi vā ‘saṅkhyātasaṅkhyeyam’ iti pāṭhaḥ, tadā punarvasuviśeṣaṇametat; arthastu samānaḥ| sāṅkhyaiḥ sahāvasthānopadarśanamātreyasya kartavyapraśnānuguṇamanaḥsamādhānopadarśanārtham| saṃśayamiti saṃśayena ‘saṃśayaviṣayeṇa viṣayiṇaṃ’ iti pā. viṣayiṇā viṣayaṃ lakṣayati, tena saṃśayamiti saṃśayaviṣayamityarthaḥ||3||

div.quote: kiṃyonayaḥ kati snehāḥ ke ca snehaguṇāḥ pṛthak
kālānupāne ke kasya kati kāśca vicāraṇāḥ
kati mātrāḥ kathammānāḥ kā ca keṣūpadiśyate
kaśca kebhyo hitaḥ snehaḥ prakarṣaḥ snehane ca kaḥ
snehyāḥ ke ke na ca snigdhāsnigdhātisnigdhalakṣaṇam
kiṃ pānāt prathamaṃ pīte jīrṇe kiñca hitāhitam
ke mṛdukrūrakoṣṭhāḥ kā vyāpadaḥ siddhayaśca kāḥ
acche saṃśodhane caiva snehe kā vṛttiriṣyate
vicāraṇāḥ keṣu yojyā vidhinā kena tat prabho!
div.p: ko+asau saṃśaya ityāha- kiṃyonaya ityādi| kiṃyonayaḥ kimādhārakāraṇāḥ| kālaścānupānaṃ ca kālānupāne| vicāraṇā dravyāntarāsaṃyuktasnehapānaṃ varjayitvā snehopayogaḥ| kathammānā kīdṛṅmānā| kā ceti mātrā| prakarṣaḥ kālaprakarṣaḥ| snehane snehayuktikriyāyām| ke naceti ke na ca snehyāḥ| kiṃ pānāt snehapānāt prathamaṃ pūrvaṃ hitāhitaṃ; kiñca pīte snehe tathā jīrṇe ca snehe hitāhitamiti yojyam| siddhayo vyāpatsādhanāni bheṣajāni| acche iti saṃśodhanapṛthaṅnirdeśādgobalīvardanyāyena saṃśamana iti bhavati| vṛttiriti vṛttiḥ upacāravidhānam| jñānaṃ śāstram||4-8||

abhiṣuka auttarāpathikaḥ| citrā gorakṣakarkaṭī, tadbījamiha; yadi vā citrā lohitairaṇḍaḥ| atasī ‘umā’ iti khyātā ‘sīḍanīti prasiddhā’ iti pā.; | ārukanikocakākṣoḍā auttarāpathikāḥ| snehāśayāḥ snehasthānāni| ete cāviṣkṛtatamatvenoktāḥ, tena nimbatailādayo boddhavyāḥ| āmiṣaṃ māṃsam||9-11||
div.quote: teṣāṃ dadhikṣīraghṛtāmiṣaṃ vasā sneheṣu majjā ca tathopadiśyate

div.p: tailajātānāmiti jātaśabdaḥ prakāravacanaḥ; yathā- “yadāhārajātamagniveśa” (sū.a.25) ityādi| atra yadyapi yogāttilabhavameva tailaṃ, tathā+api rūḍhyeha sarva eva sthāvarasnehāstailamityucyante| yaduktaṃ suśrute- “niṣpattestadguṇatvācca tailatvamitareṣvapi” (su.sū.a.45) iti| viśiṣyate atiricyate| agryamityairaṇḍena sambadhyate||12||
div.quote: (kaṭūṣṇaṃ tailamairaṇḍaṃ vātaśleṣmaharaṃ guru [ kaṣāyasvādutiktaiśca yojitaṃ pittahantrapi [[1[[)

div.p: sarvasnehottamā ityatra sarvaśabdena dadhikṣīrādayo gṛhyante; sarvasnehottamatvaṃ ca sarpirādīnāṃ snehaguṇaprakarṣavattvena| saṃskāro guṇāntarāropaṇaṃ, tasyānuvartanamanuvidhānaṃ svīkaraṇamiti yāvat| etaduktaṃ bhavati- yat- na tathā tailādayo dravyāntarasaṃskṛtāḥ saṃskāraguṇān vahanti yathā sarpiriti| ata evoktaṃ- “nānyaḥ snehastathā kaścit saṃskāramanuvartate| yathā sarpirataḥ sarpiḥ sarvasnehottamaṃ matam” (ni. a.1)| ata eva saṃskārakadravyacitrakādiguṇānuvidhāne+api sarpirna svaguṇān snehaśaityādīn jahāti, kiñca svaguṇān tadguṇāṃśca vahati, yato+anuśabdena paścādvācinā svaguṇavartanasya paścāt saṃskārakaguṇavartanamucyate| ata evoktaṃ- “snehādvātaṃ śamayati pittaṃ mādhuryaśaityataḥ| ghṛtaṃ tulyaguṇaṃ doṣaṃ saṃskārāttu jayet kapham” (ni. a.1) iti| na ca vācyaṃ rūkṣoṣṇacitrakādisaṃskārādrūkṣoṣṇaṃ sarpirbhūtaṃ, tataśca sarpiṣaḥ snehaśaitye tadviruddhe kathaṃ tiṣṭhataḥ? iti; yataḥ sarpiḥsambaddhacitrakāvayavānugataṃ hi rūkṣoṣṇatvaṃ, sarpirgate ca snehaśaitye iti bhinnāśrayatvānna virodhaḥ; idameva ca sarpiṣaḥ saṃskārānuvartanaṃ yat- svaguṇaviruddhasyāpi tasyānupaghātena dhāraṇaṃ; saṃskārakacitrakādiguṇavahane+api sarpiṣaḥ śaityādayaḥ kadācidabhibhūyante saṃskārakaguṇairuṣṇādibhirna punaḥ snehaguṇaḥ, tasya sneheṣu sarvātmanā vyavasthitasya prabalatvāt; ata eva sarpirādayaḥ snehapradhānatvāt ‘snehā’ ityucyante| anye tu saṃskārānuvartanaṃ svaguṇopaghātena saṃskārakaguṇavahanaṃ bruvate, etacca taile tiṣṭhati na sarpiṣīti vadanti; sarpiṣi tu saṃskārānuvartanamuktaṃ yat tat sarpiṣi sarvathā kasyacidguṇasya saṃskāraguṇenānupaghātādbhavati ‘saṃskāragaṇena svaguṇopaghātādbhavati’ iti pā.; ; tathāhi- dāhapraśamanārthaṃ jvare candanādiśītadravyasādhitatailamuktaṃ, yataḥ śītena sādhitaṃ tailamuṣṇamapi svabhāvācchītameva bhavatīti||13||

div.quote: majjā viśeṣato+asthnāṃ ca balakṛt snehane hitaḥ
div.p: snehaguṇānabhidhatte- ghṛtamityādi| nirvāpaṇaṃ dāhapraśamanam| mārutaghnamityādi tailaguṇāḥ| sthirakaram aṅgasthairyakaram| viddhetyādi vasāguṇāḥ| pauruṣopacayaḥ śukropacayaḥ| snehe śarīrasnehane kartavye| balaśukretyādi majjaguṇāḥ||14-17||

div.quote: sarpiḥ śaradi pātavyaṃ vasā majjā ca mādhave
div.p: sarpirādipānakālamāha- sarpiḥ śaradītyādi| mādhave vaiśākhe| prāvṛḍāṣāḍhaśrāvaṇau, yaduktaṃ- “prāvṛṭ śukranabhau jñeyau” (si.a.6) iti| śaradi bahupittatvena pittaviruddhaṃ ghṛtameva yaugikaṃ, nānyastailādiḥ| vasāmajjñostu nātiśītoṣṇatvāt sādhāraṇe; yatastayoranupāne śītatvena voṣṇatvena vā nirdeśo na kṛtaḥ; “yathāsattvaṃ tu śaityauṣṇye vasāmajjñorvinirdiśet” (sū.a.27) iti tu vacanena śaityauṣṇyābhidhānaṃ sāmānyena, tailasarpirvadauṣṇyaśaityānabhidhānānna prakarṣaprāptaśaityoṣṇatvaprāpakam| ata evoktaṃ- “tailavasāmajjasarpiṣāṃ tu yathāpūrvaṃ śreṣṭhatvaṃ vātaśleṣmavikāreṣu bhavati, yathottaraṃ pittavikāreṣu” (vi.a.8) iti| atrottarasya sarpiṣaḥ śaityāt pittaharatvaṃ, tailasya tūṣṇatvādvātaśleṣmaharatvaṃ, vasāmajjñostu sādhāraṇatvena madhyagatatvamiti sthitam| evaṃ vasāmajjñoḥ sādhāraṇatvena tathā balyatvadhātuvṛddhikaratvābhyāmanatiśītoṣṇe tathā balakṣayadhātukṣayayukte mādhave prayogo yuktaḥ| caitrastu mukhyasādhāraṇaguṇo+api prabhūtaśleṣmatayā na snehaviṣaya ityanuktaḥ| sāmānyena snehopayoge śastaṃ kālamāha- nātyuṣṇetyādi| nātyuṣṇe grīṣme, nātiśīte hemante śiśire ca tathā varṣajanitaśaitye varṣākāle| ayaṃ cānātyayikavikāre sati kālaniyamo jñeyaḥ, agre uṣṇe śīte ca kāle snehopadeśāt||18||

kālaviśeṣe doṣaviśeṣe ca pānakramaṃ darśayati- vātetyādinā| vātaśca pittaṃ ca vātapittaṃ, tadadhiko vātapittādhikaḥ| rātrāviti sāyam| uṣṇe grīṣme| śleṣmādhikagrahaṇamatyantaśītavikāragṛhītapuruṣopalakṣaṇārthaṃ, tena vātaśleṣmādhikaḥ śleṣmādhikaśca gṛhyate; ata eva suśrute+apyuktaṃ- “vātapittādhiko rātrau vātaśleṣmādhiko divā” (su.ci.31) iti| kevalavātādhikasya tathā pittādhikasya śleṣmādhikasya ca sādhāraṇe śaradādau kāle utsargasiddha eva pānakālo vakṣyamāṇo bhavati| vakṣyati hi- “pibet saṃśamanaṃ snehamannakāle” ityādi| anye tu bruvate- vātādhikagrahaṇena kevalavātasyāpi grahaṇaṃ, śleṣmādhikavyapadeśācca vātaśleṣma-pittaśleṣmaṇorapi grahaṇamiti| śīte hemantādau| amalaḥ prabalaraśmiryasmin dinasya bhāge bhāskaraḥ so+amalabhāskaro madhyāhna iti yāvat||19||

div.quote: atyuṣṇe vā divā pīto vātapittādhikena vā
śīte rātrau piban snehaṃ naraḥ śleṣmādhiko+api vā
div.p: uktakālaniyamaviparyaye doṣamāha- atyuṣṇe vetyādi| atyuṣṇe kāle divā pītaḥ snehaḥ ślaiṣmikasyāpi yathoktavikārakaraḥ, tathā vātapittādhikena pītaḥ śītakāle+api yathoktavikārakaraḥ; evaṃ niśāpāne+api vākyārthaḥ; paraṃ niṣiddhasya kālasya doṣasya ca melake+atyaye coktavikāraprakarṣāprakarṣau tarkaṇīyau||20-21||
anupānamāha- jalamityādi| taile+anviti anupāne| anupānaparimāṇaṃ tu samyagbheṣajapākārthaṃ kriyamāṇaṃ bheṣajāvaikārikapākenaivonneyaṃ, vṛddhavaidyavyavahārācca||22||

vicāraṇāḥ saṅkhyayā svarūpeṇa caikagranthenāha- odanaścetyādi| vilepī viraladravā yavāgūrbahusikthasamanvitā jñeyā| saśākapallavena kṛto yūṣaḥ khaḍaḥ| kāmbaliko dadhilavaṇasnehatilādikṛta īṣadamlaḥ| etayorudāharaṇaṃ yathā- “takre kapitthacāṅgerīmaricājājicitrakaiḥ‘...cukrīkā...’ iti pā.| supakvaḥ khaḍayūṣo+ayamayaṃ kāmbaliko mataḥ|| dadhyamlo lavaṇasnehatilamāṣānvitaḥ śṛtaḥ” iti| lehaḥ śarkarādīnāṃ pākāt kṛtaḥ; lihyata iti lehaḥ| pravicāryate avacāryate+anukalpenopayujyate+anayeti pravicāraṇā odanādayaḥ; odanādayaśca snehapravicāraṇāyāṃ snehayuktā eva boddhavyāḥ; abhyañjanādayastu yadyapi śuddhasnehasampādyāstathā+api jaṭharāgnisambandhe na vyāpriyanta iti tantre vicāraṇāśabdenocyante||23-25||
div.quote: odanaśca vilepī ca raso māṃsaṃ payo dadhi
yavāgūḥ sūpaśākau ca yūṣaḥ kāmbalikaḥ khaḍaḥ

div.p: kevalasnehapānaṃ tu snehane śaktyatiśayavattvena na vicāraṇāsañjñayocyate, etadevāha- acchapeya ityādi| acchaśca peyaśca acchapeyaḥ, odanādyasambandhe sati peya ityarthaḥ| na tāmāhurvicāraṇāmiti vacanena vaidyaparamparāsiddho+ayaṃ vyavahāra iti darśayati| bhiṣagbhirdṛṣṭo bhiṣagdṛṣṭaḥ| prathame śreṣṭhe kalpe pakṣe bhavatīti prāthamakalpikaḥ, śreṣṭha ityarthaḥ||26||
div.quote: snehasya sa bhiṣagdṛṣṭaḥ‘bhiṣagdiṣṭaḥ’ iti kalpaḥ prāthamakalpikaḥ

div.p: prakārāntareṇa vicāraṇābhedamāha- rasaiścetyādi| samāso rasānāmanyonyamelakaḥ, vyāso+amelakaḥ; samāsavyāsavadbhiḥ ṣaḍbhī rasairodanādigatairupahito yuktaḥ san snehastriṣaṣṭisaṅkhyāṃ prāpnoti| ekaśca kevala ityacchapeyaṃ varjayitvā+abhyañjanādiprayojyaḥ| triṣaṣṭhī rasabhedā ātreyabhadrakāpyīye “svāduramlādibhiryogaṃ” (sū.a.26) ityādivākye vakṣyamāṇā boddhavyāḥ| evaṃ snehānāṃ rasayuktānāṃ catuḥṣaṣṭiḥ pravicāraṇā bhavanti| catuḥṣaṣṭiriti snehānāmityanena sambadhyate, tena pravicāraṇetyekavacanamupapannaṃ bhavati| na sarvavicāraṇā sarvatra kartavyā, kintu sātmyartuvyādhidoṣapuruṣān parīkṣya yā yatra yujyate sā tatra kartavyetyāha- okartvityādi| okaḥ abhyāsaḥ| puruṣagrahaṇena kasmin deśe+ayaṃ puruṣo vartata iti parīkṣayā deśo+apyavaruddho boddhavyaḥ, vayobalaprabhṛtayaśca boddhavyāḥ||27-28||

mātrāyāḥ saṅkhyāṃ pramāṇaṃ cāha- ahorātramityādi| ahorātraśabdo+aṣṭapraharopalakṣaṇaḥ, evamahaḥśabdārdhāhaśabdau catuḥpraharadvipraharopalakṣaṇau, tena praharādyatīte+apyahani pītā mātrā yathoktapraharakālaprāptyā dināntare rātrau vā jīryamāṇā mantavyā; anye tvahorātraśabdena nyūnenāpyahnā yuktā rātrirahorātraśabdenocyate ‘ahorātreṇaivocyate’ iti pā., kṛtsnārdhāhau tu praharopalakṣaṇāviti vadanti| atra yadā ahorātrapariṇāminī mātrā kriyate, tadā tadaharāhāro na kartavyaḥ; ata evaitatpānaṃ puruṣaviśeṣaviṣayakathane uktaṃ- “kṣutpipāsāsahānarāḥ” iti| prabhūtasnehanityāḥ prabhūtasnehasātmyāḥ| samyagyo jitetivacanena mahāvyāpattitvamasyāḥ sūcayati| sarvamārgāḥ koṣṭhasandhimarmaśākhāḥ| punarnavakarī niḥśeṣadoṣaharatvena| aruṣketyādi madhyamamātrāguṇaḥ; aruṣkā arūṃṣikā| śodhanārtha iti śodhanārtha(ṅga)snehakaraṇe; etena uttamamātrā saṃśamane‘saṃśamanī’ iti pā. eva paraṃ, na tu śodhanāṅgasnehe kartavyeti darśayati| ye tvityādi hrasvamātrāguṇaḥ| parihāre sukheti alpaparihāratvena||29-40||
div.quote: pradhānā madhyamā hrasvā snehamātrā jarāṃ prati
iti tisraḥ samuddiṣṭā mātrāḥ snehasya mānataḥ
tāsāṃ prayogān vakṣyāmi puruṣaṃ puruṣaṃ prati
sukhena ca snehayati śodhanārthe ca yujyate
ye tu vṛddhāśca bālāśca sukumārāḥ sukhocitāḥ
snehamātrāṃ pibeyuste hrasvāṃ ye cāvarā bale

div.p: yaḥ sneho yatra kāryastamāha- vātapittetyādi| vātapittavikāragrahaṇenaiva vātapittaprakṛtiṣu labdheṣu punastadabhidhānaṃ vātapittaprakṛtīnāṃ stokaśleṣmavikāre+api ghṛtapānopadeśārtham; evaṃ vātavyādhibhirāviṣṭā vātaprakṛtayaśca ya ityatra vyākhyeyam| balārthina ityatra balaśabdaḥ smṛtyādibhiḥ sambadhyate| ārtāḥ pīḍitāḥ, dāhādibhiriti sambandhaḥ||41-43||

tailaviṣayamāha- pravṛddhetyādi| śītale kāla iti tailasyoṣṇatvena śītale+api kāla ityarthaḥ; tena sāmānyapratiṣedhaḥ ‘nātyuṣṇaśīte snehaṃ pibennaraḥ’ iti na virudhyate; yadi vā sarpiḥpānakālāpekṣayā śītatvaṃ boddhavyam||44-46||
div.quote: balaṃ tanutvaṃ laghutāṃ dṛḍhatāṃ sthiragātratām ‘sthiratāṃ dṛḍhagātratām’ iti pā.;
pibeyuḥ śītale kāle tailaṃ tailocitāśca ye

div.p: vasāviṣayamāha- vātātapetyādi| saṃśuṣkaniṣpītaśabdau kṣīṇārthāveva| mahāruja ityasthyādibhiḥ sambadhyate| khāni srotāṃsi||47-49||

div.quote: yebhyo yebhyo hito yo yaḥ snehaḥ sa parikīrtitaḥ
div.p: dīptāgnaya ityādi majjapānaviṣayaḥ| ghasmarā bahubhakṣakāḥ| āpnuyuḥ upayuñjīran||50||-

prakarṣāviti alpaprakarṣabhūyaḥprakarṣau ‘alpatvabhūyastvaprakarṣau’ iti pā.; tena, alpatvena trairātrikaḥ prakarṣaḥ, bhūyastvena sāptarātrika iti ca bhavati| etacca vakṣyamāṇasadyaḥsnehaprayogātiriktaprayoge boddhavyaṃ; yadi vā, sadyaḥsnehaprayogā api tryaheṇaiva snehayanti, stutyarthaṃ tu teṣu sadya ityuktam| yaduktaṃ- “tryahāvaraṃ saptadinaṃ paraṃ tu snigdho naraḥ svedayitavya iṣṭaḥ| nātaḥ paraṃ snehanamādiśanti sātmyībhavet saptadināt paraṃ tu” (si.a.1.) iti||51||
sāmānyena snehyānāha- svedyā ityādi| svedyāḥ svatantrasvedasādhyā vātarugārtādayaḥ, śodhanāṅgasvedasādhyānāṃ tu śodhayitavyā ityanenaiva gṛhītatvāt| cintakā iti cintābahulāḥ||52||

asnehyānāha- saṃśodhanādṛta ityādi| yeṣāṃ rūkṣaṇaṃ vakṣyate laṅghanabṛṃhaṇīye- “abhiṣyandā mahādoṣā marmasthā vyādhayaśca ye| ūrustambhaprabhṛtayo rūkṣaṇīyā nidarśitāḥ” (sū. a.22) ityanena, teṣāṃ śodhanādṛte snehanaṃ na śastaṃ, yadā tu śodhanena virūkṣyante tadā paraṃ śodhanāṅga(rtha)statra snehaḥ kartavya iti bhāvaḥ| utsanno vṛddhaḥ kapho medaśca yeṣāṃ te tathā; etacca viśeṣaṇaṃ virūkṣaṇīyā evambhūtā eva bhavantīti darśayati‘darśanārthaṃ’ iti pā.| abhiṣyaṇṇaḥ dravapradhānaśleṣmavikārī| garaḥ kṛtrimaṃ viṣam| atipratāntaḥ atikṣīṇadravadhātuḥ| vartamāneṣu kriyamāṇeṣvityarthaḥ||53-56||
div.quote: na snehyā vartamāneṣu na nasto bastikarmasu

div.p: asnigdhalakṣaṇamāha- purīṣamityādi| mṛduriti pakturviśeṣaṇam| vātānulomyamityādi snigdhalakṣaṇam| pāṇḍutetyādi atisnigdhalakṣaṇam| jāḍyam indriyajaḍatvam||57-59||
div.quote: pāṇḍutā gauravaṃ‘sadanaṃ’ iti pā. jāḍyaṃ purīṣasyāvipakvatā

div.p: snehāt pūrvaṃ yat pathyaṃ tadāha- dravoṣṇamityādi| asaṅkīrṇam aviruddhavīryam| śva ityāgāmidine| annakāle dvipraharādilakṣaṇe bubhukṣā kadācinna‘na bhavatyapi’ iti pā. syādapi tadarthaṃ viśeṣaṇaṃ- prakāṅkṣita iti| śuddhyarthaṃ tu snehaṃ naiśe dināntarakṛte āhāre jīrṇa eva prātareva pibedityarthaḥ| saṃśamanārthasneho yadi jaraṇānte prātareva kriyate tadā koṣṭhopalepakadoṣasyākṣayāttena doṣeṇa sambaddho doṣotkleśaṃ kuryānna saṃśamanaṃ, saṃśodhanārthastu doṣotkleśaṃ karotītyapekṣaṇīya eveti bhāvaḥ| etacca kālakathanamutsargeṇa, tena “vātapittādhiko rātrau” ityuktakālavirodho na bhavati||60-61||

kṣapāyāmeva svapitīti kṣapāśayaḥ| apravātaṃ ceti śayanāsanaviśeṣaṇam| snehaṃ pratibhuñjāna iti snehe jīrṇe+api snehaprayogānuguṇamanyasnehamaviruddhavīryādiguṇayuktaṃ bhuñjānaḥ| etena snehe pīte jīrṇe kiñca hitāhitamiti praśnadvayasyottaramidam- uṣṇodakopacārī syādityādi bhavati||62-64||
div.quote: śakṛnmūtrānilodgārānudīrṇāṃśca na ‘udīrṇāṃśca na dhārayedityatra cakārādanudīrṇāṃśca nodīrayedityartho jñeyaḥ’ iti śivadāsasenaḥ; dhārayet

snehaṃ gaṅgādharastu ‘snehaṃ pītvā nare snehaṃ pratibhuñjāna eva ca’ iti paṭhati, ‘snehaṃ pītvā tvaparaṃ snehaṃ pratibhuñjāne nare snehamithyopacārāddāruṇā gadā jāyante’ iti vyākhyānayati; yogīndranāthasenastu ‘snehaṃ pītvā naraḥ snehaṃ pratibhuñjāna eva ca; uṣṇodakopacārī syāt’ ityādi ‘seveta śayanāsanam; snehamithyopacārāddhi jāyante dāruṇā gadā’ ityevaṃ kiñcitpaurvāparyaṃ kṛtvā paṭhati, ‘pīte hitāhitamāha- snehaṃ pītvetyādi; snehaṃ pītvā tathā snehaṃ pratibhuñjānaḥ tasminneva dine snehaṃ piban snehaṃ pītavān snehaṃ pibaṃścetyarthaḥ, nara uṣṇodakopacārī syāt’ ityādi vyākhyānayati ca; pītvā naraḥ snehaṃ pratibhuñjāna eva ca
madyaṃ vā taruṇaṃ pītvā mṛdukoṣṭho viricyate
mṛdukoṣṭhasya tasmāt sa suvirecyo naraḥ smṛtaḥ
div.p: mṛdukoṣṭhādilakṣaṇamāha- mṛdvityādi| abhyarhitatvāt koṣṭhajñānasyānyathā+api tallakṣaṇamāha- guḍamityādi| ulloḍitaṃ dadhisaraḥ| kṛśarā tilataṇḍulamāṣakṛtā yavāgūḥ; vacanaṃ hi- “tilataṇḍulamāṣaistu kṛśarā trisareti ca”| krūrakoṣṭhāvirecanahetumāha- bhavatītyādi| grahaṇī koṣṭhasthāgnyadhiṣṭhānabhūtā nāḍī; yaduktam- “agnyadhiṣṭhānamannasya grahaṇādgrahaṇī matā” (ci.a.15) iti| udīrṇapittetyādi mṛdukoṣṭhasvarūpakathanam| krūrakoṣṭhasya grahaṇīgato vāyurguḍādīnāṃ saratvaṃ pratibadhnāti, mṛdukoṣṭhasya hi grahaṇyāṃ virodhako vāyurnāsti, stambhako+api śleṣmā+alpaḥ, udbhūtasaratvaguṇaṃ ca pittaṃ prabalaṃ; tena guḍādibhiḥ sukhaṃ virecanaṃ bhavatīti bhāvaḥ||65-69||

samprati snehavyāpado darśayati- udīrṇetyādi| ojaḥ sarvadhātusārabhūtaṃ hṛdi sthitaṃ, prakṣārayan sthānādbhraṃśayan kṣapayaṃśca| balītyanena snehendhano vahnirnitarāṃ balavān bhavatīti darśayati| vacanaṃ hi- “nālaṃ snehasamṛddhasya śamāyānnaṃ sugurvapi” iti| uttamāṃ mahatīṃ mātrām| sopasargāṃ sopadravām| kakṣaḥ kāṣṭhasamūhaḥ| chardayediti prathamaṃ snehameva tṛṣṇākārakaṃ chardayitvā punaḥ śītodakaṃ pītvā rūkṣānnaṃ ca bhuktvā ullikhediti yojanīyam| na sarpirityādi|- na sarpiḥ sāme pitte peyaṃ, kevalaṃ tvasaṃskṛtaṃ viśeṣato na peyaṃ sāmapitta eveti yojanā; evaṃ manyate- saṃskṛtaṃ tiktakādibhiryutaṃ sāme pitte tiktakādipācanaguṇānuyogādyogyaṃ kadācidbhavatyapi‘yogyaṃ śaṅkyetāpi’ iti pā., asaṃskṛtaṃ tu sarvathā viruddhameva; yadivā, kevalamasaṃskṛtaṃ sarpiḥ pitte sāmānyena sāme nirāme vā na peyaṃ, sāme pitte viśeṣata iti yojanā| etena, yatrāpi sāmānyena ghṛtaṃ vihitaṃ, yathā- “ata ūrdhvaṃ kaphe mande vātapittottare jvare| paripakveṣu doṣeṣu sarpiḥpānaṃ yathā+amṛtam” (ci.a.3) ityādau, tatrāpyucitabheṣajasaṃskṛtameva boddhavyam| yadivā, na kevalaṃ pitte sāme sarpirviśeṣato na peyaṃ, kintarhi tailādīnyapi vātaśleṣmavihitāni tayoḥ sāmayorna peyānītyarthaḥ| asmin vyākhyāne+apeyamityakārapraśleṣo draṣṭavyaḥ| anurajet pittavarṇaṃ kuryāt| sañjñā smṛtiḥ, taddhananaṃ ceha vyādhiprabhāvāt| staimityam ārdravastrāguṇṭhitatvamiva| āmapradoṣā alasakavisūcikādayaḥ| kālapratīkṣaṇaṃ snehajanitadoṣakṣayaṃ yāvadabhojanam| takrasyāriṣṭānāṃ ca cikitsāvakṣyamāṇānāṃ prayogaḥ| mūtrāṇāṃ triphalāyāśca sevanamiti sambandhaḥ||70-78||
div.quote: sa jagdhvā snehamātrāṃ tāmojaḥ prakṣārayan balī
sa cet suśītaṃ salilaṃ nāsādayati dahyate
ajīrṇe yadi tu snehe tṛṣṇā syācchardayedbhiṣak
na sarpiḥ kevalaṃ pitte peyaṃ sāme viśeṣataḥ
sarvaṃ hyanurajeddehaṃ‘hyanucareddehaṃ’ iti pā. hatvā sañjñāṃ ca mārayet
tandrā‘tantrīrutkleśa’ iti pā. sotkleśa ānāho jvaraḥ stambho visañjñatā
prati prati vyādhibalaṃ buddhvā sraṃsanameva ca
akāle cāhitaścaiva mātrayā na ca yojitaḥ
div.p: mithyopacārāt yathoktavidhyananuṣṭhānāt| atisevitaḥ kālaprakarṣeṇa sevitaḥ||79||

saṃśodhanasnehapāne vṛttipracāramāha- snehādityādi| snehāt snehaprayogāt| trirātroparataḥ trirātraṃ parityaktasnehapāna ityarthaḥ| praskandanaṃ virecanam| snehoparamatrirātra‘snehoparatasya trirātra eva’ iti pā. eva bhojanaṃ darśayati- snehavadityādi| rasapradhānamodanaṃ rasaudanam||80||
vamane snehavṛttimāha- eketyādi| ekāhoparataḥ snehāditi yojanā| tadvaditi snehavaddravamuṣṇaṃ ca rasaudanaṃ snehoparamadivasa eva|81|-

saṃśamanavidhimāha- syāttvityādi| asaṃśodhanārthīye saṃśamane| vṛttiḥ upacāraḥ| viriktavadityanenāgatāvekṣaṇenopakalpanīyavakṣyamāṇaṃ “samyagviriktaṃ cainaṃ” (sū. a.15) ityādigranthapratipādanīyamupacāramāha, natu peyādikramamātram ‘viriktavaditi yathā virikte peyādikramastathā+asminnapi’ iti yogīndranāthasenaḥ; | yadyapi vamanoktā eva tatroccairbhāṣyādayo virecanavṛttāvapyatidiṣṭāstathā+apīha vamanavidhi parityajya virecanavidhyatideśo dhūmapānapratiṣedhārthaḥ, virecane hi tatra “dhūmapānavarjaṃ” (sū. a.15) iti kṛtaṃ, snehapāne ca dhūmapānaṃ niṣiddhaṃ mātrāśitīye- “na madyadugdhe pītvā ca na snehaṃ” (sū. a.5) ityādinā||81||

vicāraṇāviṣayamāha- snehadviṣa ityādinā| lāvādirasānāmuktānāṃ saṃskāramāha- yavetyādi| rase snehārthoktarasa ucitaḥ saṃyogo yeṣāṃ te rasasaṃyogāḥ, teṣāṃ saṅgrahaṇaṃ saṅgrahaḥ| pūrvamiti bhojanāt pūrvam| tilapradhānaḥ kāmbalikastilakāmbalikaḥ| phāṇitamityādau śṛṅgaveramiti śṛṅgaverarasam| bhṛtaiḥ bhaṭitrīkṛtaiḥ| pāñcaprasṛtikī agre vakṣyamāṇā| māṣamiśrako māṣataṇḍulakṛtamannam| peyā pātavyā||82-90||
div.quote: phāṇitaṃ śṛṅgaveraṃ ca tailaṃ ca surayā saha
tailaṃ surāyā maṇḍena vasāṃ majjānameva vā
piban saphāṇitaṃ kṣīraṃ naraḥ snihyati vātikaḥ
naraḥ snihyati pītvā vā saraṃ dadhnaḥ saphāṇitam
(śaukaro vā rasaḥ snigdhaḥ sarpirlavaṇasaṃyutaḥ [ pīto dvirvāsare yatnāt snehayedacirānnaram [[1[[)
kuṣṭhī śothī pramehī ca snehane na prayojayet
vyoṣagarbhaṃ bhiṣak snehaṃ pītvā snihyati taṃ naraḥ
div.p: yathārhamiti yo yatra sneho yujyate sarpirādiḥ| siddhairiti pippalībhistathā harītakyā tathā triphalayā ceti pṛthagyojanīyaṃ; pippalyādisiddhasnehaśca kuṣṭhādiṣu yathāsaṅkhyamiti kecit| yūṣaśabdaḥ kvāthavacanaḥ| vyoṣagarbhaṃ vyoṣakalkam| atra tribhirdravyairmilitvā cāturguṇyam| yavakolādau ṣaḍdravyāṇi snehasamāni| kṣāro yavakṣāraḥ kalkaḥ||91-94||
tailamajjetyādi|- catuḥsneho+akalka eva, tailamajjavasāsarpirityekavadbhāvāddvitīyāntaḥ prayogaḥ||95||

samprati sneha upayukto yathā śarīraṃ sasnehyādhiko dṛśyate, tadāha- gṛhṇātītyādi| tacca śiṣyeṇādhyāyādāvapṛṣṭamapi śiṣyahitatayā+abhidhīyate| yathāgnīti agnyanadhika ityarthaḥ| nanvagnyadhikaścet sravati, tadavadhi ca snehalakṣaṇamuktaṃ, yaducyate- “adhastāt snehadarśanam” iti, tenaikadina evādhikasnehapānaṃ kriyatāmityāha- yathā cetyādi| ākledya īṣatkledayitvā| tvaritasevitaḥ sneho dhātūnasnehayitvaiva sraṃsate+adho yāti yāvān, na tāvatā snehanaṃ bhavatīti bhāvaḥ||96-97||
div.quote: gṛhṇātyambu “idānīmupayuktaḥ snehaḥ śarīraṃ saṃsnehyādhikaścedbhavati tadā sravati, anyathātu jīryatyevetyāha- gṛhṇātītyādi; yathāgnīti agnyanurūpam; nanu snehapānaṃ hi snigdhalakṣaṇāvadhi kāryaṃ, tenaikadina eva tathā snehapānaṃ kriyatāṃ yathā śīghrameva snehalakṣaṇaṃ syādityāha- yathā cetyādi; ākledya īṣatkledayitvā, evaṃ tvaritasevito+api sneho dhātūnasnehayitvaiva sraṃsate adho yāti, tathā ca sati samyaksnehanaṃ na bhavatīti bhāvaḥ” iti śivadāsasenaḥ; yathā vastraṃ prasravatyadhikaṃ yathā

div.p: snehane sarvasneheṣu lavaṇaprayogamāha- lavaṇopahitā ityādi| taditi lavaṇam| abhiṣyandi doṣasaṅghātavicchedakam| vyavāyi akhiladehavyāptipūrvakapākagāmi||98||
ato vakṣyamāṇasvedopakalpanādhyāyayoḥ sambandhasūcakaṃ svedādiṣu snehasya prāgbhāvamāha- snehamityādi||99||
cāndrabhāgī punarvasuḥ||100||
div.quote: tatra ślokaḥ- snehāḥ snehavidhiḥ kṛtsnavyāpatsiddhiḥ sabheṣajā
yathāpraśnaṃ ‘yathānyāyaṃ yathāśāstraṃ snehasvedopapādanairityanvayaḥ, śāstroktasnehasvedavidhibhirityarthaḥ’ iti śivadāsasenaḥ; bhagavatā vyāhṛtaṃ cāndrabhāginā
ityagniveśakṛte tantre carakapratisaṃskṛte ślokasthāne snehādhyāyo nāma trayodaśo+adhyāyaḥ samāptaḥ
div.p: iti śrīcakrapāṇidattaviracitāyāṃ carakatātparyavyākhyāyāmāyurvedadīpikāyāṃ sūtrasthāne kalpanācatuṣke snehādhyāyo nāma trayodaśo+adhyāyaḥ||13||
snehapūrvakatvāt svedasya svedādhyāyo+abhidhīyate| svedapratipādako+adhyāyaḥ svedādhyāyaḥ||1-2||

vātakaphātmakā asaṃsṛṣṭavātakaphajāḥ, vātakaphajatve+apyudarādayaḥ svedena na śāmyanti, ata āha- svedasādhyāḥ; etenodarādayo+asvedyā vyāvartyante| snehapūrvamiti kriyāviśeṣaṇam| na sajjanti apravṛttāni na bhavanti| yathānyāyaṃ yathāgamam, etacca snehasvedopapādanairityanena sambadhyate; yadi vā yathānyāyaṃ yathāsahajaṃ namayantīti sambandhaḥ||3-5||

div.quote: dravyavān kalpito deśe svedaḥ kāryakaro mataḥ
div.p: rogamṛtuṃ vyādhitaṃ ca balavattvādinā+apekṣata iti rogartuvyādhitāpekṣaḥ| nātyuṣṇo nāticaṇḍatāpaḥ| dravyavāniti snigdharūkṣādidravyavān| kalpita iti rogādīnapekṣya yathocitena dravyeṇa deśe cāmāśayādau yathāyogyatayā sampādita iti mantavyam||6||

div.quote: vyādhau śīte śarīre ca mahān svedo mahābale
durbale durbalaḥ svedo madhyame madhyamo hitaḥ
vātaśleṣmaṇi vāte vā kaphe vā sveda iṣyate
div.p: rogādyapekṣayoktakalpanāṃ darśayati- vyādhāvityādi| vyādhau mahābale tathā śīte kālakṛte mahābale| mahāniti caṇḍatāpa eva punaḥ punaḥ kriyamāṇatvena mṛdusvedāpekṣayā+adhikatāpatvena jñeyaḥ| durbala iti tathā madhyama iti ca vyādhyādiṣu pūrvavadyojanīyam| snigdharūkṣadravyakṛtaḥ snigdharūkṣaḥ, snigdharūkṣadravyādayo vātaśleṣmādiṣu yathāsaṅkhyaṃ mantavyāḥ; etacca snigdharūkṣādikathanaṃ dravyāpekṣakalpanodāharaṇaṃ; vāte snigdhaḥ, kaphe rūkṣaḥ||7-8||

taṃ deśaviśeṣasambandhena vyabhicārayan deśāpekṣāṃ kalpanāmāha- āmāśayetyādi| āmāśayagate vāte rūkṣapūrvaḥ sthānāpekṣayā pūrvaṃ rūkṣaṃ kṛtvā paścādvātāpekṣaḥ snigdhaḥ kāryaḥ, evaṃ pakvāśayagate kaphe snehapūrvo vyākhyeyaḥ; āmāśayaśabdena kaphasthānaṃ jñeyaṃ, kaphasthānāpekṣayā hi prathamaṃ rūkṣaḥ kriyate, yaduktaṃ- “sthānaṃ jayeddhi pūrvaṃ tu sthānasthasyāviruddhataḥ” iti||9||

div.quote: vṛṣaṇau hṛdayaṃ dṛṣṭī svedayenmṛdu naiva vā
div.p: mṛdu naiva veti svedaikasādhye vṛṣaṇādigate vyādhau mṛdusvedaḥ, svedavyatiriktopāyāntarasambhave tu na veti boddhavyam| iṣṭata ityāturecchāto vaidyecchātaśca| iṣṭata iti bhāvādicchāvacanaḥ||10||
svede kriyamāṇe cakṣuṣaḥ svedaparihāropāyamāha- suśuddhairityādi| naktakaḥ karpaṭāvayavaḥ ‘karpaṭāvayavaḥ paṭāvayavaḥ’ iti pāṭhaḥ; ||11||
svede kriyamāṇe hṛdayarakṣaṇārthamāha- muktāvalībhirityādi| jalajāni paṅkajādīni| evamasvedyatvasāmānyatvādvṛṣaṇarakṣā+apyunnetavyā, prādhānyāddhṛdayacakṣuḥpālanamuktam||12||

śītaśūletyādi| sveda iti svedabhave gharme| svedanādviratirmatetyupadiśan śītādivyuparame sati svedo nivartanīyaḥ, śītādyanuparame ca svedaḥ kartavya iti dvayamupadiśati; tataśca ita eva svedanivṛttiviṣayaśītādivyuparamotpādaḥ svedasya samyagyogalakṣaṇaṃ tathā śītādivyuparamānutpādaśca svedānivṛttiviṣayo+ayogalakṣaṇamuktaṃ bhavatīti nāyogalakṣaṇānabhidhānamudbhāvanīyam||13||

atisvinnacikitsitamāha- ukta ityādi| graiṣmiko vidhirityanena labdhe punarmadhuraḥ snigdhaśītala ityādivacanaṃ “madyamalpaṃ na vā peyaṃ” (sū.a.6) ityatropadiṣṭamadyapānasya pratiṣedhārthaṃ, madhuraśītādiyogaviśeṣavidhānārthaṃ ca||14-15||

asvedyānāha- kaṣāyetyādi| kaṣāyadravyakṛtaṃ madyaṃ kaṣāyamadyaṃ; kiṃvā kaṣāyaśabdo+amadhuravacanaḥ, na tena yaducyate- kaṣāyanityasya vātapradhānatā syāt kaṣāyasya vātakāritvāt, vāte ca svedo vihita eva, tat kathaṃ kaṣāyanityaṃ prati svedaniṣedha iti, tannirastaṃ bhavati| kiṃvā, kaṣāyanityā rūkṣātistabdhagātrā bhavanti, kaṣāyasya virūkṣakastambhakatvena; tataśca teṣāṃ svedaḥ parvabhedamāvahatītyataḥ kaṣāyanityaniṣedhaḥ| raktapittināmavidhānādeva svede niṣiddhe, punaḥ svedaniṣedho raktapittināṃ yadyanyo+api svedasādhyo vātaśleṣmajo vikāro bhavati tatrāpi svedaniṣedhārthaṃ, tathā raktapittināṃ vamanavirecanāṅgatayā prāptasvedapratiprasavaniṣedhārthaṃ ca; evaṃ pittamehikāmalyādiṣvapi vyākhyeyam| pittināmiti pittaprakṛtīnām| madhumehaśabdena sarva evaṃ mehā gṛhyante, madhumehaśabdo hi sarveṣveva meheṣu vartata iti kiyantaḥśirasīye darśanīyaṃ, meheṣu ca sarveṣveva śarīraśaithilyapravṛtteṣu viśeṣataḥ śarīraśaithilyahetutvena svedo na yujyate; pittamehināmiti tu punarabhidhānaṃ pittasambandhena viśeṣapratiṣedhatādarśanārtham| bradhnaḥ gudaḥ| madyavikāriṇāmiti madyanityasya vātakaphajamadātyaye svedaniṣedhārtham| āḍhyarogīha vātaraktī| eṣu cāsvedaviṣayeṣu yadi svedaikasādhyaḥ sannyāsādirbhavati tadā mahāpratyavāyabhayādalpapratyavāyamupekṣyāpi svedo vidheya iti nyāyasiddhameva; yadāhurnyāyavidaḥ- “bhūyovirodhe svalpamanyāyyam” iti||16-19||
div.quote: tṛṣyatāṃ kṣudhitānāṃ‘kṣutparītānāṃ’ iti pā. ca kruddhānāṃ śocatāmapi

div.p: pratiśyāye cetyādinā svedyān darśayati| vināmakaḥ śarīravinamanakārī vātaḥ| vijṛmbhako bahirāyāmaḥ, jṛmbhābahutvaṃ vā| pādajānūrujaṅghābhirartiḥ saṅgrahaśca pṛthak sambadhyate| khallī hastapadāvamoṭanam| vātakaṇṭako gulphāśrito vātaḥ| alāghava iti pūrvamukte+api punargauravavacanamaṅgānāṃ gurutaratvapratipādanārtham, alāghavavacanaṃ tu lāghavapratiṣedhamātraprayojanaṃ nātigurutvaṃ brūte, yataḥ sarvatra nañ viruddhe na vartate, yathā “arūkṣamanabhiṣyandi tvāsīnapracalāyitam” (sū.a.21) ityatra na hyarūkṣaśabdena snigdhatvamabhipretaṃ, kiṃ tarhi rūkṣatāpratiṣedhamātrameva||20-24||
div.quote: saṅkocāyāmaśūleṣu stambhagauravasuptiṣu ‘stambhasya gauravaṃ bahutvamatistabdhatetyarthaḥ; na tu gauravamityarthaḥ, alāghave iti pūrvamuktatvāt’ iti śivadāsasenaḥ;

div.p: vakṣyamāṇānāṃ saṅkarādisvedānāṃ dravyāṇyāha- tilamāṣetyādi| piṇḍarūpaḥ svedaḥ piṇḍasvedaḥ| karīṣaḥ śuṣkagomayaḥ; āyasaḥ ayovikāraḥ, sa ceha puṭakaraṇayogyo boddhavyaḥ| pūrvairiti tilamāṣādibhiḥ| yathāsvamityanena tilamāṣādayo vāte, gokharādigranthoktāśca śleṣmaṇi, prastarasvede kartavyā iti darśayati||25-27||
bhūgṛheṣviti bhūsvedārtheṣu gṛheṣu| uṣṇagarbhagṛheṣviti kuṭīsvedaṃ darśayati| svabhyakta iti samyagabhyaktaḥ||28||

bastaśiraḥ chāgamastakam| snehavantaścairaṇḍabījādayaḥ tilāśca taṇḍulāśca snehavattilataṇḍulāḥ| grāmyetyādinā vātāpaho nāḍīsveda uktaḥ, vāruṇetyādinā kaphāpahaḥ, bhūtīketyādinā vātaśleṣmāpahaḥ| vāruṇo varuṇaḥ amṛtakā guḍūcī, sarṣapairityatra patrairiti sambadhyate| vaṃśo veṇuḥ| punaḥ śobhāñjanagrahaṇāddvitīyo viṭapaśobhāñjano gṛhyate, saireyaḥ jhiṇṭī||29-33||
div.quote: deśakālavibhāgajño ‘deśakālavikārajñaḥ iti, deśakālavicārajñaḥ’ iti ca pā. yuktyapekṣo bhiṣaktamaḥ
eta eva ca niryūhāḥ prayojyā jalakoṣṭhake
div.p: eta eveti nāḍīsvedoktāstrayo+api| jalakoṣṭhaḥ avagāhārthaṃ kṛtaṃ mahajjalapātram; evaṃ ghṛtakṣīratailakoṣṭhāśca vyākhyātāḥ||34||

godhūmaśakalaiḥ godhūmacūrṇaiḥ| kiṇvaḥ surābījam| upanāhaḥ bahalaṃ lepaṃ dattvā carmādibhirāvṛtya vyādhiyuktasyāṅgasya bandhanam; carmabhiścopanaddhavya ityatra upanāho+anagnisvedo ‘ayaṃ cānagnirasvedo+atibahalatvena śarīroṣmarodhaṃ kṛtvā svedayati’ iti śivadāsasenaḥ; grāhyaḥ| gandhaiḥ sugandhidravyairupanāho bandhanīyaḥ| uṣṇavīryairiti uṣṇavīryamṛgādiprāṇiprabhavaiḥ ‘ānūpaprāṇibhavāni carmāṇi prāyeṇoṣṇavīryāṇi bhavanti’ iti śivadāsasenaḥ; | āvikaśāṭakaḥ kambalaḥ||35-37||

div.quote: rātrau baddhaṃ divā muñcenmuñcedrātrau divā kṛtam
div.p: upanāhasvede bandhamokṣāvadhiṃ darśayati- rātrau baddhamityādi| divākṛtamityatra ‘bandhaṃ’ iti śeṣaḥ| vidāhaḥ raktādividāhaḥ| śītale ityatra “kāle” iti śeṣaḥ| prakarṣa uktādbandhanakālādadhikakālatvaṃ bandhanasya||38||

div.quote: jentāko+aśmaghanaḥ karṣūḥ kuṭī bhūḥ kumbhikaiva ca
div.p: samprati sāgnisvedānāṃ saṅkarādīnāṃ lakṣaṇamabhidhātuṃ saṅkarādīn svedān nāmatastāvaduddiśati- saṅkara ityādi| saṅkarādiśabdāścāyurvedaparamparāsiddhāḥ; tatra kvacinnāḍīsvedādau nāḍyā praṇīyata ityanvayo+apyanusaraṇīyaḥ, jentākādayaścānvayanirapekṣā eva||39-40||

div.quote: tatra vastrāntaritairavastrāntaritairvā piṇḍairyathoktairupasvedanaṃ saṅkarasveda iti vidyāt

div.p: pulākaḥ tucchadhānyam| utkārikā māṣādikṛtotkārākṛtivyañjanaviśeṣaḥ‘māṃsādikṛta ... ’ iti pā.| prastīryata iti prastaraḥ śayanapramāṇena svedavastūnāṃ vistaraṇaṃ, tasmin prastare| kauśeyāvikottarapracchade kauśeyāvikapihita ityarthaḥ| pañcāṅgula eraṇḍabhedaḥ||42||
div.quote: śūkaśamīdhānyapulākānāṃ veśavārapāyasakṛśarotkārikādīnāṃ vā prastare kauśeyāvikottarapracchadepañcāṅgulorubūkārkapatrapracchade vā svabhyaktasarvagātrasya śayānasyopasvedanaṃ‘śayānasyopari svedanaṃ’ iti pā. prastarasveda iti vidyāt

div.p: svedanetyādinā nāḍīsvedamāha| svedanadravyāṇi svedopagagaṇoktāni iha ca nāḍīsvedakvāthārthamuktāni| śiraḥpadaṃ mastakam| bāṣpamanudvamantyāmityanena kvathanakāle bāṣpo yathā na niryāti tathā kartavyamiti darśayati| utkvathitānāṃ bāṣpaṃ snehāktagātraḥ‘snehāktagātrasya’ iti pā. san nāḍyā upaharediti sambandhaḥ| nāḍīkaraṇavidhimāha- śareṣīketyādi| vaṃśadalo vaṃśavidalaḥ ‘vaṃśapatraṃ’ iti pā.; | gajāgrahastasaṃsthānatvaṃ nāḍyā agra eva boddhavyam| vyāmaḥ tiryagvistṛtabāhudvayapramāṇaṃ; vyāmadīrghatvaṃ nāḍyā bahalasvede kartavyam| vyāmacaturthabhāgena vyāmāṣṭabhāgena ca mūle agre ca yathāsaṅkhyaṃ mānaṃ nāḍyā veditavyaṃ; pariṇāhena veṣṭanena sroto randhraṃ yasyāḥ sā tathā| yathoktanāḍīkaraṇe guṇamāha- bāṣpo hītyādi| vihatacaṇḍavegatvaṃ nāḍīkāyā dīrghatvena vakratvena ca boddhavyam||43||
div.quote: svedanadravyāṇāṃ punarmūlaphalapatraśuṅgādīnāṃ mṛgaśakunapiśitaśiraspadādīnāmuṣṇasvabhāvānāṃ vā yathārhamamlalavaṇasnehopasaṃhitānāṃ mūtrakṣīrādīnāṃ vā kumbhyāṃ bāṣpamanudvamantyāmutkvathitānāṃ nāḍyā śareṣīkāvaṃśadalakarañjārkapatrānyatamakṛtayā gajāgrahastasaṃsthānayā vyāmadīrghayā vyāmārdhadīrghayā vā vyāmacaturbhāgāṣṭabhāgamūlāgrapariṇāhasrotasā sarvato vātaharapatrasaṃvṛtacchidrayā dvistrirvā vināmitayā vātaharasiddhasnehābhyaktagātro bāṣpamupaharet; bāṣpo hyanṛjugāmī‘hyanūrdhvagāmī’ iti pā. vihatacaṇḍavegastvacamavidahan sukhaṃ svedayatīti nāḍīsvedaḥ

div.p: pariṣekavidhimāha- vātiketyādi| vātikāni vātaharāṇi, uttaravātikāni uttaravāte ‘uttaraḥ pradhāno vāto yatra īdṛśo yo vātakaphasaṃsargastatra hitāni’ iti śivadāsasenaḥ; pradhānavāte vātaśleṣmaṇi hitānīha grāhyāṇi| varṣaṇikā alpaghaṭī, ‘sahasradhārā’ ityanye; praṇāḍī veṇunalanāḍyādyāḥ||44||
div.quote: vātikottaravātikānāṃ punarmūlādīnāmutkvāthaiḥ sukhoṣṇaiḥ kumbhīrvarṣaṇikāḥ‘vārṣulikāḥ iti, varṣulikā’ iti ca pā. pranāḍīrvā pūrayitvā yathārhasiddhasnehābhyaktagātraṃ vastrāvacchannaṃ pariṣecayediti pariṣekaḥ

div.p: yathokta eveti lokaprasiddha eva| avagāhaḥ avagāhasvedaḥ||45||

jentākavidhimāha- athetyādi| athaśabdo maṅgale ānantarye vā| pūrvasyāmuttarasyāṃ veti grāmādbāddhavyam| guṇavatīti sasyaprarohādiyuktatvena; praśastabhūmibhāgatvaṃ tuṣāṅgārādirahitatvena| parīvāpaḥ dīrghikā| suṣṭhu upa samīpe tīrthaṃ yasya tasmin sūpatīrthe| aratniḥ hastaḥ| prāṅmukhamiti paścime, udaṅmukhamiti dakṣiṇe; evaṃ hyabhimukhaṃ tīrthaṃ bhavati| kūṭāgāramiti vartulāgāram| ākapāṭādityanena dvāraparyantaṃ lakṣayati| kiṣkuḥ hastaḥ| puruṣapramāṇamiti ūrdhvataḥ| kanduḥ kandvākārāgnisthānam| aṅgārārthaṃ koṣṭho+avakāśo vidyate yasmin so+aṅgārakoṣṭhakaḥ, sa eva stambha ityaṅgārakoṣṭhakastambhaḥ| khādirāṇāmiti pūraṇe ṣaṣṭhī| sa ityatra ‘tvaṃ’ ityadhyāhāryaṃ, jānīyā ityarthaḥ; kiṃvā, ‘jānīyāt’ iti pāṭhaḥ, uttaratrāpi ‘praveśayet’ iti pāṭhaḥ; evaṃ ca sugamam| picchā svedasyaiva picchilo bhāgaḥ| sarveṣu srotaḥsu vimuktaṃ sarvasrotovimuktam apagatavibandhastu apagatamalavibandho boddhavyaḥ| cakṣuṣoḥ paripālanārthamiti atropataptasya ‘atroṣṇataptasya’ iti pā. sahasā śītajalapraveśe śītajalaparāhata ūṣmā nayanopaghātaṃ karotītyabhiprāyaḥ| atra ca jentāke bhūmiviśeṣaparigrahajalasānnidhyādayo maṅgalārthāḥ; jalasānnidhyaṃ tu svidyamānasya darśanena dṛṣṭeḥ paripālanārthaṃ ca, tathā svedātiyogapratikriyārthaṃ kūṭāgārasya jalasānnidhye sukhena karaṇārthaṃ ca||46||
div.quote: atha jentākaṃ cikīrṣurbhūmiṃ parīkṣeta- tatra pūrvasyāṃ diśyuttarasyāṃ vā guṇavati praśaste bhūmibhāge kṛṣṇamadhuramṛttike suvarṇamṛttike vā parīvāpapuṣkariṇyādīnāṃ jalāśayānāmanyatamasya kūle dakṣiṇe paścime vā sūpatīrthe samasuvibhaktabhūmibhāge saptāṣṭau vā+aratnīrupakramyodakāt prāṅmukhamudaṅmukhaṃ vā+abhimukhatīrthaṃ kūṭāgāraṃ kārayet, utsedhavistārataḥ paramaratnīḥ ṣoḍaśa, samantāt suvṛttaṃ mṛtkarmasampannamanekavātāyanam; asya kūṭāgārasyāntaḥ samantato bhittimaratnivistārotsedhāṃ piṇḍikāṃ kārayedākapāṭāt, madhye cāsya kūṭāgārasya catuṣkiṣkumātraṃ puruṣapramāṇaṃ mṛnmayaṃ kandusaṃsthānaṃ bahusūkṣmacchidramaṅgārakoṣṭhakastambhaṃ sapidhānaṃ kārayet; taṃ ca khādirāṇāmāśvakarṇādīnāṃ vā kāṣṭhānāṃ pūrayitvā pradīpayet; sa yadā jānīyāt sādhu dagdhāni kāṣṭhāni gatadhūmānyavataptaṃ ca kevalamagninā tadagnigṛhaṃ svedayogyena coṣmaṇā yuktamiti, tatrainaṃ puruṣaṃ vātaharābhyaktagātraṃ vastrāvacchannaṃ praveśayet, praveśayaṃścainamanuśiṣyāt- saumya! praviśa kalyāṇāyārogyāya ceti, praviśya caināṃ piṇḍikāmadhiruhya pārśvāparapārśvābhyāṃ yathāsukhaṃ śayīthāḥ, na ca tvayā svedamūrcchāparītenāpi satā piṇḍikaiṣā vimoktavyā+a+aprāṇocchvāsāt, bhraśyamāno hyataḥ piṇḍivakāvakāśāddvāramanadhigacchan svedamūrcchāparītatayā sadyaḥ prāṇāñjahyāḥ, tasmāt piṇḍikāmenāṃ na kathañcana muñcethāḥ; tvaṃ yadā jānīyāḥ- vigatābhiṣyandamātmānaṃ samyakprasrutasvedapicchaṃ sarvasrotovimuktaṃ laghūbhūtamapagatavibandhastambhasuptivedanāgauravamiti, tatastāṃ piṇḍikāmanusaran dvāraṃ prapadyethāḥ, niṣkramya ca na sahasā cakṣuṣoḥ paripālanārthaṃ śītodakamupaspṛśethāḥ, apagatasantāpaklamastu muhūrtāt sukhoṣṇena vāriṇā yathānyāyaṃ pariṣikto+aśnīyāḥ; iti jentākasvedaḥ

div.p: kauravaṃ kārpāsam||47-49||-
div.quote: tasyāṃ svabhyaktasarvāṅgaḥ svapan svidyati nā sukham
kauravājinakauṣeyaprāvārādyaiḥ‘rauravājina...’ iti pā. susaṃvṛtaḥ‘sukhaṃ vṛtaḥ’ iti pā.
tasyāmupari śayyāyāṃ svapan svidyati nā sukham
div.p: karṣūḥ abhyantaravistīrṇaḥ svalpamukho gartaḥ||50-51||

anatyutsedhavistārāmiti svalpapramāṇocchrāyavistārām| alocanāṃ nirjālakām| kuṣṭhādyairiti atrādiśabdaḥ prakāravacanaḥ, tenoṣṇasugandhidravyairiti bhavati| hasantikā aṅgāradhāni(ri)kā, parivāryeti hasantikābhirityanena sambadhyate| tāmiti upakalpitaśayyāṃ kuṭīm, ārohediti sambandhaḥ||52-55||

div.quote: ardhabhāgaṃ tribhāgaṃ vā śayanaṃ tatra copari
pāṣāṇān voṣmaṇā tena tatsthaḥ svidyati nā sukham
div.p: śayanaṃ tatra coparīti atra kumbhīkopari śayanaṃ khaṭṭādi tathā kartavyaṃ yathā kumbhīkā na bhajyate| tatstha iti yathoktaśayanāsanasthaḥ||56-58||

kūpamiti kūpamiva kūpaṃ gabhīratvena| dviguṇamiti vistārādboddhavyam| vedhata ityadhaḥkhananapramāṇena| susaṃstīrṇa iti suṣṭhu saṃstīrṇe ācchādite, śayyayā khaṭvoparisthitayā ācchādite kūpe iti boddhavyam||59-60||

dhītīkāmityādinā holākasvedaḥ| dhītīkā śuṣkagomayādikṛto+agnyāśrayaviśeṣaḥ| yathoktānāmiti pūrvoktahastyaśvādibhavānām| śayanāntaḥpramāṇena dhītīkāṃ ‘kṛtvā’ ityadhyāhārya yojyam| yathoktāmiti nātisāndraparicchadām| upasaṃharati- itītyādi| sākṣādagnerguṇamuṣṇatvamāśritya svedayatītyagniguṇasaṃśrayaḥ||61-63||
div.quote: dhītīkāṃ‘dhautikāṃ’ iti pā. tu karīṣāṇāṃ yathoktānāṃ pradīpayet

div.p: sampratyanagnisvedānāha- vyāyāma ityādi| uṣṇasadanamiti agnisantāpavyatirekeṇa nirjālakatayā ghanabhittitayā ca yadgṛhaṃ svedayati tadboddhavyam| bahupānamiti bahumadyapānam| upanāho dvividhaḥ- sāgniranagniśca; tatra yaḥ sāgnirupanāhaḥ sa saṅkara eva boddhavyaḥ, yaduktaṃ- “kolaṃ kulatthāḥ suradārurāsnāḥ” (sū.a.3) ityādinā+a+aragvadhīye; yastvanagnirbahalatvena śarīroṣmarodhaṃ kṛtvā svedayati sa iha boddhavyaḥ| ātapaśca yadyapyuṣṇaḥ, tathā+apyagnikṛtaṃ tasyoṣṇatvaṃ na bhavatītyanagnisveda uktaḥ| agniguṇādṛte iti sākṣādagnisambandhena kṛtāduṣṇatvādvinā||64||-

sarvasvedamupasaṃharati- ityukta ityādi| ekāṅgagatāḥ saṅkaranāḍyādayaḥ, sarvāṅgagatāḥ prastarajentākādayaḥ| snigdho vātavihitaḥ svedaḥ| rūkṣaḥ kaphavihitaḥ| snigdharūkṣastu vātaśleṣmavihito+anayorna bhidyata iti pṛthaṅgoktaḥ| dvandvaṃ parasparaṃ viruddhaṃ yugmam||65-66||
svinnena yathā kartavyaṃ tadāha- snigdha ityādi| pathyāśano bhavedityatra yadyapi śṛṅgagrāhikayā pathyaṃ noktaṃ, tathā+api svedapravṛttiviṣayadoṣasya yat pathyaṃ tadeva boddhavyam||67||

saṅgrahe svedo yathā kāryakara iti snehapūrvaṃ prayuktenetyādi| yebhyaśca yadvidha iti vāte snigdha ityādi saṅgṛhṇāti| yatra deśe yathā yogya iti āmāśayagate vāte rūkṣapūrva ityādi| śeṣaṃ sugamam||68-71||
div.quote: tatra ślokāḥ- svedo yathā kāryakaro hito yebhyaśca yadvidhaḥ
yatra deśe yathā yogyo deśo rakṣyaśca yo yathā
saṅgraheṇa ca ṣaṭ svedāḥ svedādhyāye nidarśitāḥ
svedādhikāre yadvācyamuktametanmaharṣiṇā ‘yadvācyamuktamiti svedādhyāye yadvācyaṃ yo+artha uktaḥ, tacchiṣyaiḥ; pratipattavyaṃ, yataḥ punarvasurupadeṣṭā’ iti śivadāsasenaḥ;
ityagniveśakṛte tantre carakapratisaṃskṛte ślokasthāne svedādhyāyo nāma caturdaśo+adhyāyaḥ
div.p: iti śrīcakrapāṇidattakṛtāyāṃ carakatātparyaṭīkāyāmāyurvedadīpikākhyāyāṃ sūtrasthāne nirdeśacatuṣke svedādhyāyaścaturdaśaḥ||14||

snehasvedopapannasya saṃśodhanamanantaramityanenaivoktāt sambandhāt svedādhyāyānantaraṃ śodhanavidherabhidhāyakamupakalpanīyamāha| upakalpanīyamiti śodhanopakalpanāmadhikṛtya kṛto+adhyāya upakalpanīyaḥ||1-2||

rājña iva mātrā paricchado yasya sa rājamātraḥ| vipuladravyastu vaṇigādiḥ| parisaṅkhyāyeti jñātvā| krayaḥ paṇyam, ākrayo mūlyam| aniyameneti ‘aniyameneti kadācit samyagārabdhaṃ vyāpadyati, asamyagārabdhaṃ ca sidhyatīti’ iti śivadāsasenaḥ; samyagārabdhaṃ sidhyati vyāpadyate ca||3-4||
div.quote: iha khalu rājānaṃ rājamātramanyaṃ vā vipuladravyaṃ vamanaṃ virecanaṃ vā pāyayitukāmena bhiṣajā prāgevauṣadhapānāt sambhārā upakalpanīyā bhavanti samyakcaiva hi gacchatyauṣadhe pratibhogārthāḥ, vyāpanne cauṣadhe vyāpadaḥ parisaṅkhyāya pratīkārārthāḥ; na hi sannikṛṣṭe kāle prādurbhūtāyāmāpadi satyapi krayākraye sukaramāśu sambharaṇamauṣadhānāṃ yathāvaditi

evaṃvādinaṃ bhagavantamātreyamagniveśa uvāca- nanu bhagavan! ādāveva jñānavatā tathā pratividhātavyaṃ yathā prativihite sidhyedevauṣadhamekāntena, samyakprayoganimittā hi sarvakarmaṇāṃ siddhiriṣṭā, vyāpaccāsamyakprayoganimittā; atha samyagasamyak ca samārabdhaṃ karma siddhyati vyāpadyate vā+aniyamena, tulyaṃ bhavati jñānamajñāneneti

div.p: prayogasauṣṭhavaṃ prayogasuṣṭhutvaṃ, yathāvadupadeṣṭuṃ śakyamasmābhirasmadvidhairveti yojanā| etaditi prayogasauṣṭhavam| evamiti yathāvad| upadhārayitumiti granthena dhārayitum| pratipattumiti arthato grahītum| sūkṣmāṇītyādi sūkṣmāṇīva sūkṣmāṇi durbodhatvena; tatra doṣasyāvasthāntarāṇi- kṣayastathā vṛddhistathā samatvaṃ, evamūrdhvadehagamanaṃ tathā+adhodehagamanaṃ tiryaggamanaṃ vā, tathā śākhāśrayitvaṃ koṣṭhāśrayitvaṃ madhyamārgāśrayitvaṃ, tathā svadeśagamanaṃ paradeśagamanaṃ, tathā svatantratvaṃ paratantratvaṃ, tathāṃ+aśāṃśavikalpaḥ, tathā dhātuviśeṣāśrayitvaṃ, tathā kālaprakṛtidūṣyānuguṇatvādikṛtsnatantrapratipāditāni jñeyāni; evaṃ bheṣajasyāvasthāntarāṇi- taruṇatvaṃ, vṛddhatvam, ārdratvaṃ, śuṣkatvaṃ, dravyāntarasaṃyuktatvaṃ, svarasādikalpanāyogitvaṃ, rasavīryavipākaiḥ prabhāvaiśca tasmin dehe doṣādau tattatkāryakartṛtvamevamādīni; deśastvānūpajāṅgalasādhāraṇapraśastādibhedabhinnaḥ; kālāvasthāntarāṇi tu ṛtubhedāḥ, pūrvāhṇādiśca tathā vyādhyavasthā jvarāṣṭāhādaya ityevamādīni; balaṃ tu sahajaṃ yuktikṛtaṃ tathā kālakṛtamutkṛṣṭāpakṛṣṭamadhyādibhedabhinnaṃ; śarīraṃ tu sthūlatvakṛśatvasāravattvaniḥsāravattvādi, tathā paripālanīyadṛṣṭimarmādyavayavaviśeṣādibhiśca bhinnam; āhārastu prakṛtikaraṇasaṃyogarāśibhedādibhirbhinnaḥ; sātmyaṃ tu deśataḥ kālato vyādhitaḥ prakṛtitaḥ svabhāvato+abhyāsataśca bhinnaṃ bhavati; sattvaṃ tu bhayaśauryaviṣādaharṣādiyogabhinnaṃ bhavati; prakṛtibhedāstvanekaprakārabhinnavātādyārabdhatvena boddhavyāḥ; vayobhedāstu bālyayauvanavārdhakyatadavāntarabhedāḥ‘vārdhakyādyavasthā’; etāni doṣādyavasthāntarāṇi cikitsāprayoge yathāyathā+apekṣyante, tadudāharaṇaṃ śāstre+anusaraṇīyam, iha likhyamānaṃ tu vistaratvaṃ granthasyāvahatīti noktam| ubhayametaduttarakālaṃ siddhiṣūpadekṣyāma iti yojanā||5||
div.quote: tamuvāca bhagavānātreyaḥ- śakyaṃ tathā pratividhātumasmābhirasmadvidhairvā+apyagniveśa! yathā prativihite sidhyedevauṣadhamekāntena, tacca prayogasauṣṭhavamupadeṣṭuṃ yathāvat; nahi kaścidasti ya etadevamupadiṣṭamupadhārayitumutsaheta, upadhārya vā tathā pratipattuṃ prayoktuṃ vā; sūkṣmāṇi hi doṣabheṣajadeśakālabalaśarīrāhārasātmyasattvaprakṛtivayasāmavasthāntarāṇi, yānyanucintyamānāni vimalavipulabuddherapi buddhimākulīkuryuḥ kiṃ punaralpabuddheḥ; tasmādubhayametadyathāvadupadekṣyāmaḥ- samyakprayogaṃ cauṣadhānāṃ, vyāpannānāṃ ca vyāpatsādhanāni siddhiṣūttarakālam

idānīṃ tāvat sambhārān vividhānapi samāsenopadekṣyāmaḥ; tadyathā- dṛḍhaṃ nivātaṃ pravātaikadeśaṃ sukhapravicāramanupatyakaṃ dhūmātapajalarajasāmanabhigamanīyamaniṣṭhānāṃ ca śabdasparśarasarūpagandhānāṃ sodapānodūkhalamusalavarcaḥsthānasnānabhūmimahānasaṃ vāstuvidyākuśalaḥ praśastaṃ gṛhameva tāvat pūrvamupakalpayet
div.p: vividhānapīti apiśabdaḥ samāsenāpītyevaṃrūpo jñeyaḥ; tena gṛhādayo+api vistareṇocyante, saṅgrahaṇīyādayaśca samāseneti dvayamapi susthaṃ syāt; yadi vā ‘dvividhānapi’ iti pāṭhaḥ, tena bhogārthāni tathā vyāpatsādhanāni gṛhyante| anupatyakaṃ yad vidūramanyasya mahato gṛhasya| udakaṃ pīyate yena tadudapānam||6||

prādakṣiṇyam ānukūlyam| ullāpakaṃ stotram, itihāsaḥ ajñāyamānakartṛkāptopadeśaḥ| mṛgamātṛkā pṛthūdaro hariṇaḥ| śaraṇaṃ gṛham| ācamanīyodakoṣṭham ācamānārthamudakakoṣṭhaṃ; kiṃvā ācamyate yena pātreṇa tadācamanaṃ; maṇiko golakaḥ‘maṇati gabhīratvājjalārpaṇe śabdāyate iti maṇikaḥ’, piṭharaḥ sthālī, paryogaḥ kaṭāhaḥ, kumbho dṛḍhāvayavo+alpamukho ghaṭaḥ, kaṭaḥ tṛṇādiracitamāsanam, udañcanaṃ pidhānaśarāvaḥ, paripacanaṃ tailapācanikā| ūrṇā gaḍḍararomāṇi| suprakṣālitetyādau upadhānaḥ śilāputra iti prasiddhaḥ, dṛṣadaḥ pāṣāṇapaṭṭakāḥ| śastrāṇi copakaraṇārthānīti kuddālakartarīprabhṛtīni| kuśahastakaṃ sammārjanī; anye tu ārdradravyaparipacanamabhidadhati| mānabhāṇḍaṃ ‘mānabhāṇḍaṃ ghRūtatailādiparimāṇārthaṃ bhāṇḍam’ iti śivadāsasenaḥ; pratimānam||7||
div.quote: tataḥ śīlaśaucācārānurāgadākṣyaprādakṣiṇyopapannānupacārakuśalān sarvakarmasu paryavadātān sūpaudanapācakasnāpakasaṃvāhakotthāpakasaṃveśakauṣadhapeṣakāṃśca paricārakān sarvakarmasvapratikūlān, tathā gītavāditrollāpakaślokagāthākhyāyiketihāsapurāṇakuśalānabhiprāyajñānanumatāṃśca deśakālavidaḥ pāriṣadyāṃśca, tathā lāvakapiñjilaśaśahariṇaiṇakālapucchakamṛgamātṛkorabhrān, gāṃ dogdhrīṃ śīlavatīmanāturāṃ jīvadvatsāṃ suprativihitatṛṇaśaraṇapānīyāṃ, pātryācamanīyodakoṣṭhamaṇikaghaṭapiṭharaparyogakumbhīkumbhakuṇḍaśarāva- darvīkaṭodañcanaparipacanamanthānacarmacelasūtrakārpāsorṇādīni ca, śayanāsanādīni copanyastabhṛṅgārapratigrahāṇi suprayuktāstaraṇottarapracchadopadhānāni sopāśrayāṇi ‘saha upāśrayeṇa vartamānāni sopāśrayāṇi, upāśraya upadhānabhedaḥ’ iti yogīndranāthasenaḥ; ‘svāpāśrayāṇi’ iti pā.; saṃveśanopaveśanasnehasvedābhyaṅgapradehapariṣekānulepanavamanavirecanāsthāpanānuvāsana- śirovirecanamūtroccārakarmaṇāmupacārasukhāni, suprakṣālitopadhānāśca suślakṣṇakharamadhyamā dṛṣadaḥ, śastrāṇi copakaraṇārthāni, dhūmanetraṃ ca, bastinetraṃ cottarabastikaṃ ca, kuśahastakaṃ ca, tulāṃ ca, mānabhāṇḍaṃ ca, ghṛtatailavasāmajjakṣaudraphāṇitalavaṇendhanodakamadhusīdhusurāsauvīrakatuṣodaka- maireyamedakadadhidadhimaṇḍodasviddhānyāmlamūtrāṇi ca, tathā śāliṣaṣṭikamudgamāṣayavatilakulatthabadaramṛdvīkākāśmaryaparūṣakābhayāmalakabibhītakāni, nānāvidhāni ca snehasvedopakaraṇāni dravyāṇi, tathaivordhvaharānulomikobhayabhāñji, saṅgrahaṇīyadīpanīyapācanīyopaśamanīyavātaharādisamākhyātāni cauṣadhāni; yaccānyadapi kiñcihyāpadaḥ parisaṅkhyāya pratīkārārthamupakaraṇaṃ vidyāt, yacca pratibhogārthaṃ, tattadupakalpayet

div.p: taṃ cetyādau asminnantara iti snehasvedakaraṇasamaye| tāvantameva kālamiti yāvatā kālenāgatavyādhipraśamaḥ kṛtastāvantam| iṣṭa iti śodhanakartṛpuruṣanakṣatrādyanuguṇe auṣadhaprayogārthaṃ vihita ityarthaḥ; yaduktaṃ jyotiṣa- “puṣyo hastastathā jyeṣṭhā rohiṇī śravaṇāśvinau| svāti saumyaṃ ca bhaiṣajye kuryādanyatra varjayet” ityādi| kārayitveti svastivācanaṃ kārayitvā||8-9||
div.quote: tatastaṃ puruṣaṃ yathoktābhyāṃ snehasvedābhyāṃ yathārhamupapādayet, taṃ cedasminnantare mānasaḥ śārīro vā vyādhiḥ kaścittīvrataraḥ sahasā+abhyāgacchettameva tāvadasyopāvartayituṃ‘upaśamayituṃ’ iti pā. yateta, tatastamupāvartya tāvantamevainaṃ kālaṃ tathāvidhenaiva karmaṇopācaret

tatastaṃ puruṣaṃ snehasvedopapannamanupahatamanasamabhisamīkṣya sukhoṣitaṃ suprajīrṇabhaktaṃ śiraḥsnātamanuliptagātraṃ sragviṇamanupahatavastrasaṃvītaṃ devatāgnidvijaguruvṛddhavaidyānarcitavantamiṣṭe nakṣatratithikaraṇamuhūrte kārayitvā brāhmaṇān svastivācanaṃ prayuktābhirāśīrbhirabhimantritāṃ madhumadhukasaindhavaphāṇitopahitāṃ madanaphalakaṣāyamātrāṃ pāyayet

div.p: pratipuruṣamapekṣitavyānītyanena pratipuruṣaṃ śodhanamātrābhedaṃ darśayati| yāvaddhītyādi mātrāśitīyoktaḥ ‘yāvaddhyasyāśanaṃ’ (sū.a.5) ityādigranthavyākhyānānusāreṇa vyākhyeyam| anukāṅkṣeteti parīkṣayan dhārayet| asambādhamiti asaṅkīrṇam| pratigṛhṇantīti pratigrahaḥ patadgrahāḥ| lalāṭapratigrahādaya anapatrapaṇīyā alajjāviṣayāḥ||10-11||
div.quote: madanaphalakaṣāyamātrāpramāṇaṃ tu khalu sarvasaṃśodhanamātrāpramāṇāni ca pratipuruṣamapekṣitavyāni bhavanti; yāvaddhi yasya saṃśodhanaṃ pītaṃ vaikārikadoṣaharaṇāyopapadyate na cātiyogāyogāya, tāvadasya mātrāpramāṇaṃ veditavyaṃ bhavati

pītavantaṃ tu khalvenaṃ muhūrtamanukāṅkṣeta, tasya yadā jānīyāt svedaprādurbhāveṇa doṣaṃ pravilayanamāpadyamānaṃ, lomaharṣeṇa ca sthānebhyaḥ pracalitaṃ, kukṣisamādhmāpanena ca kukṣimanugataṃ, hṛllāsāsyasravaṇābhyāmapi cordhvamukhībhūtam, athāsmai jānusamamasambādhaṃ suprayuktāstaraṇottarapracchadopadhānaṃ sopāśrayamāsanamupaveṣṭuṃ ‘svāpāśrayaṃ’ iti gaṅgādharasammataḥ pāṭhaḥ; nidrākaraṇopayogītyarthaḥ; prayacchet, pratigrahāṃścopacārayet, lālāṭapratigrahe pārśvopagrahaṇe nābhiprapīḍane pṛṣṭhonmardane cānapatrapaṇīyāḥ suhṛdo+anumatāḥ‘anukūlāḥ’ iti pā. prayateran

athainamanuśiṣyāt- vivṛtoṣṭhatālukaṇṭho nātimahatā vyāyāmena vegānudīrṇānudīrayan kiñcidavanamya grīvāmūrdhvaśarīramupavegamapravṛttān pravartayan suparilikhitanakhābhyāmaṅgulibhyāmutpalakumudasaugandhikanālairvā kaṇṭhamabhispṛśan sukhaṃ pravartayasveti, sa tathāvidhaṃ kuryāt; tato+asya vegān pratigrahagatānavekṣetāvahitaḥ, vegaviśeṣadarśanāddhi kuśalo yogāyogātiyogaviśeṣānupalabheta, vegaviśeṣadarśī punaḥ kṛtyaṃ yathārhamavabudhyeta lakṣaṇena; tasmādvegānavekṣetāvahitaḥ
div.p: upavegaṃ vegasamīpam; etena sarvathā+apravṛtte vege pravartanaṃ niṣedhayati| vegaviśeṣadarśanāddhītyādigranthasya bhāvino yogāyogādīn vegaviṣayānupalabhya tarkayatītyarthaḥ; kiṃvā, siddhau vaigikī śuddhirabhidhātavyā “jaghanyamadhyapravare tu vegāścatvāra iṣṭā vamane ṣaḍaṣṭau” (si.a.1) ityādinā, tāmanena darśayati||12||

apravṛttiḥ kutaściditi sarvasyaivāpravṛttiḥ; tathā kevalasya kṛtsnasya śodhanīyadoṣasyāpravṛttiḥ; tathauṣadhasya vibhraṃśaḥ prātilomyena gamanaṃ; yathā- vamanasyādha ūrdhvaṃ ca virecanasya, etadeva siddhāvuktaṃ- “ayogaḥ prātilomyena nacā+alpaṃ vā pravartanam” (si. a.6) iti| kiṃvā, kutaściddhā+apravṛttiḥ stokadoṣapravṛttirityarthaḥ, tathā kevalasya cāpyauṣadhasya pravṛttiriti yojanā| yathākramamiti vamane prathamaṃ śleṣmā, tadanu pittaṃ, tadanu vāyuḥ; yaduktaṃ- “kramāt kaphaḥ pittamathānilaśca yasyaiti samyagvamitaḥ sa iṣṭaḥ” (si. a.1) iti| samyagyogo+api hartavyadoṣasyālpatvamadhyatvotkṛṣṭatvena trividho bhavatīti darśayannāha- yogena tvityādi| tuśabdo+avadhāraṇe, tena yogenaiva yaḥ pramāṇaviśeṣo+alpādistena, na tvayogātiyogābhyāmityarthaḥ; ayaṃ ca tīkṣṇādiyogavibhāgaḥ‘tīkṣṇādi vibhāgaḥ’ iti pā. peyākramotkarṣārthaḥ, tathāhi vakṣyati siddhau- “peyāṃ vilepīṃ” (si. a.1.) ityādi| tatrātiyogetyādau ādhmānādayaḥ śodhanasiddhau “bahudoṣasya rūkṣasya” (si. a.6) ityādinā granthena prapañcena vaktavyāḥ, atastatraiṣāṃ yogātiyogajanyo yaścāyogajanyaḥ sa sphuṭo jñeyaḥ||13||
div.quote: tatrāmūnyayogayogātiyogaviśeṣajñānāni bhavanti; tadyathā- apravṛttiḥ kutaścit kevalasya vā+apyauṣadhasya vibhraṃśo vibandho vegānāmayogalakṣaṇāni bhavanti; kāle pravṛttiranatimahatī vyathā yathākramaṃ doṣaharaṇaṃ svayaṃ cāvasthānamiti yogalakṣaṇāni bhavanti, yogena tu doṣapramāṇaviśeṣeṇa tīkṣṇamṛdumadhyavibhāgo jñeyaḥ; yogādhikyena tu phenilaraktacandrikopagamanamityatiyogalakṣaṇāni bhavanti

tatrātiyogāyoganimittānimānupadravān vidyāt- ādhmānaṃ parikartikā parisrāvo hṛdayopasaraṇamaṅgagraho jīvādānaṃ ‘hṛdayopasaraṇaṃ hṛdgrahaḥ, kiṃvā hṛdgrahotpādanārthaṃ hṛdaye doṣāṇāmupasaraṇam; ata eva vakṣyati- “kupitā hṛdayaṃ gatvā doṣāḥ kurvanti hṛdgraham” iti; jīvādānamiti jīvanahetudhāturūpaśoṇitanirgamaḥ, yaduktaṃ- “atiyogācca bhaiṣajyaṃ jīvaṃ harati śoṇitam; tajjīvādānamityuktamādatte jīvitaṃ yataḥ”- iti; vibhraṃśaḥ sañjñabhraṃśādirūpastrividhaḥ, sa ca siddhau vakṣyamāṇaḥ’ iti śivadāsasenaḥ; vibhraṃśaḥ stambhaḥ klamaścetyupadravāḥ

div.p: snaihikādidhūmapānavikalpaḥ puruṣaprakṛtyapekṣaḥ; ata eva sāmarthyata ityuktaṃ, yadyasya yujyata ityarthaḥ| atisthānamiti atyarthaṃ daṇḍāyamānatvenāvasthitiḥ| pramitabhojanam ekarasābhyāsaḥ| atihīnaṃ naṣṭaśaktikaṃ dhānyādi| guruśabdena svabhāvagurulaṭṭukacipiṭakāderyathoktamātrayā+api bhojananiṣedhaḥ||14-15||
div.quote: yogena tu khalvenaṃ charditavantamabhisamīkṣya suprakṣālitapāṇipādāsyaṃ muhūrtamāśvāsya, snaihikavairecanikopaśamanīyānāṃ dhūmānāmanyatamaṃ sāmarthyataḥ‘sāmarthyaṃ yogyatā’ iti śivadāsasenaḥ pāyayitvā, punarevodakamupasparśayet

upaspṛṣṭodakaṃ cainaṃ nivātamāgāramanupraveśya saṃveśya cānuśiṣyāt- uccairbhāṣyamatyāśanamatisthānamaticaṅkramaṇaṃ krodhaśokahimātapāvaśyāyātipravātān yānayānaṃ grāmyadharmamasvapanaṃ niśi divā svapnaṃ viruddhājīrṇāsātmyākālapramitātihīnaguruviṣamabhojanavegasandhāraṇodīraṇamiti bhāvānetānmanasā+apyasevamānaḥ sarvamaho gamayasveti ‘sarvamāhāramadyāḥ’ iti pā.;

div.p: sāyāhna ityādau samyagagniśuddhilakṣaṇabhūte sāyāhne, kiñcittvaviśuddhāvapare+ahni| yaduktaṃ siddhau- “vamitaṃ laṅghayet samyagjīrṇaliṅgānyavekṣayan| tāni dṛṣṭvā tu peyādikramaṃ kuryānna laṅghanam” (si. a.6) iti| maṇḍapūrvāṃ maṇḍapradhānām| ayaṃ ca dvādaśakālanivartanīyaḥ kramaḥ pradhānaśuddhiśuddhe jñeyaḥ, madhye tvaṣṭānukālikaḥ, tathā+alpe caturanukālikaḥ; uktaṃ hi- “peyāṃ vilepīṃ” (si. a.1) ityādi| annaguṇān madhurādīn gurukaṭhinādīṃśca| etacca saṃsarjanakramādūrdhvaṃ saptarātreṇa prakṛtibhojanagamanaṃ tadā kartavyaṃ yadi vamanānantaraṃ virecanaṃ na kartavyaṃ bhavati, tatkaraṇe tu saṃsarjanakramādūrdhvameva snehapānaṃ; yaduktaṃ- “saṃsṛṣṭabhaktaṃ navame+ahni sarpistaṃ pāyayedvā+apyanuvāsayedvā” (si. a.1) iti| tathā suśrute+apyuktaṃ- “pakṣādvireko vāntasya” (su.ci. a.36) iti| yadi saṃsarjanakramaṃ tathā+anuguṇābhyāsaṃ ca kṛtvā snehaḥ kriyate, tadā pakṣādvireko vāntasya na syāt||16||
div.quote: athainaṃ sāyāhne pare vā+ahni sukhodakapariṣiktaṃ purāṇānāṃ lohitaśālitaṇḍulānāṃ svavaklinnāṃ maṇḍapūrvāṃ sukhoṣṇāṃ yavāgūṃ pāyayedagnibalamabhisamīkṣya, evaṃ dvitīye tṛtīye cānnakāle, caturthe tvannakāle tathāvidhānāmeva śālitaṇḍulānāmutsvinnāṃ vilepīmuṣṇodakadvitīyāmasnehalavaṇāmalpasnehalavaṇāṃ vā bhojayet, evaṃ pañcame ṣaṣṭhe cānnakāle, saptame tvannakāle tathāvidhānāmeva śālīnāṃ dviprasṛtaṃ susvinnamodanamuṣṇodakānupānaṃ tanunā tanusnehalavaṇopapannena mudgayūṣeṇa bhojayet, evamaṣṭame navame cānnakāle, daśame tvannakale lāvakapiñjalādīnāmanyatamasya māṃsarasenaudakalāvaṇikena ‘audakalāvaṇikenodakalavaṇābhyāṃ saṃskṛtena’ iti śivadāsasenaḥ; nātisāravatā bhojayeduṣṇodakānupānam; evamekādaśe dvādaśe cānnakāle; ata ūrdhvamannaguṇān krameṇopabhuñjānaḥ saptarātreṇa prakṛtibhojanamāgacchet

athainaṃ punareva snehasvedābhyāmupapādyānupahatamanasamabhisamīkṣya sukhoṣitaṃ suprajīrṇabhaktaṃ kṛtahomabalimaṅgalajapaprāyaścittamiṣṭe tithinakṣatrakaraṇamuhūrte brāhmaṇān svasti vācayitvā trivṛtkalkamakṣamātraṃ yathārhāloḍanaprativinītaṃ pāyayet prasamīkṣya doṣabheṣajadeśakālabalaśarīrāhārasātmyasattvaprakṛtivayasāmavasthāntarāṇi vikārāṃśca, samyak viriktaṃ cainaṃ vamanoktena dhūmavarjena vidhinopapādayedābalavarṇaprakṛtilābhāt, balavarṇopapannaṃ cainamanupahatamanasamabhisamīkṣya sukhoṣitaṃ suprajīrṇabhaktaṃ śiraḥsnātamanuliptagātraṃ sragviṇamanupahatavastrasaṃvītamanurūpālaṅkārālaṅkṛtaṃ suhṛdāṃ darśayitvā jñātīnāṃ darśayet, athainaṃ kāmeṣvavasṛjet
bhavanti cātra- anena vidhinā rājā rājamātro+athavā punaḥ
yasya vā vipulaṃ dravyaṃ sa saṃśodhanamarhati
div.p: athainamiti kṛtasaṃsarjanakramam| prativinītam āloḍitam| doṣādayaḥ pūrvavadvyākhyeyāḥ| vikārāṃśceti kuṣṭhajvarādīn virecanasādhyān; pūrvaṃ tu “sūkṣmāṇi hi” ityādau vikāro noktaḥ, tasya parīkṣyatvenaiva grahaṇāt; kiṃvā doṣagrahaṇenaiva tatra vikāragrahaṇam| kāmeṣu īpsiteṣu, avasṛjet niryantraṇaṃ kuryāt||17-18||

div.quote: na hi sarvamanuṣyāṇāṃ santi sarve paricchadāḥ
na ca rogā na bādhante daridrānapi dāruṇāḥ
div.p: samprati daridrasya yathoktaṃ sambhāramakṛtvā+api saṃśodhanakaraṇamāha- daridra ityādi| durlabhāniti vacanena sulabhāni daridreṇā+apyutpādanīyāni||19-21||
saṃśodhanakaraṇaguṇamāha- malāpahamityādi||22||

div.quote: tatra ślokāḥ- īśvarāṇāṃ vasumatāṃ vamanaṃ savirecanam
sambhārā ye yadarthaṃ ca samānīya prayojayet
yathā prayojyā mātrā yā yadayogasya lakṣaṇam
div.p: saṅgrahe- īśvarāḥ savilāsāḥ; tena rājño rājamātrasya ca grahaṇam| prayojayediti ‘sambhārān’ iti śeṣaḥ||23-25||

div.quote: ityagniveśakṛte tantre carakapratisaṃskṛte ślokasthāne upakalpanīyo nāma pañcadaśo+adhyāyaḥ
div.p: iti śrīcakrapāṇidattaviracitāyāṃ carakatātparyaṭīkāyāmāyurvedadīpikāyāṃ sūtrasthāne nirdeśacatuṣke pañcadaśo+adhyāyaḥ||15||

pūrvādhyāyoktavamanavirecanayorvistareṇa samyagyogādilakṣaṇaṃ, tathā tatpravṛttiviṣayabahudoṣapuruṣādyabhidhātuṃ cikitsāprābhṛtīyo+abhidhīyate| cikitsā prabhṛtarūpā sadā yatnena āturopaḍhaukanīyatvena ca yasya vidyate sa cikitsāprābhṛtīyaḥ||1-2||

yogāt samyagyogāt| sukham ārogyam| virecayatītyatra vāmayatītyapi boddhavyaṃ, virecanaśabdasya vamane+api pravṛtteḥ| so+atiyogādityādi| duḥkhaṃ vikāraṃ; yaduktaṃ- “vikāro duḥkhameva tu” (sū. 9)| nanu vamanādau kasmānmithyāyogo nocyate, yāvatā yasya vastuna ucito yogaḥ sa yogaḥ, tasya svalpo vā yogaḥ sarvathā vā ayogo ayoga ucyate, tasyaivātimātrayogo vikārakaro+atiyogaḥ, anucitasambandhena tu vastuno mithyāyogaḥ; tenehāpyutkliṣṭaśleṣmādidharmaprayukte puruṣe virecanaṃ sarvathā+ayaugikameva, tacca prayuktaṃ pratīpagamanenaiva yāti, virecane mithyāyogo+ayamucitaḥ, evaṃ vamanādiṣvapi jñeyam| naivam, evambhūtamithyāyogasyāyogenaiva grahaṇāt, uktaṃ hi- “prātilomyena doṣāṇāṃ haraṇātte hyakṛtsnaśaḥ| ayogasañjñe kṛcchreṇa yadā gacchati cālpaśaḥ” (si. 6) iti| duṣṭavirecanauṣadhasya rasanayopayujyamānasya hīnamātratvātimātratvābhyāṃ vinā yadvyādhikaraṇatvaṃ tanmithyāyogādeva paraṃ bhavati; yaduktaṃ tisraiṣaṇīye- “mithyāyogo rāśivarjeṣvāhāravidhiviśeṣāyataneṣūpadekṣyate” (sū. 11) iti| satyaṃ bheṣajasya mithyāyogo+ayaṃ, vamanasya tu doṣaharaṇarūpasyāyoga iti; evaṃ ca virecanādāvapi jñeyam| yadyapyatrāpi mithyāyogaḥ kathañcit pāryate kalpayituṃ, tathā+api prayojanaśūnyatvādācāryeṇa pṛthaṅna kṛtaḥ, śabdādiṣu tu mithyāyogināṃ sambandhamātrasyāpi parihārārthaṃ pṛthakkṛta iti||3-4||
div.quote: naraṃ virecayati yaṃ sa yogāt sukhamaśnute

div.p: daurbalyamityādīni virecanasya samyagyuktāyuktātiyuktasya lakṣaṇāni| adaurbalyaṃ sthaulyānapagamaḥ'sthaulyānapacayaḥ' iti pā.| yathākramamiti paṭhan krameṇaiveti darśayati; yaduktaṃ- “prāptiśca viṭpittakaphānilānāṃ samyagviriktasya bhavet krameṇa” (si. 1) iti| āgatānāṃ paramūrdhvamiti yojanā||5-10||

atiyogalakṣaṇaṃ vamane+atidiśati- vamana ityādi| vamanātiyoge viṭpittakaphavātānāmiti na yojanīyaṃ, yena vamanaprayoge kaphapittānilāgamarūpaḥ kramo bhavet| yaduktaṃ- “kramāt kaphaḥ pittamathānilaśca yasyaiti samyagvamitiḥ sa iṣṭaḥ” (si. a. 1) iti||11-12||
div.quote: yuñjyād ya enamatyantamāyuṣā ca sukhena ca
balaṃ puṣṭirapatyaṃ ca vṛṣatā cāsya jāyate
div.p: saṃśodhanaviṣayabahudoṣalakṣaṇamāha- avipāka ityādi| anāyāsakṛtaḥ śramaḥ klamaḥ; śramastviha svalpenāyāsena jñeyaḥ| avasādako mano+avasādaḥ| nidrānāśo vātapradhānena doṣeṇa; atinidratā śleṣmapradhānena||13-19||

samūladoṣāpahārakatvaṃ'samūladoṣāpahārakatvena' iti pā. saṃśodhanasya, laṅghanapācanayostu doṣāpaharatve satyapi na saṃśodhanavaddoṣahantṛtvamityāha- doṣā ityādi| kadāciditi anyahetuprāptyā| na teṣāṃ punarudbhava iti balavaddoṣakāraṇatvaṃ vineti mantavyam| ukte+arthe dṛṣṭāntamāha- doṣāṇāmityādi| laṅghanapācanābhyāṃ rogakāraṇībhūtadoṣaprakopaharaṇamātre kṛte rogo yo nivṛttaḥ sa mūlabhūtāśayavyavasthitadoṣānucchedādyatkiñcidanuguṇakālādiprāptyā punaḥ kupitadoṣeṇa bhavatīti bhāvaḥ||20-21||
div.quote: jitāḥ saṃśodhanairye tu na teṣāṃ punarudbhavaḥ
doṣāṇāṃ ca drumāṇāṃ ca mūle+anupahate sati
tathā sa labhate śarma yujyate cāyuṣā ciram
div.p: samprati śodhanena yathā doṣakṣayastathā dhātukṣayo+api bhavati, tena tatra pratīkāramāha- bheṣajetyādi| āhāraireveti evāvadhāraṇe; tena bheṣajena bṛṃhaṇaṃ niṣedhati, bheṣajasya vīryapradhānasya tadā duḥsahatvāt| sānuvāsanairityatra cakāro boddhavyaḥ, tenābhyaṅgādibhiśca bṛṃhaṇaṃ pathyam||22-23||

div.quote: snehane svedane śuddhau rogāḥ saṃsarjane ca ye
div.p: atiyogādicikitsāmāha- atiyogetyādi| smaran pūrvamanukramamityanena yaḥ pūrvamayoge hetubhūtastaṃ pariharanniti śikṣayati| amārgavihite avidhivihite| sādhanamityatra ‘vakṣyate’ iti śeṣaḥ||24-26||

samprati yadetat siddhau vakṣyamāṇaṃ rogāṇaṃ sādhanaṃ tadanuṣaṅgeṇa ca sarvabheṣajānāmeva kṣaṇabhaṅgibhāve pakṣe+api rogaśamakatvaṃ pratipādayituṃ prakaraṇamārabhate- jāyanta ityādi| teṣāmiti viṣamāṇāṃ dhātūnāṃ samānāṃ ca| svabhāvāt vināśakāraṇanirapekṣāduparamo vināśaḥ svabhāvoparamaḥ| sadeti avilambena; tenotpannamātrā eva vinaśyantītyarthaḥ||27||
div.quote: jāyante 'samprati rogāṇāṃ kṣaṇikatvena yadupaśamārthaṃ cikitsābhidhānaṃ tanniṣphalamiti saugatapakṣe cikitsāyāḥ prayojakatvamabhidhātuṃ tanmatamupanyasyati- jāyanta ityādi'; iti śivadāsasenaḥ; hetuvaiṣamyādviṣamā dehadhātavaḥ

div.p: atraivārthe upapattimāha- pravṛttītyādi| pravṛttihetuḥ utpattiheturbhāvānāmasti, nirodhe vināśe heturbhāvānāṃ kāraṇaṃ nāsti; yasmāt sarva eva bhāvāḥ pradīpārcirvadutpattau kāraṇāpekṣiṇaḥ, vināśe tu dvitīyakṣaṇāvidyamānatvalakṣaṇe sahajasiddhe na hetvantaramapekṣante; yato na svābhāvikarūpe hetvantarāpekṣā bhavati, nahyutpannaḥ khaṅgaḥ svābhāvike lauhamayatve kāraṇāntaramapekṣate; tadevaṃ sarveṣāmeva bhāvānāṃ svābhāvike nāśe viṣamadhātūnāmapi'dehadhātūnāmapi' iti pā. nāśaḥ svābhāvika eveti bhāvaḥ| vyādhipraśame ca cikitsāpekṣakaṃ pakṣāntaramāha- kecidityādi| tatrāpi vināśe+api, hetuṃ kāraṇaṃ, hetoravartanamiti utpādakahetorabhāvaṃ, manyanta iti yojanā| evamapi hetuparamparāyāḥ kṣaṇikatvena tatkāryāṇāmapi svabhāvādeva nityaṃ sannihitasvahetuvināśarūpavināśahetūnāṃ '...svahetuvināśahetūnāṃ iti, ...sahetuvināśahetūnāṃ' iti ca pā.; na vināśahetucikitsāpekṣeti bhāvaḥ||28||
div.quote: kecittatrāpi'kecittvatrāpi' iti pā. manyante hetuṃ hetoravartanam

div.p: evamutthitāyāṃ śaṅkāyāṃ guruṃ pṛcchati- evamityādi| kimiti ākṣepe| karma sādhyaṃ; svabhāvoparame sati na kimapi sādhyaṃ paśyāmīti 'tasyāstītyarthaḥ' iti pā. bhāvaḥ| kān samīkurute iti viṣamāṇāmasthiratvena sāmyaṃ tatra kartuṃ na pāryata ityāśayaḥ| kā vā cikitseti rogapraśamaṃ pratyakāraṇatvena cikitsā nāstītyarthaḥ| kimarthaṃ vā prayujyata iti yannivṛttyarthaṃ cikitsā prayujyate taddhātuvaiṣamyaṃ svata eva nivṛttamiti'svabhāvānnivṛttamiti' iti pā. cikitsāprayojanaṃ nāsti||29-30||
div.quote: kā vā cikitsā bhagavan! kimarthaṃ vā prayujyate

div.p: pūrvoktahetuvināśaṃ dṛṣṭāntena hetumantamāha- na nāśetyādi| bhāvānāṃ nāśakāraṇaṃ na jñāyate, tat kimabhāvādeva, yathā- śaśaviṣāṇam, uta vā jñānāyogyatvāt pṛthivyāṃ nikhātamūlakīlakādivat sadapi na jñāyate, ityāha- nāśakāraṇābhāvāditi; na jñānāyogyatvena, kintarhyabhāvādevetyarthaḥ| atra dṛṣṭāntamāha- nityagasyetyādi| nimeṣādirūpatvena nityagasya| evaṃ manyate- nityagaḥ kālo yathā vinaśvaratvena na hetvantaraṃ vināśe+apekṣate, tathā sarva eva bhāvāḥ; yaddhi yasya hetvantarāpekṣaṃ na tasya tadavaśyambhāvi, yathā- paṭasya rāgaḥ; hetvantarāpekṣī cedvināśaḥ syāt, nāvaśyambhāvī syāt; etadviparyayāccānapekṣatvaṃ vināśasya siddham| sampratyahetuko vināśa utpattyanantarameva bhavati, paścādasthiratvena saṃskārādhānamapi bhāveṣu na pāryate kartumityāha- śīghragatvādityādi| yathā bhūta iti yādṛśa utpannaḥ, tatheti tādṛśa eva vipadyate; kutaḥ? śīghragatvāt asthiratvāt||31-32||

pūrvasādhitamahetuvināśitvaṃ tathā śīghragatvahetusādhitaṃ cāsaṃskāryatvamupasaṃharati- nirodha ityādi| tasyeti bhāvasya| anyathākriyā anyathākaraṇaṃ, saṃskārādhānamiti yāvat; etena viṣame dhātau sāmyaṃ saṃskāra ādhīyatāmityevaṃrūpā+api cikitsā nirastā mantavyā||33||

evaṃ vyavasthite pūrvākṣiptaṃ cikitsitaṃ samādadhati- yābhirityādi| ‘sā cikitsā’ ityanena ‘kā vā cikitsā’ ityākṣepaḥ parihṛtaḥ| ‘karma tad’ ityanena prathamoddiṣṭa ākṣepaḥ parihṛtaḥ| ‘ityarthaṃ kriyate kriyā’ ityanena ‘kimarthaṃ vā’ ityākṣepaḥ parihṛtaḥ| ‘kān samīkurute’ ityākṣepastu ‘samaistu hetubhiryasmād’ ityādinā parihṛtaḥ| viṣameṣu dhātuṣu yābhiḥ kriyābhiḥ sāmā dhātavo janyante sā cikitsā| evaṃ manyate- yadyapi dhātuvaiṣamyaṃ kṣaṇikatvena vinaśvaraṃ, tathā+api vinaśyadapi taddhātuvaiṣamyaṃ svakāryaṃ viṣamameva dhātumārabhate, evaṃ so+apyaparaṃ viṣamamiti asyāgre 'kṣaṇabhaṅgavādinā+apyabhyupeyaṃ' iti śivadāsasenavyākhyāyāmadhikaḥ pāṭha upalabhyate; na dhātuvaiṣamyasantānanivṛttirdhātusāmyajanakahetuṃ vinā; yadā tu dhātusāmyaheturupayukto bhavati, tadā tena sahitaṃ vaiṣamyasantatipatitamapi kāraṇaṃ samameva dhātusantānamārabhate, yathā- mudgaraprahārasahito ghaṭaparamāṇusantāno visadṛśaṃ kapālasantānamārabhate; evaṃ vyavasthite ‘kathaṃ śarīre’ ityādigrantho vyākhyeyaḥ| vaiṣamyaṃ na bhavet notpadyata ityarthaḥ| samānāṃ cānubandha iti santatyotpādaḥ| viṣamā nānubadhnantīti hetvabhāvādviṣamasantānasyotpādo na bhavati| samānāṃ copasevanāditi samahetūnāṃ sevanāt||34-36||
div.quote: yābhiḥ 'yadyapyuktakṣaṇabhaṅgavādimatametadaprāmāṇikaṃ, tathā tannirākaraṇamanatiprayojanamityupekṣya tuṣyatu durjana iti tanmate+api cikitsitasya prayojakatvaṃ samarthayati- yābhirityādi; etena yadyapi viṣamā dhātavaḥ kṣaṇikatvenaiva vinaśyanti tathā+api samadhātūtpattau cikitsitaṃ kṣaṇabhaṅgināmapyabhyupeyaṃ, yatastanmate+api utpattau hetvapekṣā vidyata eveti bhāvaḥ' iti śivadāsasenaḥ; kriyābhirjāyante śarīre dhātavaḥ samāḥ
sā cikitsā vikārāṇāṃ karma tadbhiṣajāṃ smṛtam
kathaṃ śarīre dhātūnāṃ vaiṣamyaṃ na bhavediti

div.p: dehasukhāyuṣāṃ dānāt dharmādīnāṃ dātā bhavati, dehasampattisādhyatvāddharmādīnāmiti bhāvaḥ||37-38||

saṅgrahe siddhisaṃśrayaṃ ca vyāpattisaṃśrayaṃ ca siddhivyāpattisaṃśrayaṃ; tatra siddhisaṃśrayaṃ siddhisthānasaṃśrayeṇa 'siddhisamānasaṃśrayeṇa' iti pā.; 'siddhisaṃśrayaṃ bheṣajakṣapita ityādinoktaṃ' iti yogīndranāthasenaḥ; , vyāpattisaṃśrayaṃ ‘atiyogānubaddhānāṃ’ ityādinoktam||39-41||
div.quote: yā ca yuktiścikitsāyāṃ yaṃ cārthaṃ kurute bhiṣak

div.p: iti śrīcakrapāṇidattaviracitāyāṃ carakatātparyaṭīkāyāmāyurvedadīpikāyāṃ sūtrasthāne caturthe kalpanācatuṣke cikitsāprābhṛtīyo nāma ṣoḍaśo+adhyāyaḥ||16||
div.quote: ityagniveśakṛte tantre carakapratisaṃskṛte ślokasthāne cikitsāprābhṛtīyo nāma ṣoḍaśo+adhyāyaḥ

div.p: pūrvacatuṣkacatuṣṭayena bheṣajamabhihitaṃ, samprati tadviṣayarogābhidhānārthaṃ rogacatuṣko+abhidhātavyaḥ, cikitsā ca vidheyatvenaiva pradhānamataḥ prathamamuktā, kiñca darśitaścāyaṃ prathamādhyāya eva sambandhaḥ, evaṃ cāṅgeṣu marmasu ca pradhānabhūtaśirohṛdayarogābhidhāyakatvena kiyantaḥ śirasīyo+abhidhīyate||1-2||

kṣayasthānavṛddhayo doṣamānaṃ, tasya vikalpo doṣāntarasambandhāsambandhakṛto bhedaḥ| mādhumehikā ityatra madhumehaśabdaḥ sāmānyena pramehavacanaḥ| yato+atraiva sāmānyena brūte- “vinā pramehamapyetā jāyante duṣṭamedasaḥ” iti; anyathā hi ‘vinā madhumehaṃ’ iti kṛtaṃ syāt; tathā cikitsite vakṣyati sāmānyenaiva yat- “pramehiṇāṃ yāḥ piḍakā mayoktā rogādhikāre pṛthageva sapta” (ci. 6) ityādi| tathā madhumehapiḍakānāṃ cikitsitopadeśācca sarvamehabhavatvaṃ piḍakānāṃ, madhumehabhavatve hi madhumehasyaivāsādhyatvānna tadbhavapiḍakānāmupakramaṇīyatvamasti; kiñca pradeśāntare+api madhumehaśabdenāyaṃ sarvapramehānuktavān, yathā- “gulmī ca madhumehī ca rājayakṣmī ca yo naraḥ| acikitsyā bhavantyete balamāṃsaparikṣaye” (iṃ. 9) iti| atra hi yadi vātiko madhumeho+abhipretaḥ syāttadā tasya svarūpata evāsādhyatvena ‘balamāṃsaparikṣaye sati’ iti viśeṣaṇamanarthakaṃ syāt| suśrutenāpi ca sāmānyena pramehe evaitāḥ piḍakā darśitāḥ, yaduktaṃ- “tatra vasāmedobhyāmabhipannaśarīrasya tribhirdoṣaiścānugatadhātoḥ pramehiṇo daśa piḍakā jāyante” (su. ni. 6) ityādi| sarva eva pramehā yasmāddehaṃ madhurīkṛtya jāyante tasmānmadhumehā ityucyante, vacanaṃ hi- “ṣaṭpadapippīlikābhiśca śarīramūtrābhisaraṇam” (ni. 4) iti, tathā ca vāgbhaṭaḥ- “madhuraṃ yacca sarveṣu prāyo madhviva mehati| sarve hi madhumehākhyā mādhuryācca tanorataḥ” (vā. ni. 10) iti| vistarata iti śṛṇvityanena sambadhyate||3-7||
div.quote: kiyantaḥ śirasi proktā rogā hṛdi ca dehinām
kṣayāḥ kati samākhyātāḥ piḍakāḥ kati cānagha!
pṛṣṭavānasi yat saumya! tanme śṛṇu savistaram
daśāṣṭau ca kṣayāḥ sapta piḍakā mādhumehikāḥ
doṣāṇāṃ trividhā coktā gatirvistarataḥ 'gatirvakṣyāmi vistaram’ iti pā.; śṛṇu
