div.p: vamanavirecanaśabdārthaṃ vibhajate- tatretyādi| ūrdhvaṃ mukhena doṣanirharaṇaṃ bhajata iti ūrdhvabhāgam| adho gudena doṣanirharaṇaṃ bhajata iti adhobhāgam| vamanavirecanayorapi kadācidvirecanasañjñāṃ ṣaḍvirecanaśatāśritīyoktāṃ darśayannāha- ubhayamapītyādi| na caivaṃ sati vamanavirecanavannirūhe+api virecanasañjñāprasaktirudbhāvanīyā‘sambhāvanīyā’ iti pā., yataḥ paṅkajaśabdavadiyaṃ virecanasañjñā vamanavirecanayoreva yogarūḍhyā vartate||4||
div.quote: tatra doṣaharaṇamūrdhvabhāgaṃ vamanasañjñakam, adhobhāgaṃ virecanasañjñakam; ubhayaṃ vā śarīramalavirecanādvirecanasañjñāṃ labhate

div.p: samprati dvayorapi vamanavirecanadravyayoḥ sādhāraṇoṣṇatīkṣṇatvādiguṇayogakṛtadoṣaviṣyandanādisādhāraṇakāryadarśanapūrvakamagnivāyvātmakatvādiviśiṣṭadharmayogakṛtaṃ viśiṣṭaṃ ca kāryaṃ vamanavirecanarūpaṃ darśayannāha- tatroṣṇetyādi| uṣṇamiti uṣṇavīryam| svavīryeṇeti svaprabhāveṇa| dhamanīranusṛtyeti sakaladehagatā dhamanīranusṛtya; sakaladehagatadhamanyanusaraṇaṃ ca vīryeṇa jñeyaṃ, na sākṣāt| āgneyatvādviṣyandayantīti vilīnaṃ kurvanti| vicchindanti chinnaṃ kurvanti| pariplavan itastato gacchan| asajjanniti na kvacidapi saṅgaṃ gacchan| aṇupravaṇabhāvāditi aṇutvāt pravaṇabhāvācca; pravaṇatvamiha koṣṭhagamanonmukhatvam, aṇutvaṃ ca aṇumārgasañcāritvam| udānapraṇunna iti udānavāyupreritaḥ| agnivāyvātmakatvāditi agnivāyūtkarṣavattvāt| ūrdhvabhāgaprabhāvāditi ūrdhvabhāgadoṣaharatvarūpaprabhāvāt| evaṃ salilapṛthivyātmakatvamapi vyākhyeyam| ubhayataśceti ūrdhvamadhaśca kṣipyata ityarthaḥ| ubhayaguṇatvāditi agnivāyvātmakatvāt salilapṛthivyātmakatvādūrdhvādhobhāgaprabhāvāccetyarthaḥ| iti lakṣaṇoddeśa iti anantaragranthena vamanavirecanadravyasvarūpābhidhānaṃ ‘vamanavirecanataddravyasvarūpābhidhānaṃ’ iti pā. kṛtamityarthaḥ| atra ca prakaraṇe sāmānyenaiva vamanavirecanadravyāṇām ‘āgneyatvādviṣyandayanti’ ityanenāgneyatvaṃ pratipāditaṃ; punaśca viśeṣeṇa ‘agnivāyvātmakatvāt’ iti padena vamanadravyasyāgnyātmakatvaṃ pratipādyate; tena, sāmānye viśeṣe ca vamanadravyāṇāmāgneyatvapratipādanāt prakṛṣṭamāgneyatvaṃ bhavati; virecanadravyāṇāṃ tu sāmānyoktāgneyatvasambandhād viśeṣaguṇakathanaprastāve ca salilapṛthivyātmakatvābhidhānādvamanadravyāpekṣayā+apakṛṣṭamāgneyatvaṃ bhavati| tathāhi suśrute+api vamanavirecanayorapyāgneyatvamuktaṃ- “saratva-saukṣmya-taikṣṇyauṣṇya-vikāśitvairvirecanam| vamanaṃ ca hareddoṣān prakṛtyā gatamanyathā” (su.ci.a.33) ityanena| yaccātrocyate-vamanaṃ yadyūrdhvabhāgaharatvaprabhāvādūrdhvayati, tadā+agnivāyvātmakatvāditi hetuvarṇanaṃ na yujyate; yataḥ, yat sopapattikaṃ kāryaṃ na bhavati tat prabhāvakṛtamiti vyapadiśyate; uktaṃ hi- “prabhāvo+acintya ucyate” (sū.a.26) iti| tanna, yataḥ prabhāvasyaiveha vamanakārye vāyvagnyātmakaguṇatayā vāyvagnyātmakatvaṃ heturupadṛ(di)śyate, na tu vāyvagnyātmakatvaṃ svatantro vamanahetuḥ; tathāhi sati yadanyadapi vāyvagnyātmakamūrdhvabhāgadoṣaharatvaprabhāvarahitaṃ, tadapi vamanakaraṃ ‘vamanaṃ’ iti pā. syāt; yathā- kaṭukarase dravye tat syāt; tasmāt prabhāvaguṇatayaiva hetuvarṇanam| evaṃ virecanadravye+api pūrvapakṣasiddhāntāvanusartavyau||5||
div.quote: tatroṣṇa-tīkṣṇa-sūkṣma-vyavāyi-vikāśīnyauṣadhāni svavīryeṇa hṛdayamupetya dhamanīranusṛtya sthūlāṇusrotobhyaḥ kevalaṃ śarīragataṃ doṣasaṅghātamāgneyatvād viṣyandayanti, taikṣṇyād vicchindanti, sa vicchinnaḥ pariplavan‘pariplavaḥ’ iti pā. snehabhāvite kāye snehāktabhājanasthamiva kṣaudramasajjannaṇupravaṇabhāvādāmāśayamāgamyodānapraṇunno+agnivāyvātmakatvādūrdhvabhāgaprabhāvādauṣadhasyordhvamutkṣipyate, salilapṛthivyātmakatvādadhobhāgaprabhāvāccauṣadhasyādhaḥ pravartate, ubhayataścobhayaguṇatvāt

div.p: samprati kalpasthānavaktavyatayā ṣaḍvirecanaprayogaśatānyanatisaṅkṣepavistaraprayogopadarśanapūrvakaṃ pratijānīte- tatra phaletyādinā ṣaḍvirecanayogaśatāni vyākhyāsyāma ityantena| tatra kṛtavedhanāntānāṃ vicchedapāṭhena vamanaprayogaprayojyatvaṃ, śyāmādīnāṃ virecanaprayogaprayojyatvaṃ ca darśayati| atraiva vamane virecane caikaikeṣāṃ punarvastūnāṃ madanaphalādīnāṃ śyāmādīnāṃ ca bahavaḥ prayogā abhidhīyante, na punarekaikameva dravyaṃ vamanakārakaṃ virecanakārakaṃ vā; svalpasaṅkhyāprayogeṇa grahaṇasukhatā vamanavirecanayogasya bhavati, kāryaṃ ca sidhyatītyāśaṅkyāha- nānāvidhetyādi yāvadrogāvasthādīnāṃ nānāprabhāvavattvācceti| asyārthaḥ- yasmānnānāvidhadeśakālasambhavāḥ, nānāvidhāsvādāḥ, nānāvidhavīryāḥ, nānāvidhavipākāḥ, nānāvidhaprabhāvāśca madanaphalādikā oṣadhyaḥ, tathā tatsaṃskārakāḥ kovidārādikā oṣadhya upalabhyante; puruṣāśca deha-doṣa-prakṛti-vayo-balāgni-bhakti-sātmya-rogāvasthābhinnā nānāvidhā dṛśyante; tena naikaṃ dravyaṃ sarvasmin dehadoṣādau yaugikaṃ, sarvatra kāle vā prāpyate sarvatra deśe vā; tasmāddehadoṣādinā bhedavati puruṣe bahūnyeva dravyāṇi bahubhiśca prayogairupakalpitāni yathāyogyatayā yathāprāpti ca prayoktuṃ śakyante; ato bahunāmeva madanādidravyāṇāṃ bahuprakāraprayogāṇāmupanyāso yukta iti bhāvaḥ| grahaṇāt upalambhāt| deho nānā sthūlakṛśādibhedena, bhaktiḥ icchā, avasthāśabdeneha rogāvasthaiva grāhyā, ādiśabdeneha sattvāhārayorgrahaṇam| bhūrivirecanaprayogopadarśanaprayojanāntaramapyāha- vicitretyādi| nānāvidhagandha-varṇa-rasatayā prayoge tatkālamuttarakālaṃ ca sukhārthamityarthaḥ| atha kiṃ prabhedānmadanaphalādīnāṃ ṣaṭprayogaśatāni bhavanti, yenādhikāḥ prayogā nābhidhīyanta‘yena nādhikyaṃ prayogāṇāmabhidhīyate’ iti pā. ityāśaṅkyāha- asaṅkhyeyetyādi| vikalpamārgopadarśanārthamiti adhikaprayogakalpanāsamarthān bhiṣajaḥ prati etat ṣaṭprayogaśatopadarśanaṃ kartavyādhikaprayogakalpanāmārgopadarśakaṃ, tenāpare+apyatra prayogāḥ kalpanīyāḥ; granthe niḥśeṣaprayogānabhidhānaṃ prayogāṇāmasaṅkhyeyatvenāśakyatvādeva| anativistareṇa ṣaṭprayogaśatābhidhānaṃ mandabuddhisaṃvyavahārārthamiti bhāvaḥ| uktaṃ hyanyatra- “etāvanto hyalamalpabuddhīnāṃ vyavahārāya, buddhimatāṃ ca svālakṣaṇyānumānayuktikuśalānāmanuktārthajñānāya” (sū.a.4) iti||6||
div.quote: tatra phala-jīmūtakekṣvāku-dhāmārgava-kuṭaja-kṛtavedhanānāṃ, śyāmā-trivṛccaturaṅgula-tilvaka-mahāvṛkṣa-saptalā-śaṅkhinī-dantī-dravantīnāṃ ca, nānāvidhadeśakālasambhavāsvāda-rasa-vīrya-vipāka-prabhāvagrahaṇād ‘…prabhāvagrahaṇānāṃ’ iti pā. deha-doṣa-prakṛti-vayo-balāgni-bhakti-sātmya-rogāvasthādīnāṃ nānāprabhāvavattvācca‘…rogāvasthādinānātmakatvācca’ iti pā., vicitragandha-varṇa-rasa-sparśānāmupayogasukhārthamasaṅkhyeyasaṃyogānāmapi ‘…mupabhogasukhārtha...’ iti pā. ca satāṃ dravyāṇāṃ vikalpamārgopadarśanārthaṃ ṣaḍvirecanayogaśatāni vyākhyāsyāmaḥ

div.p: samprati vamanavirecanadravyāṇāṃ deśādisampattyā guṇotkarṣaṃ darśayannāha- tānītyādi| deśādibhiścaturbhiḥ sampacchabdaḥ pratyekamabhisambadhyate| bhājanaṃ bheṣajasthāpanasthānam| vīryasya balaṃ vīryādhikatvameva||7||

deśādi samyag vyākurvannāha- tatra trividha ityādi| atra kecijjāṅgalādideśalakṣaṇagranthaṃ na paṭhanti, tattu janapadoddhvaṃsanīye paṭhitamiti kṛtvehānārṣaṃ vadanti| yaistu janapadoddhvaṃsanīye jāṅgalādilakṣaṇaṃ na paṭhyate, tairatra paṭhanīya evāyaṃ granthaḥ||8||
div.quote: trividhaḥ khalu deśaḥ- jāṅgalaḥ, ānūpaḥ, sādhāraṇaśceti

tatra jāṅgalaḥ paryākāśabhūyiṣṭhaḥ, tarubhirapi ca kadara-khadirāsanāśvakarṇa-dhava-tiniśa-śallakī-sāla-somavalka-badarī-tindukāśvattha-vaṭāmalakīvanagahanaḥ, anekaśamī-kakubha-śiṃśapāprāyaḥ, sthiraśuṣkapavanabalavidhūyamānapranṛtyattaruṇaviṭapaḥ, pratatamṛgatṛṣṇikopagūḍhatanukharaparuṣasikatāśarkarābahulaḥ, lāvatittiricakorānucaritabhūmibhāgaḥ, vātapittabahulaḥ, sthirakaṭhinamanuṣyaprāyo jñeyaḥ, athānūpo hintālatamālanārikelakadalīvanagahanaḥ, saritsamudraparyantaprāyaḥ, śiśirapavanabahulaḥ, vañjulavānīropaśobhitatīrābhiḥ saridbhirupagatabhūmibhāgaḥ, kṣitidharanikuñjopaśobhitaḥ, mandapavanānuvījitakṣitiruhagahanaḥ, anekavanarājīpuṣpitavanagahanabhūmibhāgaḥ, snigdhatarupratānopagūḍhaḥ, haṃsa-cakravāka-balākā-nandīmukha-puṇḍarīka-kādamba-madgu ‘... madgukoyaṣṭībhṛṅgarājapuṃskokilānunāditaḥ’ iti pā.; -bhṛṅgarāja-śatapatra-mattakokilānunāditataruviṭapaḥ, sukumārapuruṣaḥ, pavanakaphaprāyo jñeyaḥ; anayoreva dvayordeśayorvīrudvanaspativānaspatyaśakunimṛgagaṇayutaḥ sthirasukumārabalavarṇasaṃhananopapannasādhāraṇaguṇayuktapuruṣaḥ sādhāraṇo jñeyaḥ

tatra deśe sādhāraṇe jāṅgale vā yathākālaṃ śiśirātapapavanasalilasevite same śucau pradakṣiṇodake śmaśāna-caitya-devayajanāgāra-sabhā-śvabhrārāma-valmīkoṣaravirahite kuśarohiṣāstīrṇe snigdhakṛṣṇamadhuramṛttike suvarṇavarṇamadhuramṛttike vā mṛdāvaphālakṛṣṭe+anupahate+anyairbalavattarairdrumairauṣadhāni jātāni praśasyante
div.p: yathākālamiti yathākālaṃ śiśirādibhiḥ sevite deśe| śmaśānādibhiḥ pratyekaṃ virahitaśabdaḥ sambadhyate| devayajanenāgāraśabdaḥ sambadhyate| sabhā janamelakasthānam| na phālena kṛṣṭa iti aphālakṛṣṭe||9||

tatra yāni kālajātānītyanenaiva kālasampaducyate; kālajātānīti svakālabhūtāni| upāgatasampūrṇetyādinā pratyagrāṇītyantena guṇasampaducyate| pratyagrāṇīti sampūrṇaguṇatayā niṣpannāni| teṣāṃ śākhāpalāśamityādinā kālasampadamuktāṃ prapañcayati| śākhāgrahaṇenaiva tvagādīnāmapi grahaṇam| śīrṇaprarūḍhaparṇānāmiti cchedaḥ| grīṣme mūlāni śiśire veti kathanena yānyāgneyāni teṣāṃ mūlāni grīṣme, yāni saumyāni teṣāṃ mūlāni śiśire, grāhyāṇīti vyavasthāṃ sūcayati; uktaṃ hyanyatra- “saumyānyauṣadhāni saumyeṣvṛtuṣvādadīta, āgneyānyāgneyeṣu” (su.sū.a.36) iti| bheṣajagrahaṇavidhānamāha- maṅgaletyādi||10||
div.quote: tatra yāni kālajātānyupāgatasampūrṇapramāṇa-rasavīrya-gandhāni ‘... nyāgatasampurṇapramāṇarasavīryagandhāni’ iti pā.; kālātapāgnisalilapavanajantubhiranupahatagandha-varṇa-rasa-sparśa-prabhāvāṇi pratyagrāṇyudīcyāṃ diśi sthitāni; teṣāṃ śākhāpalāśamaciraprarūḍhaṃ varṣāvasantayorgrāhyaṃ, grīṣme mūlāni śiśire vā śīrṇaprarūḍhaparṇānāṃ, śaradi tvakkandakṣīrāṇi, hemante sārāṇi, yathartu puṣpaphalamiti; maṅgalācāraḥ kalyāṇavṛttaḥ śuciḥ śuklavāsāḥ sampūjya devatā aśvinau gobrāhmaṇāṃśca kṛtopavāsaḥ prāṅmukha udaṅmukho vā gṛhṇīyāt

div.p: bhājanasampadamāha- gṛhītvetyādi| anurūpaguṇavadbhājanasthānīti anurūpaguṇavattā ca bhājanasya bheṣajasamānaguṇatayaiva| svavacchannānīti samyakpihitāni||11||
div.quote: gṛhītvā cānurūpaguṇavadbhājanasthānyāgāreṣū ‘cānurūpaguṇavadbhājane saṃsthāpyāgāreṣu’ iti pā. prāgudagdvāreṣu nivātapravātaikadeśeṣu nityapuṣpopahārabalikarmavatsu, agni-salilopasveda-dhūma-rajo-mūṣaka-catuṣpadāmanabhigamanīyāni svavacchannāni śikyeṣvāsajya sthāpayet

div.p: saṅkṣepeṇa madanaphalādīnāṃ vātādibhedena bhāvanāloḍanadravyāṇyāha- tāni ca yathādoṣaṃ prayuñjītetyādi| dhānyāmlaṃ kāñjikaṃ, phalāmlaṃ dāḍimarasādi| śleṣmaṇītyādau kaṣāyaśabdena śleṣmaharadravyakvātho+abhipretaḥ| uddeśa iti saṅkṣepābhidhānamityarthaḥ| dravya-deha-doṣa-sātmyādīnītyatra ādiśabdena prakṛtibalādīnāṃ grahaṇam||12||
div.quote: tāni ca yathādoṣaṃ prayuñjīta surā-sauvīraka-tuṣodaka-maireya-medaka-dhānyāmla ‘...dhānyaphaladadhyamlādibhirvāte’ iti pā.-phalāmla-dadhyamlādibhirvāte, mṛdvīkāmalaka‘mṛdvīkāmadhumadhukaphāṇitakṣīrādibhiḥ’ iti pā.-madhu-madhuka-parūṣaka-phāṇitakṣīrādibhiḥ pitte, śleṣmaṇi tu madhu-mūtra-kaṣāyādibhirbhāvitānyāloḍitāni ca; ityuddeśaḥ

div.p: vamanadravyāṇāmityādinā madanaphalasya prādhānyopadarśanapūrvakaṃ prayogavidhimāha| anapāyitvāditi vamanadravyāntarāpekṣayā+alpavyāpattikatvāt| antare iti madhye, sa ca grīṣmavasantayorantarvartikatipayadinānyeva madhyo jñeyaḥ| aśvayuk aśvinī| maitre muhūrta iti śivabhujagamitrādīnāṃ madhye mitradevatāke, evaṃ maitre muhūrte| palānāmiti rāśīnām| madhuvadiṣṭagandho yeṣāṃ tāni, yāni madhviṣṭagandhāni bhavanti tāni grāhyāṇīti darśayati| phalapippalīriti madanaphalamadhyagatāni pippalīsaṃsthānāni bījāni| tāsāmityādi pūraṇavācakaśabdayogāt karaṇe ṣaṣṭhī| svanuguptamiti kṛtarakṣāvidhānam||13||
div.quote: tāni vasantagrīṣmayorantare ‘...rantarā puṣye+aśvayuji mṛgaśirasi vā’ iti pā.; puṣyāśvayugbhyāṃ mṛgaśirasā vā gṛhṇīyānmaitre muhūrte

yāni pakvānyakāṇānyaharitāni pāṇḍūnyakrimīṇyapūtīnyajantujagdhānyahrasvāni; tāni pramṛjya ‘pragṛhya kuśamūlairbaddhvā’ iti pā.; , kuśapuṭe baddhvā, gomayenālipya, yavatu(bu)ṣamāṣaśālikulatthamudgapalānāmanyatame‘... mudgaparṇānā...’ iti pā. nidadhyādaṣṭarātram
tāsāṃ ghṛtadadhimadhupalalavimṛditānāṃ punaḥ śuṣkāṇāṃ navaṃ kalaśaṃ supramṛṣṭavālukamarajaskamākaṇṭhaṃ pūrayitvā svavacchannaṃ svanuguptaṃ śikyeṣvāsajya‘...ṣvavasṛjya’ iti pā. samyak sthāpayet

div.p: dvyahaṃ tryahaṃ vā snehasvedopapannamityanena abhyaṅge kriyamāṇe snehasahacaritasvedopapādanaṃ dvyahaṃ tryahaṃ vā vidhīyate, “tryahāvaraṃ saptadinaṃ paraṃ tu snigdho naraḥ svedayitavya iṣṭaḥ” (si.a.1) ityanena pānaprayujyamānasnehasya saptarātraṃ trirātraṃ vā prakarṣa ucyate iti na virodhaḥ| etaccābhyaṅgasvedasahitasnehasvedakaraṇaṃ pānasnehāntadivasamārabhya kriyate, tena snehapānaviśrāmadinena samaṃ dvyahatryahapūraṇamabhyaṅgasnehasahitasvedaprayogasya bhavati| snehapānācca yadviśrāmadinam, “ekāhoparatastadvadbhuktvā pracchardanaṃ pibet” (sū.a.13) ityanenoktaṃ, tathaivehāpi| kaphotkleśakāribhojanamāha- śvaśchardayitavyamityādinā| śva iti parasminnahni| vyuṣitamiti rātrimatikrāntam| nirannamiti padacchedaḥ| anatisnigdhamityādinā vamanadina eva ghṛtamātrāyuktayavāgūpānapūrvakaṃ vamanamanatisnigdhapuruṣaviṣayaṃ brūte| anye tu pūrvadina evānatisnigdhasya ghṛtamātrāṃ ‘ghṛtamātrāyuktayavāgūpānamāhuḥ’ iti pā.; pītavata eva yavāgvāḥ pānamāhuḥ, “peśalairvividhairannairdoṣānutkleśya dehinaḥ| snigdhasvinnāya vamanaṃ dattaṃ samyak pravartate|| athāparedyuḥ pūrvāhṇe sādhāraṇe kāle vamanadravyakaṣāyakalkacūrṇasnehānāmanyatamasya” (su.ci.a.33) ityādi suśrutokteḥ| antarnakhamuṣṭimiti antarīkṛtanakhamuṣṭiparimāṇam| yāvadvā sādhu manyetetyanena mātrāyā baladoṣādibhedenāsthiratvamityāha| yaṣṭīmadhukasya kovidārādiṣu vicchedapāṭha uttaraprayogeṣu kovidārāderyaṣṭīmadhuvirahitasya grahaṇārthaḥ| kovidāraḥ svanāmakhyātaḥ, sa śaradi puṣpati; karbudārastu kāñcanāraḥ, sa vasante puṣpati; nīpaḥ kadambaḥ, vidulaḥ vetasaḥ, śaṇapuṣpī ghaṇṭāravā, sadāpuṣpī arkapuṣpikā, pratyakpuṣpī apāmārgaḥ| rātrimuṣitaṃ vimṛdya pūtamiti śṛtakaṣāyāt kaṣāyāntaropadarśakaṃ pakṣāntaraṃ; kiṃvā, kaṣāyapāna eva śītakaṣāyavidhānamihocyate| pūrṇaṃ śarāvamiti maṅgalārthaṃ pūrṇakumbhavat| punaḥ punariti yāvat pittāgamanaṃ na bhavati tāvat punaḥ punaḥ kaṣāyaṃ pibedityarthaḥ| anyatrāpyuktaṃ- “pittāntamiṣṭaṃ vamanaṃ virekādardhaṃ” (si.a.1) ityādi| vamanāyogakārakahīnavegapravṛttipratikārārthamāha- hīnavegamityādi||14||
div.quote: atha cchardanīyamāturaṃ dvyahaṃ tryahaṃ vā snehasvedopapannaṃ śvaśchardayitavyamiti grāmyānūpaudakamāṃsarasa-kṣīra-dadhi-māṣa-tila-śākādibhiḥ samutkleśitaśleṣmāṇaṃ vyuṣitaṃ jīrṇāhāraṃ pūrvāhṇe kṛtabalihomamaṅgalaprāyaścittaṃ nirannamanatisnigdhaṃ yavāgvā ghṛtamātrāṃ pītavantaṃ, tāsāṃ phalapippalīnāmantarnakhamuṣṭiṃ yāvadvā sādhu manyeta jarjarīkṛtya yaṣṭimadhukaṣāyeṇa kovidāra-karbudāra-nīpa-vidula-bimbī-śaṇapuṣpī-sadāpuṣpī-pratyakpuṣpī-kaṣāyāṇāmanyatamena vā rātrimuṣitaṃ vimṛdya pūtaṃ madhusaindhavayuktaṃ sukhoṣṇaṃ kṛtvā pūrṇaṃ śarāvaṃ mantreṇānenābhimantrayet- ‘Oṃ brahmadakṣāśvirudrendrabhūcandrārkānilānalāḥ

ityevamabhimantryodaṅmukhaṃ prāṅmukhaṃ vā+a+aturaṃ pāyayecchleṣmajvaragulmapratiśyāyārtaṃ viśeṣeṇa punaḥ punarāpittāgamanāt, tena sādhu vamati; hīnavegaṃ tu pippalyāmalaka-sarṣapa-vacākalkalavaṇoṣṇodakaiḥ punaḥ punaḥ pravartayedāpittadarśanāt
sarveṣu tu madhusaindhavaṃ kaphavilayanacchedārthaṃ vamaneṣu vidadhyāt
div.p: yadyapi ca ghreyādivamanayogeṣu madhusaindhavayogo na bhavati, tathā+api ‘sarveṣu’ iti padaṃ bāhulyārtham| vamanārthakaṣāye uṣṇe madhuprakṣepo virodhitvānna yujyate, uktaṃ hi- “madhūṣṇamuṣṇārtamathavā” (sū.a.27) ityādi, evamāśaṅkya samādhānamāha na coṣṇavirodho madhuna ityādi| avipakvapratyāgamanādityanena pacyamānaṃ madhūṣṇayuktaṃ virudhyeteti darśayati| doṣanirharaṇācceti madhūṣṇaviruddhamapi vamanayoge uṣṇe iṣyate, tasya doṣanirharaṇādeva na virodho bhavatīti darśayati| evaṃ bastiprayoge+api madhuna uṣṇāvirodho varṇanīyaḥ| etena yaṣṭīmadhvādinavadravyakṛtairnavabhiḥ kaṣāyairnavayogāḥ||15||

phalapippalīnāṃ dvau bhāgāvityādau phalapippalīnāṃ bhāgatrayaṃ kartavyaṃ; tatra bhāgadvayaṃ ṣaḍguṇena kovidārādikaṣāyeṇa kṣāraparisrāvaṇavidhivadekaviṃśativārān parisrāvaṇīyam| kovidārādīnāṃ cāṣṭānāmaṣṭau kaṣāyāḥ pṛthak parisrāvaṇe prayoktavyāḥ| yena ca kaṣāyeṇa ‘taiśca kaṣāyaiḥ’ iti pā.; phalapippalībhāgadvayaṃ parisrāvya haritakyādiparimāṇā mātrā tṛtīyabhāgaphalapippalīkalkasya kriyate tenaiva kaṣāyeṇa mātrāyogāḥ ‘tenaiva kaṣāyeṇa mātrāyogāḥ’ ityayaṃ pāṭho hastalikhitapustake na paṭhyate; ; evamaṣṭau harītakyādimātrayā nirdiṣṭāḥ phalapippalīyogā bhavanti| mātrāvikalpaśca doṣabalādivikalpakṛto jñeyaḥ| samānaṃ pūrveṇeti pūrvayogavadiha snehasvedābhimantraṇādividhānaṃ kartavyamityarthaḥ| evamanyatrāpi pūrvavacchabdārtho jñeyaḥ||16||
div.quote: phalapippalīnāṃ dvau dvau bhāgau kovidārādikaṣāyeṇa triḥsaptakṛtvaḥ srāvayet, tena rasena tṛtīyaṃ bhāgaṃ piṣṭvā mātrāṃ harītakībhirbibhītakairāmalairvā tulyāṃ vartayet, tāsāmekāṃ dve vā pūrvoktānāṃ kaṣāyāṇāmanyatamasyāñjalimātreṇa vimṛdya balavacchleṣmaprasekagranthijvarodarāruciṣu pāyayediti samānaṃ pūrveṇa

div.p: phalapippalyā kṣīrapākavidhinā sādhitaṃ kṣīraṃ phalapippalīkṣīram; ayameko yogaḥ| teneti phalapippalīsādhitakṣīreṇa| tajjasyeti phalapippalīkṣīrajātasya dadhnaḥ| uttarakamiti saram| santānikā kṣīroparisthaḥ styāno bhāgaḥ||17||
div.quote: phalapippalīkṣīraṃ, tena vā kṣīrayavāgūmadhobhāge raktapitte hṛddāhe ca; tajjasya vā dadhna uttarakaṃ kaphaccharditamakaprasekeṣu ‘...prasekeṣu pūrṇaṃ śarāvaṃ’ iti pā.; tasya vā payasaḥ śītasya santānikāñjaliṃ pitte prakupite uraḥkaṇṭhahṛdaye ca tanukaphopadigdhe, iti samānaṃ pūrveṇa

div.p: phalādīni phala-jīmūtakekṣvāku-dhāmārgava-kuṭaja-kṛtavedhanāni ṣaṭ| ete kṣīrayogacatuṣṭayena ghṛtayogena ca samaṃ pañca yogā adhyāyasaṅgrahe vaktavyā||18||
div.quote: phalapippalīśṛtakṣīrānnavanītamutpannaṃ phalādikalkakaṣāyasiddhaṃ kaphābhibhūtāgniṃ viśuṣyaddehaṃ‘viśuṣkadehaṃ viśuṣyamāṇaṃ ca’ iti pā. ca mātrayā pāyayediti samānaṃ pūrveṇa

div.p: phalapippalīnāṃ phalādikaṣāyeṇetyādinā ekaṃ ghreyayogamāha| puṣparajaḥprakāśeneti puṣpadhūlisadṛśena| haridrābhidhānaḥ kṛśaro haridrākṛśaraḥ||19||
div.quote: phalapippalīnāṃ phalādikaṣāyeṇa triḥsaptakṛtvaḥ suparibhāvitena puṣparajaḥprakāśena cūrṇena sarasi sañjātaṃ ‘sañjātaṃ’ iti hastalikhitapustake na paṭhyate; bṛhatsaroruhaṃ sāyāhne+avacūrṇayet, tadrātrivyuṣitaṃ prabhāte punaravacūrṇitamuddhṛtya haridrākṛsarakṣīrayavāgūnāmanyatamaṃ saindhavaguḍaphāṇitayuktamākaṇṭhaṃ pītavantamāghrāpayet sukumāramutkliṣṭapittakaphamauṣadhadveṣiṇamiti samānaṃ pūrveṇa

div.p: bhallātakavidhiparisrutamiti rasāyanoktabhallātakasnehagrahaṇavidhānena parisrutaḥ svaraso grāhyaḥ| phāṇitayogo+ayamekaḥ| ātapaśuṣkaṃ vetyādinā cūrṇayogo+apyekaḥ||20||
div.quote: phalapippalīnāṃ bhallātakavidhiparisrutaṃ ‘bhallātakavidhisrutaṃ’ iti pā. svarasaṃ paktvā phāṇitībhūtamātantulībhāvāllehayet; ātapaśuṣkaṃ vā cūrṇīkṛtaṃ jīmūtakādikaṣāyeṇa pitte kaphasthānagate pāyayediti samānaṃ pūrveṇa

div.p: phalapippalīcūrṇānītyādau phalādiṣaṭkaṣāyabhedena kṛtatvāt ṣaḍ vartiprayogā jñeyāḥ| vartikriyāyāṃ caturguṇena kvāthena pākādvartyākāratā ‘śalākākāravartiḥ’ iti pā. kartavyā| atrāpi ca tathā lehādau ca sāmānyoktena madhuprakṣepo yuktaḥ; taṃ caike madhunaḥ pākavirodhānnānumanyante||21||
div.quote: phalapippalīcūrṇāni pūrvavat phalādīnāṃ ‘kovidārādīnāṃ’ iti pā.; ṣaṇṇāmanyatamakaṣāyasrutāni vartikriyāḥ phalādikaṣāyopasarjanāḥ ‘kovidārādikaṣāyopasarjanāḥ’ iti pā. peyā iti samānaṃ pūrveṇa

div.p: phalapippalīnāmāragvadhetyādinā āragvadhādiviṃśatidravyakvāthabhedena kṛtatvādviṃśatirlehā jñeyāḥ| vṛkṣakaḥ kuṭajaḥ, svādukaṇṭakaḥ vikaṅkataḥ, śārṅgeṣṭā guñjā, suṣavī kāravellakaṃ, dvīpikā hiṃsrā, ‘kaṇṭakārī’ ityanye||22||
div.quote: phalapippalīnāmāragvadha‘phalapippalīṣvā...’ iti pā.-vṛkṣaka-svādukaṇṭaka-pāṭhā-pāṭalā-śārṅgeṣṭā-mūrvā-saptaparṇa-naktamāla-picumarda-paṭola-suṣavī-guḍūcī-somavalka-dvīpikānāṃ pippalī-pippalīmūla-hastipippalī-citraka-śṛṅgaverāṇāṃ cānyatamakaṣāyeṇa siddho leha iti samānaṃ pūrveṇa

phalapippalīṣvelā-hareṇukā-śatapuṣpā-kustumburu-tagara-kuṣṭha-tvak-coraka-marubakāguru-guggulvelavāluka-śrīveṣṭaka-paripelava-māṃsī-śaileyaka-sthauṇeyaka-sarala-pārāvatapadyaśokarohiṇīnāṃ viṃśateranyatamasya kaṣāyeṇa sādhitotkārikā utkārikākalpena, modakā vā modakakalpena, yathādoṣarogabhakti prayojyā iti samānaṃ pūrveṇa
div.p: phalapippalīṣvityādinotkārikā modakāśca pratyekaṃ viṃśatiḥ| corakaḥ gandhadravyaṃ svanāmakhyātaṃ, paripelavaṃ kaivartamustakaṃ, sthauṇeyakaḥ granthiparṇakaṃ, pārāvatapadī jyotiṣmatī, aśokarohiṇī aśokasadṛśapatrā latā, ‘kaṭurohiṇī’ ityanye| kecidatra sthauṇeyakaṃ parityajyāpākīpādyā viṃśatiṃ pūrayanti, apākīpādī svanāmakhyātā| utkārikākalpeneti sūdaśāstroktotkārikāvidhānena||23||

div.quote: phalapippalīsvarasakaṣāyaparibhāvitāni tilaśālitaṇḍulapiṣṭāni tatkaṣāyopasarjanāni śaṣkulīkalpena vā śaṣkulyaḥ, pūpakalpena vā pūpāḥ iti samānaṃ pūrveṇa
etenaiva ca kalpena sumukha-surasa-kuṭheraka-kāṇḍīra-kālamālaka-parṇāsaka-kṣavaka-phaṇijjhaka-gṛñjana-kāsamarda-bhṛṅgarājānāṃ poṭekṣuvālikā-kālaṅkataka-daṇḍairakāṇāṃ cānyatamasya kaṣāyeṇa kārayet
div.p: phalapippalīsvarasenetyādinā śaṣkulyapūpayoḥ pṛthageko yogaḥ| etenaiva ca kalpenetyādinā sumukhādipañcadaśadravyakaṣāyeṇa pṛthak śaṣkulyapūpayoḥ karaṇāt pañcadaśa yogā bhavanti| evaṃ militvā śaṣkulīpūpayoḥ pṛthak ṣoḍaśayogā bhavanti| poṭā ikṣugandhā; daṇḍairakā gundrākhyagulmaḥ, nalo vā||24-25||
tathā badaraṣāḍavetyādinā daśa yogāḥ| badarakṛtaḥ ṣāḍavo badaraṣāḍavaḥ||26||
div.quote: tathā badaraṣāḍava-rāga-leha-modakotkārikā-tarpaṇa-pānaka-māṃsarasa-yūṣa-madyānāṃ ‘...yūṣamadyāni madanaphalaphāṇitenopasaṃsṛjya’ iti pā. madanaphalānyanyatamenopasṛjya yathādoṣarogabhakti dadyāt; taiḥ sādhu vamatīti

div.p: madanasya vyavahārārthaṃ paryāyānāha- madanaḥ karahāṭaścetyādi| tasya kalpaneti ya evambhūtaiḥ paryāyairvyākhyātastasyeyaṃ kalpanā| asya ca paryāyābhidhānaṃ bhūriprayogeṣu vihitatvenābhyarhitatvājjñeyam| evamanyatrāpi paryāyābhidhāne prayojanaṃ varṇanīyam||27||
madanaphalayogānāṃ navādisaṅkhyotkarṣanirāsārthaṃ sukhasmaraṇārthaṃ ca tān saṅgraheṇāha- nava yogā ityādi| asya cārtho yathāsthānaṃ vyāhṛtaḥ||28-30||
div.quote: tatra ślokāḥ- nava yogāḥ kaṣāyeṣu, mātrāsvaṣṭau ‘vartiṣvaṣṭau’ iti pā., payoghṛte
pañca, phāṇitacūrṇe dvau ghreye, vartikriyāsu ṣaṭ
ityagniveśakṛte tantre carakapratisaṃskṛte+aprāpte dṛḍhabalasampūrite kalpasthāne madanakalpo nāma prathamo+adhyāyaḥ
div.p: iti śrīcakrapāṇidattaviracitāyāṃ carakatātparyaṭīkāyāmāyurvedadīpikāyāṃ kalpasthāne madanakalpo nāma prathamo+adhyāyaḥ||1||

madanakalpānantaramanapāyitvenekṣvākvādidravyebhyaḥ prādhānyājjīmūtakasya jīmūtakalpo+abhidhīyate| evaṃ yathāyathaiṣāmanapāyitvaprakarṣaḥ, tathā tathā pūrvaniveśanaṃ jñeyam| tenāparavamanakalpānāmapyadhyāyasambandho+atraivokto jñeyaḥ| madanaphalasya snehasvedādipūrvakatvavadihāpi kramo+atideśādunnetavyaḥ||1-2||

div.quote: garāgarī ca veṇī ca tathā syāddevatāḍakaḥ
div.p: phalapuṣpāśrayamiti vacanena jīmūtasya patranālādiṣu vamanaprayogaṃ niṣedhayati| garāgarī cetyādi paryāyakathanam| jīmūtaḥ pītaghoṣakaḥ||3||

tridoṣaghnamiti yathāsvaṃ vātaharādidravyayuktaṃ, tathā vātādiharadravyakalpitaṃ‘peyādikalpitaṃ ca’ iti pā. ca sat tridoṣaghnaṃ bhavati| hikkādyeṣviti ādyaśabdena kāsādīnāmurogatadoṣajanyānāṃ grahaṇam||4||

yathoktayuktaguṇayuktānāmiti kālajatva-sampūrṇarasatvādiguṇayuktāni madanaphaloktaguṇadvārā+anusartavyāni| deśajānāmiti madanakalpoktapraśastabhūmijātānām| yathāvidhīti madanakalpoktavidhānagṛhītānām| payaḥ puṣpe ityeko yogaḥ| nirvṛtte ityādiko dvitīyo yogaḥ| nirvṛtte iti utpannamātre phale, tatra phalaiḥ kṣīraṃ sādhayitvā tena kṣīreṇa peyā sādhanīyā| romaśe ityādi tṛtīyaḥ| romaśe iti upagataromṇi phale, atrāpi romaśaphalasādhitakṣīrāt santānikā jñeyā| dadhyuttaramityādikaścaturtho yogaḥ, atrāpyupagataromāvasthaphalasādhitakṣīrasambhūtadadhisaro jñeyaḥ| śṛte payasītyādikaḥ pañcamaḥ| dadhyamlamiti amlāvasthaṃ dadhi jātam| haritapāṇḍuke iti haritapāṇḍvavasthāprāpte jīmūtakaphale| jīrṇānāmityādikaḥ ṣaṣṭhaḥ kṣīrayogaḥ| ete ca yogāḥ kṣīrasambandhena avidhīyamānakṣīrākārā api kṣīraprayogatvenaiva saṅgrahe ‘ṣaṭ kṣīre’ ityanena saṅgrahītavyāḥ||5-7||
div.quote: payaḥ‘payaḥpuṣpeṣu nirvṛttaṃ’ iti pā. puṣpe+asya, nirvṛtte phale peyā payaskṛtā
śṛte payasi dadhyamlaṃ jātaṃ‘jāte’ iti pā. haritapāṇḍuke
jīrṇānāṃ ca suśuṣkāṇāṃ nyastānāṃ bhājane śucau

div.p: āsutyetyādinā madirāyoga eka ucyate| āsutyeti niśāparyuṣitaṃ kṛtvā| atra yoge pakvajīmūtakaphalamevādhikṛtaṃ; tathā, uttarayogeṣvapi pakvameva phalamadhikṛtaṃ jñeyaṃ, “phalaṃ paryāgataṃ grāhyaṃ” ityautsargikavacanāt| dve cetyādinā dvādaśakaṣāyabhedād dvādaśayogā ucyante| tenaiva vidhineti madanakalpoktena sādhanavidhinā| athavetyādau āragvadhādisaptadravyakaṣāyabhedāt saptayogā bhavanti| āragvadhādayaḥ āragvadha-vṛkṣaka-svādukaṇṭaka-pāṭhā-pāṭali-śārṅgeṣṭā-mūrvāḥ (ka.a.1) pūrvādhyāyoktāḥ||8-10||-
div.quote: āsutya ca surāmaṇḍe mṛditvā prasrutaṃ pibet
dve cāpothyāthavā trīṇi guḍūcyā ‘guḍūcyāmalakasya vā’ iti pā.; madhukasya vā

div.p: mātrāḥ syurityādinā+aṣṭau mātrāyogānāha| phalavaditi madanaphale yathā aṣṭau mātrāyogā uktāstathehāpi kartavyāḥ, viśeṣatastu etāḥ kolamātrāḥ kartavyāḥ, na tu phalavaddharītakyādipramāṇāḥ kartavyā ityarthaḥ||11||
div.quote: mātrāḥ syuḥ‘vartayaḥ’ iti pā. phalavaccāṣṭau kolamātrāstu tā matāḥ

div.p: jīvaketyādinā caturo yogāḥ pānasādhanakaṣāyabhedāt||12||
tathetyādinā ghṛtayogamekamāha||13||
ṣaṭ kṣīre ityādinā saṅgrahārtho vyākṛta eva yathāsthānam||14-15||
div.quote: tatra ślokau- ṣaṭ kṣīre madirāmaṇḍe‘madirāyoge’ iti pā. eko dvādaśa cāpare
kalpe jīmūtakānāṃ ca‘ye’ iti ‘te’ iti ca pā. yogāstriṃśannavādhikāḥ
ityagniveśakṛte tantre carakapratisaṃskṛte+aprāpte dṛḍhabalasampūrite kalpasthāne jīmūtakakalpo nāma dvitīyo+adhyāyaḥ
div.p: iti śrīcakrapāṇidattaviracitāyāṃ carakatātparyaṭīkāyāmāyurvedadīpikāyāṃ kalpasthāne jīmūtakakalpo nāma dvitīyo+adhyāyaḥ||2||
uktādhyāyasambandhādikṣvākukalpo+abhidhīyate| yeṣāṃ praśasyate ikṣvākukalpastān vakṣyāmīti yojyam||1-2||-
lambetyādi paryāyakathanam||3||-
div.quote: lambā+atha ‘lambā piṇḍaphalā tumbī kaṭukālābukī ca sā’ iti pā.; kaṭukālābūstumbī piṇḍaphalā tathā
ikṣvākuḥ phalinī caiva procyate tasya kalpanā

div.p: tadiṣyate iti ikṣvākukalpanamiṣyate||4||-

apuṣpasyetyādinā ekaḥ kṣīrayogaḥ| apuṣpasyeti anutpannapuṣpasya| muṣṭiṃ prādeśasammitamiti pradeśinyā mūlaparyantakṛtamuṣṭiparimāṇam; evaṃ ca nātra muṣṭiśabdaḥ palavacanaḥ| kṣīraprasthe śṛtamiti vacanāt kṣīraprasthe yathoktamānamikṣvākumāvāpya caturguṇaṃ pānīyaṃ dattvā kṣīraṃ sādhanīyam| puṣpādiṣvityādinā caturaḥ kṣīrayogānāha| jīmūtake yathā “payaḥ puṣpe+asya nirvṛtte phale peyā payaskṛtā| romaśe kṣīrasantānaṃ dadhyuttaramaromaśe” (ka.a.2) ityanenoktaṃ, tathehāpi yogacatuṣṭayaṃ karaṇīyam| haritetyādinā surāyogamāha| haritapāṇḍūnāmikṣvākuphalānāṃ surāmaṇḍe jīmūtakavadyogaḥ kartavyaḥ; jīmūtakavidhānātideśena “āsutya ca surāmaṇḍe muditvā prasrutaṃ pibet” (ka.a.2) iti granthoktavidhānamihāpi bhavati| phalasvarasetyādinā ṣaṣṭhaḥ kṣīrayogo+abhidhīyate| triguṇakṣīrasādhitamiti triguṇena kṣīreṇa sādhitaṃ; tacca caturguṇena toyena sādhanīyam| phalaśabdenātrekṣvākuphalamucyate| jīrṇe ityādinā saptamaḥ kṣīrayogaḥ| madhyoddhṛte iti uddhṛtamadhye| ajākṣīreṇetyādinā+aṣṭamaḥ kṣīrayogaḥ| tena takramityādinā takrayogaḥ| teneti tumbīphalamadhyena||5-10||-
div.quote: puṣpādiṣu ca catvāraḥ kṣīre jīmūtake yathā
uraḥsthite kaphe dadyāt svarabhede ca pīnase
jīrṇe madhyoddhṛte kṣīraṃ‘jīrṇamadhyoddhṛtaṃ kṣīre’ iti pā. prakṣipettadyadā dadhi
jātaṃ syāt sakaphe kāse śvāse vamyāṃ ca tat pibet
ajākṣīreṇa bījāni bhāvayet‘bhāvitāni prayojayet’ iti pā. pāyayet ca
tena takraṃ vipakvaṃ vā sakṣaudralavaṇaṃ pibet

div.p: tumbyā ityādinā ghreyayogamāha| gandhasampatsukhocita iti gandhasampat sugandhavattvaṃ, tayā gandhasampadā sukhamucitamabhyastaṃ yena saḥ; avacūrṇitekṣvākuphalarasapuṣpaṃ‘avacūrṇitamikṣvākuphalarasabhāvitaṃ’ iti pā. mālyamāghrāyaiva vamatyanabhyastadurgandha iti bhāvaḥ||11||-

div.quote: bhakṣayet phalamadhyaṃ vā guḍena palalena ca
div.p: bhakṣayedityādinā vamanayogamekamāha| phalamadhyam ikṣvākuphalamadhyam| ikṣvākuphalakalkasādhitaṃ tailamikṣvākuphalatailam; ayameka eva tailayogaḥ| pūrvavaditi jīmūtakavat, tena “tathā jīmūtakakṣīrāt” (ka.a.2) ityādinoktavidhānena jīmūtakasthāne ikṣvākuphalaṃ dattveha ghṛtaṃ sādhanīyam||12||-

pañcāśadityādinā ṣaḍ vardhamānakayogānāha| pañcāśadārabhya daśakena vṛddhairikṣvākubījaiḥ śataṃ pūraṇīyam| tena ṣaḍyogā bhavanti| tāni ca yathāsaṅkhyaṃ madanaphalādīnāṃ ṣaṇṇāmanyatamakaṣāyeṣvāsutya vimṛditāni pātavyāni ‘tena madanaphalādīnāṃ ṣaṇṇāṃ kaṣāye āsutāḥ santo vimṛditāḥ pātavyāḥ’ iti pā.| anye tu daśabījādārabhya pañcāśadbījaparyantaṃ doṣādyapekṣayā pātavyaṃ; tatra madanādikaṣāyabhedādeva yogabheda ityāhuḥ||13||-
yaṣṭyāhvetyādinā navakaṣāyayogānāha| tatra yaṣṭyāhvamekaṃ, kovidārādayo madanakalpoktā aṣṭau||14||
kaṣāyairityādinā madanaphalasadṛśavidhā aṣṭau mātrālakṣitāḥ prayogā ucyante|15|-
div.quote: kaṣāyaiḥ kovidārādyairmātrāśca‘rvartayaḥ’ iti pā. phalavat smṛtāḥ

div.p: bilvetyādinā eko lehaḥ, tathā ‘kalpa’ ityādinā catvāro lehā ante draṣṭavyāḥ, evaṃ pañca lehāḥ| añjaliḥ palacatuṣṭayam| atra ca “tataśca kuḍavaṃ yāvattoyamaṣṭaguṇaṃ bhavet” iti vacanādbilvamūlakaṣāyasyāṣṭāvañjalayo deyāḥ, tataścaturbhāgāvaśeṣeṇa kuḍavadvayam| phāṇitam ardhaśṛta ikṣurasaḥ| ‘caturthaḥ phāṇitasya ca’ ityasya sthāne ‘trayastrikaṭukasya ca’ iti kecit paṭhanti| saghṛta iti ghṛtasyaiko bhāgaḥ| ardhāṃśikāniti ekabhāgārdhamānān pratyekaṃ mahājālinyādīn| mahājālinī pītakoṣātakī, kṛtavedhanaḥ ghoṣakabhedaḥ ‘jyotsnikā” iti khyātaḥ| yāvat syāttantumadityādinā lehapākalakṣaṇamāha; etacca lakṣaṇaṃ lehāntareṣvapi pācanīyeṣu jñeyam| na śīryate na vistīryate| pramathyāṃ ca pibedanviti atīsāracikitsite “pippalī nāgaraṃ dhānyaṃ” (ci.a.19) ityādinoktapramathyānāṃ madhye+anyatamapramathyākṛtaṃ kaṣāyaṃ pibedityarthaḥ| ‘pramathyāṃ ca’ ityasya sthāne kecit ‘manthaṃ cāpi’ iti paṭhanti| agnimanthādāviti pratyekamagnimantha-syonāka-pāṭalā-gambhārīmūlacatuṣkaṃ pañcamūlakathanaprastāve rasāyane kathitam||15-18||-
div.quote: pūtasyāsya trayo bhāgāścaturthaḥ ‘bhāgāstrayastrikaṭukasya ca’ iti pā.; phāṇitasya tu
saghṛto bījabhāgaśca piṣṭānardhāṃśikāṃstathā ‘piṣṭvā hyardhāṃśikāṃstathā’ iti pā.;
yāvat syāttantumattoye patitaṃ tu na śīryate
taṃ lihanmātrayā lehaṃ‘kāle’ iti pā. pramathyāṃ ca pibedanu

div.p: śaktubhirityādinaiko manthayogaḥ||19||-
gulme jvara ityādinā rasaikayogamāha| kalkam ikṣvākubījakalkam||20||
div.quote: gulme mehe‘śophe’ iti pā. praseke ca kalkaṃ māṃsarasaiḥ pibet
naraḥ sādhu vamatyevaṃ na ca daurbalyamaśnute

div.p: payasyaṣṭāvityādisaṅgrahārtho vyākṛta eva| atra phaleṣviti madanaphalādiṣu| ghṛtaṃ yadyapi vardhamānapūrvapaṭhitaṃ, tathā+api chandonurodhādiha paścāt paṭhitam||21-23||
div.quote: tatra ślokāḥ- payasyaṣṭau surāmaṇḍa-mastu-takreṣu ca trayaḥ
ghreyaṃ sapalalaṃ tailaṃ vardhamānāḥ phaleṣu ṣaṭ
aṣṭau vartikriyā lehāḥ pañca mantho‘manthe rase tathā’ iti pā. rasastathā
yogā ikṣvākukalpe‘ikṣvākukalpe+asmin’ iti pā. te catvāriṃśacca pañca ca
ityagniveśakṛte tantre carakapratisaṃskṛte+aprāpte dṛḍhabalasampūrite kalpasthāne ikṣvākukalpo nāma tṛtīyo+adhyāyaḥ
div.p: iti śrīcakrapāṇidattaviracitāyāmāyurvedadīpikāyāṃ carakatātparyaṭīkāyāṃ kalpasthāne ikṣvākukalpo nāma tṛtīyo+adhyāyaḥ||3||
uktasambandhāddhāmārgavakalpo+abhidhīyate||1-2||
tatra karkoṭakītyādinā paryāyakathanam| dhāmārgavaḥ pītaghoṣakaḥ||3||
div.quote: karkoṭakī koṭhaphalā‘kaṭuphalā’ iti pā. mahājālinireva ca

div.p: sthirāśca guravaśca ye ityatra ‘gadāḥ’ iti śeṣaḥ||4||-
div.quote: rogeṣveṣu‘rogeṣvetat’ iti pā. prayojyaṃ syāt sthirāśca guravaśca ye
phalaṃ puṣpaṃ pravālaṃ ca vidhinā tasya saṃharet
div.p: vidhineti bheṣajagrahaṇoktena vidhinā||5||
pravāletyādinā navayogānāha| pravālasya svarasaḥ pravālasvarasaḥ| atra kovidārādikaṣāyairguḍikākaraṇaṃ pānaṃ ca jñeyam||6||
div.quote: pravālasvarasaṃ śuṣkaṃ kṛtvā ca‘kṛtāśca’ iti pā. gulikāḥ pṛthak

div.p: puṣpādiṣvityādinā jīmūtakakalpavidhānena nirdiṣṭāścatvāraḥ kṣīraprayogāḥ, pañcamaśca surāyogo+atidiśyate; te ca ‘payaḥ puṣpe+asya’ (ka. a. 2) ityādinoktā jñeyāḥ| pūrvavaditi pūrveṇa sambadhyate|7|-
div.quote: puṣpādiṣu payoyogāścatvāraḥ ‘prayogāśca’ iti, ‘yathāyogāḥ’ iti ca pā.; pañcamī surā

div.p: jīrṇaśuṣkāṇāmityādinā navakaṣāyayogānāha, tathā ‘jātyāḥ’ ityādinā ekādaśa kaṣāyayogān vakṣyati; evaṃ viṃśatiḥ kaṣāyayogāḥ saṅgrahe vakṣyamāṇāḥ pūryante| bījakaṇṭhoddhṛtaṃ phalamiti yatra bījāni baddhāni santi sa bījakaṇṭha uddhṛto yasmin tadbījakaṇṭhoddhṛtaṃ phalam| atra ca pūrvanipātāniyama āhitāgnyādipūrvanipātavadbodhyaḥ| evambhūtaṃ ca phalaṃ kaṣāyeṇa saguḍena pūritaṃ rātrivyuṣitaṃ kartavyam| uktaṃ hi jatūkarṇe- dhāmārgavakalpe- “dhāmārgavaphaleṣūddhṛtabījamadhyeṣu saguḍoṣitāḥ kovidārādikaṣāyā nava” iti| gulmināṃ cāvasthāyāṃ vamanaṃ hitameva, teneha gulmaviṣayatayā vamanopadarśanaṃ na virodhi||7-8||-
dadyādityādinā eko+annayoga ucyate| anne ca dhāmārgavasya saṃyogenaiko yogaḥ||9||
cūrṇairityādinā ghreye ekayogamāha| utpalādīnāṃ cātra bhedo+avivakṣitaḥ utpalasyaika eva ghreyayogaḥ| atra ādiśabdena saugandhikapadmādīnāṃ grahaṇam| prabhūtaśaścūrṇairbhāvitānīti jñeyam||10||

cūrṇīkṛtasyetyādinā go+aśvaśakṛdrase iti dvau yogau| tathā pṛṣatetyādidaśayogaiḥ samaṃ śakṛdrasayogasambandhāddvādaśa śakṛdyogā ucyante| pṛṣataḥ binducitritahariṇaḥ; ṛṣyaḥ nīlāṇḍaḥ, kuraṅgaḥ cañcalagatiḥ, aśvataraḥ vegasaraḥ, śvadaṃṣṭraḥ caturdaṃṣṭro mṛgaviśeṣaḥ||11-12||
div.quote: vinīyāñjalimātre tu pibedgo+aśvaśakṛdrase‘gośakṛto rase’ iti pā.

div.p: jīvaketyādinā daśa lehānāha| madhūlikā ‘markaṭahasta’ iti khyātā| atra leheṣu dhāmārgavāditaradravyacūrṇasya samānatvaṃ; madhuśarkarayośca tāvatī mātrā yāvatyā lehatvāpattirbhavati| pittoṣmasahite kaphe iti udyatoṣmaguṇena pittena yukte kaphe; anye tu pittoṣmaśabdena pittoṣmaṇā‘pittakṛtaṃ’ iti pā. kṛtaṃ jvaramāhuḥ||13-14||-
dhānyetyādinaikaṃ kalkayogamāha| dhānyatumbarukvātha eva dhānyatumburuyūṣaḥ| uktaṃ hi jatūkaṇa “dhānyatumbururasena kalko viṣanut” iti||15|
jātyā ityādinā ekādaśakaṣāyayogānāha| jātī saumanasyāyinī, anye yūthikāṃ vadanti| vṛścīraḥ śvetapunarnavā| mahāsahā kṣudrasahā mudgamāṣaparṇyau| haimavatī vacā||16-17||-
div.quote: ekaṃ dhāmārgavaṃ dve vā kaṣāye parimṛdya tu

div.p: tacchṛtetyādinaikaṃ ghṛtayogamāha||18||

div.quote: tatra ślokau- pallave nava catvāraḥ kṣīra ekaḥ surāsave
kaṣāye viṃśatiḥ kalke daśa dvau ca śakṛdrase
anna ekastathā ghreye daśa lehāstathā ghṛtam
div.p: pallave navetyādisaṅgrahe vyutkramasaṅgrahābhidhānaṃ chando+anurodhāt| daśa dvau ceti dvādaśetyarthaḥ||19-20||
iti śrīcakrapāṇidattaviracitāyāmāyurvedadīpikāyāṃ carakatātparyaṭīkāyāṃ kalpasthāne dhāmārgavakalpo nāma caturtho+adhyāyaḥ||4||
div.quote: ityagniveśakṛte tantre carakapratisaṃskṛte+aprāpte dṛḍhabalasampūrite kalpasthāne dhāmārgavakalpo nāma caturtho+adhyāyaḥ

div.p: yathoktasambandhādvatsakakalpābhidhānam||1-2||

vatsakanāmāni vyavahārārthaṃ strīpuruṣabhedaṃ cāha- athetyādi| atra vatsakastrīpuruṣabhedena yadyapi guṇabhedaḥ prayogabhedo vā na pratipāditaḥ, tathā+api strīrūpavatsake+apuṣpaphalatvādiviśiṣṭalakṣaṇayukte+apyaviśeṣeṇobhābhyāmevāmayanivṛttiḥ syādityetadarthamubhayorapi samānaguṇatā jñātavyā||3-6||
div.quote: kalpaṃ cāsya pravakṣyāmi‘nibodhemaṃ’ iti pā. vistareṇa yathātatham
bṛhatphalaḥ śvetapuṣpaḥ‘sitaiḥ puṣpaiḥ’ iti pā. snigdhapatraḥ pumān bhavet
śyāmā cāruṇapuṣpā strī phalavṛntaistathā+aṇubhiḥ ‘phalapuṣpaiḥ’ iti pā.;

div.p: kāle iti ucite kāle| śuṣkāṇīti pakvaśuṣkāṇi| teṣāmantarnakhamityādinā kaṣāyairnavayogānāha| kṣaudrasaindhavayogo yadyapi sarvavamaneṣveva sāmānyena vihitaḥ, tathā+apīha ‘lavaṇakṣaudrasaṃyutam’ iti vacanādutkarṣo lavaṇasaindhavayorabhidhīyate||7-8||-
div.quote: kāle phalāni saṅgṛhyā tayoḥ śuṣkāṇi nikṣipet ‘saṅkṣipet’ iti pā.;
teṣāmantarnakhaṃ muṣṭiṃ jarjarīkṛtya bhāvayet ‘tepayet’ iti, ‘temayet iti’ ca pā.;

div.p: aṣṭāhamityādinā pañca cūrṇayogānāha||9-10||-
div.quote: jīvakasya‘jīmūtakakaṣāyeṇa’ iti pā. kaṣāyeṇa tataḥ pāṇitalaṃ pibet

div.p: kṛśareṇetyādinā kṛśarayoga ucyate| atra ca indrayavacūrṇamadhikṛtatvādevocyate||11||
kaṣāyairityādisaṅgrahaśloko vyākhyātārtha eva||12||
div.quote: tatra ślokaḥ- kaṣāyairnava cūrṇaiśca pañcoktāḥ salilaistrayaḥ
ekaśca kṛśarāyāṃ syādyogāste+aṣṭādaśa smṛtāḥ ‘kṛśarā+aṣṭādaśayogā vatsakasya nidarśitāḥ’ iti pā.;
ityagniveśakṛte tantre carakapratisaṃskṛte+aprāpte dṛḍhabalasampūrite kalpasthāne vatsakakalpo nāma pañcamo+adhyāyaḥ
div.p: iti śrīcakrapāṇidattaviracitāyāmāyurvedadīpikāyāṃ carakatātparyaṭīkāyāṃ kalpasthāne vatsakakalpo nāma pañcamo+adhyāyaḥ||5||
vamanakalpapāriśeṣyāt kṛtavedhanakalpo+abhidhīyate||1-2||
gāḍheṣviti atyarthagāḍheṣu kuṣṭhādiṣu||3-4||
div.quote: kṣveḍaḥ kośātakī coktaṃ‘jālī’ iti pā. mṛdaṅgaphalameva ca

div.p: kṣīrādītyādinā kṣīrayogā ucyante| kṣīrayogacatuṣṭayaṃ madirāyogaṃ ca jīmūtakakalpavidhānātideśenāha| kṣīrādiśabdena kṣīrakṛtapeyā-kṣīrasantānikā-dadhyuttarāṇāṃ grahaṇam| ete ca saṅgrahe+akṣīrarūpā api kṣīravikāratayā kṣīraśabdenaiva gṛhītāḥ ‘kṣīre dvau dvau’ iti vacanena| kusumādīnāmiti kṛtavedhanasya puṣpādīnāṃ “payaḥ puṣpe+asya nirvṛtte phale peyā payaskṛtā| lomaśe kṣīrasantānaṃ dadhyuttaramalomaśe” (ka.a.2) iti jīmūtakavidhānoktānām| surā caiteṣu pūrvavaditi yathā jīmūtakakalpavidhānena kṣīrādayaḥ kartavyāstathā surā ca kartavyā|5|
div.quote: kṣīrādi kusumādīnāṃ‘kṣīrādikusumādīni’ iti pā. surā caiteṣu pūrvavat

div.p: suśuṣkāṇāmityādinā nava kaṣāyayogānāha| phalavaditi madanaphalaṃ yathā yaṣṭīmadhukādibhiḥ pīyate, tathaitadapi pātavyamityarthaḥ| eke navakaṣāyaprayogeṣu śeṣavidhipratyāyakaṃ lehaṃ paṭhanti- “kvāthayitvā rasaṃ tasya pūtvā lehaṃ nidhāpayet” ityādi, tacca saṅgatārtham| uktaṃ ca jatūkarṇe- “atra jīrṇabījānāṃ madanaphalavat kaṣāyairlehā bhavanti nava” iti| pṛthagityādinā trayodaśa kaṣāyayogānāha| evaṃ dvāviṃśatiḥ kaṣāyayogā bhavanti| āragvadhādayastrayodaśa madanakalpe “āragvadhavṛkṣaka ...” (ka.a.1) ityādinā guḍūcyantenoktā jñeyāḥ||5-7||
div.quote: suśuṣkāṇāṃ tu jīrṇānāmekaṃ‘bījānāmekaṃ’ iti pā. dve vā yathābalam
kvāthayitvā phalaṃ ‘rasaṃ taṃ ca kṛtvā lehaṃ’ iti, ‘rasaṃ tasya paktvā lehaṃ’ iti ca pā.; tasya pūtvā lehaṃ nidhāpayet

div.p: śālmalītyādinā daśa picchāyogānāha| śālmalīmūlamādiḥ yeṣāṃ te śālmalīmūlāḥ śālmalyādayo vimānapaṭhitā daśa śālmalīśālmalakabhadraparṇyelāparṇyupodikoddāladhanvanarājādanopacitrāgopyantāḥ (vi.a.8); eṣāṃ cūrṇānāṃ picchābhiryuktyā kṛtatvenaiva daśa yogā jñeyāḥ| śālmalakaḥ śālmalībhedaḥ, rohitako vā; bhadraparṇī gambhārī; elāparṇī nāgabalā, ahiṃsretyanye; rājādanāṃ kṣīrikā, upacitrā dantī, gopī sārivā|8|

vartikriyāḥ ṣaṭ phalavaditi “phalapippalīcūrṇāni pūrvavat” (ka.a.1) ityādinā granthena yā vartikriyā uktā madanakalpe, tadvadihāpi kṛtavedhanacūrṇānāṃ ṣaḍvartikriyāḥ kartavyāḥ| phalādīnāṃ ghṛtaṃ tathetyanena kṛtavedhanasādhitakṣīrādutthitaṃ navanītaṃ phalādikaṣāyeṇa sādhanīyaṃ madanaphalaghṛtavadityarthaḥ||8||
div.quote: vartikriyāḥ‘vartayaḥ phalavat ṣaṭ syuḥ’ iti pā. ṣaṭ phalavat, phalādīnāṃ ghṛtaṃ tathā

div.p: kośātakānītyādi| atraiva kvāthapādike kalke kartavye kṣveḍasya pūrṇo bhāgo deyaḥ, phalādīnāṃ ca pratyekaṃ kṣveḍādardhabhāgikatvam||9-10||
div.quote: taṃ kaṣāyaṃ phalādīnāṃ kalkairlehaṃ punaḥ pacet
kaṣāyaiḥ kovidārādyairevaṃ ‘kovidārādyairaṣṭābhistaṃ pṛthak pibet’ iti pā.; tat kalpayet pṛthak
kośātakyā samaṃ paktvā rasaṃ salavaṇaṃ pibet
div.p: kaṣāyeṣvityādinā sapta māṃsayogānāha| samamiti kośātakītulyaṃ māṃsam| atra pibedityantena ṣaṇmāṃsarasāḥ, phalādītyanena caikaḥ| phalādipippalītulyaṃ tadvadityanena phalādibhiḥ samaṃ māṃsam| tadvaditi vacanāt kośātakyāḥ kaṣāyeṇa sādhanīyam||11||-
ikṣurasayogamekamāha- kṣveḍamityādi| siddhamiti ikṣurasena miśritaṃ sat sādhitaṃ pibedityarthaḥ uktaṃ hi jatūkarṇe- “kṣveḍamikṣurase śṛtam” iti||12||
div.quote: kṣveḍaṃ kāsīkāsīti kāsavānityarthaḥ pibet siddhaṃ miśramikṣurasena ca
tatra ślokau- kṣīre dvau dvau surā caikā kvāthā dvāviṃśatistathā
daśa picchā ghṛtaṃ caikaṃ ṣaṭ ca vartikriyāḥ śubhāḥ
lehe+aṣṭau sapta māṃse ca yoga ikṣurase+aparaḥ
div.p: kṣīre dvau dvāvityādisaṅgrahaḥ| dvau dvāviti catvāraḥ||13-14||

div.quote: ityagniveśakṛte tantre carakapratisaṃskṛte+aprāpte dṛḍhabalasampūrite kalpasthāne kṛtavedhanakalpo nāma ṣaṣṭho+adhyāyaḥ
div.p: iti śrīcakrapāṇidattaviracitāyāṃ carakatātparyaṭīkāyāmāyurvedadīpikāyāṃ kalpasthāne kṛtavedhanakalpo nāma ṣaṣṭho+adhyāyaḥ||6||

vamanārthakalpanānantaraṃ virecanakalpeṣu vaktavyeṣu trivṛtāyā virecanadravyeṣu sukhavirecanatayā pradhānatvāt trivṛtkalpa evābhidhīyate| trivṛtābheda eva ca śyāmā, tena śyāmāyāstrivṛtāyāśca kalpaḥ śyāmātrivṛtkalpaḥ| yadyapi cāruṇamūlaiva trivṛdatrotkṛṣṭā vaktavyā, tathā+apyadhyāyasañjñāyāṃ śyāmāyā agre pāṭhenāśudoṣahantṛtayā śyāmāyāḥ prakarṣaṃ darśayati| ye cātra yogā vaktavyāste+aruṇayā vā śyāmayā vā ubhābhyāṃ vā doṣaśarīrādibalābalamavekṣya kartavyāḥ||1-2||
virecane ityādau trivṛnmūlaśabdena śyāmamūlāyā aruṇamūlāyāśca sāmānyena mūlaṃ gṛhyate||3||
div.quote: tasyāḥ sañjñā guṇāḥ karma bhedaḥ kalpaśca vakṣyate

div.p: paryāyatvena vācakaiḥ paryāyavācakaiḥ||4||
div.quote: tribhaṇḍī trivṛtā caiva ‘śyāmā suvahā koṭarā tathā; trivṛt sarvānubhūtiśca’ iti pā.; śyāmā kūṭaraṇā tathā
sarvānubhūtiḥ suvahā‘saralā’ iti pā. śabdaiḥ paryāyavācakaiḥ

div.p: sedānīmityādi| vātāpahauṣadhayogena vātahantṛtvamavidyamānaṃ bhavati, kaphapittahantṛtvaṃ vidyamānamadhikaṃ bhavatīti jñeyam| kalpavaiśeṣyamiti kalpanāviśeṣam| sarvarogahareti vyastasamastasarvadoṣārabdharogaharā||5-6||
div.quote: kaṣāyā madhurā rūkṣā vipāke kaṭukā ca sā
kalpavaiśeṣyamāsādya‘kalpe vaiśeṣyamāsādya’ iti pā. sarvarogaharā bhavet

div.p: trivṛtayorbhedamāha- mūlaṃ tu dvividhamityādi| mukhyataramiti virecanakriyāyāmevāvyāpattikaratvācchreṣṭhataram| sukumārāḥ śiśavaśca yadyapyavirecanīyā uktāstathā+api teṣāṃ vidhīyamānavirecane hitamiti jñeyam| mohayedityādinā śyāmamūlāyā guṇakarmaṇī brūte| kṣiṇvīteti dhātukṣayaṃ kuryāt||7-9||
div.quote: mūlaṃ tu dvividhaṃ tasyāḥ śyāmaṃ cāruṇameva ca
tayormukhyataraṃ‘tayoḥ śreṣṭhataraṃ’ iti pā. viddhi mūlaṃ yadaruṇaprabham
sukumāre śiśau vṛddhe mṛdukoṣṭhe ca tacchubham ‘taddhitam’ iti pā.;
mohayedāśukāritvācchyāmā kṣiṇvīta mūrcchayet ‘śyāmā kaṇṭhaṃ kṣiṇotyapi’ iti pā.;

div.p: yadyapi madanakalpa eva guṇavadbhūmijātatvādi sāmānyena bheṣajānāmuktameva, tathā+api gambhīrānugatatvādiviśeṣasya tatrānuktasyehābhidhāne sati tatprasaṅgāt tatkiñciducyate- guṇavatyāmityādi| śukle iti śuklapakṣe| gambhīrānugamiti dūrapraviṣṭam| uddharedgarbhamiti mūlasyāsthi uddharet| nidhāpayediti yathoktabhaiṣajyasthāpanavidhānena sthāpayet||10-11||

peyāmātroṣita iti pūrvadine peyāmātrāhāratayā uṣitaḥ; yadyapi cānyatra virecanapūrvadineṣu tathaivāhāro niyamitaḥ- “snehavaddravamuṣṇaṃ ca tryahaṃ bhuktvā rasaudanam” (sū.a.13) ityanena, tathā+api trivṛdvirecanaprayoge pūrvadine viśeṣavidhānāt peyādānaṃ jñeyam| kiñceyameva tadvacanāt snigdhoṣṇamāṃsarasasādhitā ca kriyamāṇā na pūrvoktasnehavaddravauṣṇamāṃsarasaudanaviruddhā bhavati|12|

div.quote: akṣamātraṃ tayoḥ piṇḍaṃ vinīyāmlena nā pibet
prasannayā triphalayā śṛtayā ca pṛthak pibet
div.p: akṣamātramityādinā navabhiramlādibhirdravyairnavayogānāha| tayoriti śyāmātrivṛdaruṇatrivṛtayoḥ| etayośca militayoḥ pratyekaṃ ca prayogā iti prāgeva pratipāditam| amleneti kāñjikena||12-13||

ekaikamityādinā saindhavādibhirdvādaśayogānāha| saindhavādayaśca dvādaśa rogabhiṣagjitīye (vi.a.8) lavaṇaskandhoktā jñeyāḥ| sanāgaramiti nāgarasahitaṃ sat pratyekaṃ saindhavādīnāṃ cūrṇaṃ dviguṇatrivṛtācūrṇayuktaṃ pātavyam||14||

div.quote: saralaḥ kilimaṃ hiṅgu bhārgī tejovatī tathā
mustaṃ haimavatī pathyā citrako rajanī vacā
svarṇakṣīryajamodā ca śṛṅgaveraṃ ca taiḥ pṛthak
div.p: pippalītyādinā pippalyādidravyabhedena mūtre+aṣṭādaśayogānāha||15-16||-
madhuketyādinaikaḥ prayogaḥ| ayaṃ ca saṅgrahoktayoḥ ‘yaṣṭyāṃ dvau’ ityanayorekataraḥ||17||
jīvaketyādinā caturdaśayogān tathā yaṣṭyāhvamityekaṃ cāha| ayaṃ ca saṅgrahoktayoḥ ‘yaṣṭyāṃ dvau’ iti dvayoranyataraḥ| kṣīraśuklā kṣīravidārī| indrā kokilākṣaḥ| payasyā arkapuṣpī||18-19||-
div.quote: kākolīṃ kṣīrakākolīmindrāṃ ‘kṣudrāṃ’ iti, ‘citrāṃ’ iti ca pā.; chinnaruhāṃ tathā
kṣīraśuklāṃ payasyāṃ ca yaṣṭyāhvaṃ vidhinā pibet

div.p: kṣīretyādinā kṣīrādau sapta yogānāha| pīlu auttarapathikaṃ phalam||20||-

lihyādvā madhvityādinā+aṣṭau lehānāha| lihyādvetyādinā prathamo lehaḥ| ajagandhetyādinā dvitīyaḥ| ajagandhā ajamodā| śyāmātrivṛdityādinā tṛtīyo lehaḥ| atra śarkarātrivṛccūrṇābhyāṃ samābhyāṃ kvāthapādikābhyāṃ lehaḥ| sakṣaudrāmityādinā caturthaḥ| atra kṣaudrapāko yogamahimnā| trivṛccūrṇamātrāpādikatvaṃ tvakpatrādīnāṃ, saugandhamātraprayojanatvāt ‘trivṛccūrṇamatra pādikaṃ, tvakpatrādīni saugandhamātraprayojanatvādalpāni’ iti pā.; | īśvarāṇāṃ virecanamiti vacanena sukumāratvādasnigdhaviṣayatāmasya darśayati, īśvarā hi prāyeṇa sukumārāḥ snigdhāśca bhavanti| kuḍavāṃśānityādiḥ pañcamaḥ| atra trivṛccūrṇamanirdiṣṭamānaṃ, tacca prakṣepanyāyāllehāt pādikaṃ kartavyam| utsannapittānām udbhūtapittānām| śarkaretyādinā sitāyogāṃścaturo+atideśānuguṇyāllehānāṃ madhya evāha| atra vartyādayo+api śarkarākṛtā eva jñeyāḥ| anena vidhineti ikṣvādirasasaṃskāreṇa trivṛccūrṇayogena ca| pippalīṃ nāgaramityādinā ṣaṣṭho lehaḥ| madhyamiti amlakapitthasya madhyaṃ bhāgam| amlaṃ ca yat phalamiti mātuluṅgādi| pūrvavaditi kauḍavikatvaṃ mātuluṅgādirasānāṃ darśayati||21-32||
div.quote: kṣipecchīte‘dadyācchīte’ iti pā. trivṛccūrṇaṃ tvakpatramaricaiḥ saha
mātrayā‘lihyāttaṃ mātrayā lehaṃ’ iti pā. lehayedetadīśvarāṇāṃ virecanam
pippalīṃ nāgaraṃ kṣāraṃ śyāmāṃ trivṛtayā saha
lehayenmadhunā sārdhaṃ śleṣmalānāṃ‘ślaiṣmikāṇāṃ’ iti pā. virecanam
sahakārāt kapitthācca madhyamamlaṃ ca yat phalam

div.p: pānakānītyādinā+atideśānuguṇyāt pānakādipañcayogānāha| rāgapradhānaḥ ṣāḍavo rāgaṣāḍavaḥ| anena vidhineti pūrvalehoktavidhinā||33||
bhṛṅgailābhyāmityādinā tarpaṇayogaṃ prathamamevāha, dvitīyastu tarpaṇayogo bhaviṣyatīti| bhṛṅgaṃ guḍatvak| taiśca śarkareti bhṛṅgalānīlītrivṛdbhiḥ| phalarasaḥ dāḍimarasaḥ||34-35||
śarkaretyādinā modakaḥ prathamaḥ| tatra ca “modake dviguṇo guḍaḥ” iti vacanāt guḍaśarkarāṃ cūrṇāddviguṇāmicchanti||36||
trivṛcchāṇā ityādineha modake ca yadyapi paṭhyate yogaḥ, tathā+apyasya lehenaiva grahaṇādayamaṣṭamo leho bhavati||37-39||
div.quote: lihyāt sarpirmadhubhyāṃ ca modakaṃ vā guḍena tu
gulmaṃ plīhodaraṃ śvāsaṃ‘kāsaṃ’ iti pā. halīmakamarocakam
asvapnaṃ gātraśūlaṃ ca kāsaṃ śvāsaṃ bhramaṃ kṣayam
div.p: viḍaṅgetyādinā dvitīyo modakaḥ||40-45||

vyoṣetyādinā tṛtīyo modakaḥ| ayaṃ modakastantrāntare ‘abhayādya’ iti khyātaḥ| mukūlakaṃ dantī| atra mukūlādīnāmekaikadravyāpekṣayā dvaiguṇyādi bhavati| madhu ca tāvanmātraṃ yāvatā modako bhavati| kecidatra vyoṣādimilitacūrṇāddantyādīnāṃ dvaiguṇyaṃ vadanti||46-49||-
div.quote: vyoṣatvakpatramustailāviḍaṅgāmalakābhayāḥ ‘... malakān samān; trivṛto+aṣṭaguṇaṃ bhāgaṃ’ iti pā.;
mūtrakṛcchre jvare vamyāṃ kāse śvāse bhrame kṣaye
yogaḥ sarvaviṣāṇāṃ ca mataḥ śreṣṭho‘śreṣṭhaṃ virecanam’ iti pā. virecane

div.p: pathyetyādinā caturthaḥ||50||-
trivṛddhaimavatītyādinā pañcamo modakaḥ pūryate| veṣṭayediti avacūrṇayet||51-55||

trivṛtāṃ kauṭajamityādinā ṣaḍṛtuvihitān yogān rūkṣāṇāmapi śasyate ityantenāha| sātalā carmakaśā| jaladātyaye śaradi| hemante yadyapi prabalaśītavāte virecanaṃ niṣiddhaṃ, tathā+api vyādhiviṣayavihitaṃ virecanametajjñeyam| sarvartukayogau anukte ṛtau vasantādau ca jñeyau| trivṛcchyāmetyādiko+api sarvartuko yogaḥ| tryūṣaṇamityādiścūrṇayogo dvitīyaḥ||56-64||
div.quote: svarṇakṣīrīṃ ca hemante piṣṭvā tūṣṇāmbunā pibet
trivṛttrāyantihapuṣāḥ sātalāṃ kaṭurohiṇīm ‘hapuṣāṃ saptalāṃ śyāmāṃ dravantīṃ kaṭurohiṇīm’ iti pā.;
nīlinī triphalā mustaṃ kaṭukā ca sucūrṇitam
pibet sukhatamaṃ‘pibedetatsarvakālaṃ’ iti pā. hyetadrūkṣāṇāmapi śasyate

div.p: trivṛtāṃ triphalāmityādikastarpaṇayogaḥ| evaṃ sarvartukayogena samaṃ dvau tarpaṇayogau bhavataḥ||65||-

tulyāmlamityekaṃ ghṛtaṃ, śyāmetyādi dvitīyaṃ, śyāmātrivṛtkaṣāyeṇetyādi tṛtīyam| sādhitaṃ cetyādinā kṣīrayogamekamāha| ghṛtena kṣīreṇa ca ghṛtena kṣīreṇa vaikena militvā catvāro ghṛtakṣīrairbhavanti||66-68||
div.quote: jale tena kaṣāyeṇa‘niryūheṇa tayoryuktyā’ iti pā. paktvā sarpiḥ pibennaraḥ
sādhitaṃ vā payastābhyāṃ sukhaṃ tena viricyate

div.p: trivṛnmuṣṭīnityādinā prathamā surā, surāṃ vetyādinā dvitīyā, evaṃ dvau surāyogau bhavataḥ| trivṛdyogayuktaṃ kiṇvaṃ yasyāṃ sā tathā||69-71||
div.quote: pralipte madhunā‘vidhinā’ iti pā. māsaṃ jātaṃ tanmātrayā pibet
surāṃ vā trivṛtāyogakiṇvāṃ ‘trivṛtākiṇvāṃ pibettatkvāthasaṃyutām’ iti pā.; tatkvāthasaṃyutām

div.p: yavairityādinā sauvīrakatuṣodake prāha| etau dvau kāñjikayogau| kulmāṣa utsvinnayavapiṣṭakam| palle iti dhānyādirāśau| taccūrṇasaṃyutāniti trivṛccūrṇasaṃyutān| tadvaditi ṣaḍahaṃ palle sthitāna||72-73||
div.quote: āsutaṃ ṣaḍahaṃ palle jātaṃ sauvīrakaṃ pibet
bhṛṣṭān vā satuṣāñchuddhān‘kṣuṇṇān’ iti pā. yavāṃstaccūrṇasaṃyutān

div.p: tathetyādinā ṣāḍavādiyogān daśāha| daśa ṣāḍavādayo “badaraṣāḍavarāgalehamodakotkārikātarpaṇaśākamāṃsarasayūṣamadyānāṃ” (ka.a.1) iti granthena madanakalpoktāḥ||74||
samprati daśottaraṃ yogaśatamabhidhāya vāntinirāsārthaṃ kṛtyatrayeṇa samaṃ virecanaprayogānāha- tvakkeśaretyādi||75-76||
eko+amlādibhirityādisaṅgraho vyaktārthaḥ| yaṣṭyāṃ dvāviti ‘yaṣṭyāhvaṃ vidhinā’ iti jīvakādāvekaḥ, madhuketyādinā cāparaḥ||77-80||
div.quote: tatra ślokāḥ- eko+amlādibhiraṣṭau ca daśa dvau saindhavādibhiḥ
mūtre+aṣṭādaśa yaṣṭyāṃ‘yaṣṭyā’ iti pā. dvau jīvakādau caturdaśa
kṣīrādau sapta lehe+aṣṭau catvāraḥ sitayā+api ca
catvāraśca ghṛte kṣīre dvau cūrṇe tarpaṇe tathā
dvau madye kāñjike dvau ca daśānye ṣāḍavādiṣu
ityagniveśakṛte tantre carakapratisaṃskṛte+aprāpte dṛḍhabalasampūrite kalpasthāne śyāmātrivṛtkalpo nāma saptamo+adhyāyaḥ
div.p: iti śrīcakrapāṇidattaviracitāyāmāyurvedadīpikāyāṃ carakatātparyaṭīkāyāṃ kalpasthāne śyāmātrivṛtkalpo nāma saptamo+adhyāyaḥ||7||
śyāmātrivṛtkalpānantaraṃ mṛduvirecanatvasāmānyāccaturaṅgulakalpo+abhidhīyate||1-2||
vyavahārārthaṃ paryāyānāha- āragvadha ityādi||3||
adhikaṃ pathya iti jvarādiṣu viśeṣeṇa virecanaprayoge hitaḥ||4-5||
div.quote: bāle vṛddhe kṣate kṣīṇe sukumāre ca mānave

div.p: phalakāle iti ucitaphalakāle| teṣāmiti phalānām| bhāramiti bhūridravyopalakṣaṇam| majjānamiti phalamajjānam||6-7||
div.quote: phalakāle ‘recanārthe pariṇataṃ phalaṃ tasyāharedbudhaḥ’ iti pā.; phalaṃ tasya grāhyaṃ pariṇataṃ ca yat
teṣaṃ guṇavatāṃ bhāraṃ‘jātaṃ’ iti, ‘sāraṃ’ iti ca pā. sikatāsu nidhāpayet

div.p: drākṣetyādiḥ prathamo yogaḥ| caturvarṣamukhe bāle yāvaddvādaśavārṣike ityanenāsya prayogasya caturvarṣādarvāgūrdhvaṃ ca dvādaśavarṣādavaśyatayā yaugikatvaṃ niṣedhayati||8||-
surāmaṇḍeneti dvitīyaḥ| athavā kolasīdhuneti tṛtīyaḥ| kolakṛtaḥ sīdhuḥ kolasīdhuḥ| sauvīrakeṇa vetyantena yogatrayamaparaṃ vyaktam||9-10||
div.quote: dadhimaṇḍena vā yuktaṃ‘samyak’ iti pā. rasenāmalakasya vā
kṛtvā śītakaṣāyaṃ taṃ‘vā’ iti pā. pibet sauvīrakeṇa vā

div.p: trivṛto vā kaṣāyeṇa majjñaḥ kalkaṃ tathā pibediti saptamaḥ| tathetyādinā+aṣṭamaḥ| etatkalkakaṣāyayordvayaṃ‘kaṣāye yogadvayam’ iti pā. jatūkarṇe+apyuktameva- ‘trivṛdbilvakaṣāyābhyāṃ sakṣaudralavaṇau dvau’ iti| tenātra pāṭhāntaraṃ na pramāṇam| saṅgrahe ca kariṣyati- ‘kaṣāye ca trivṛto bilvakasya ca’ iti||11||
div.quote: trivṛto ‘trivṛnmajjñostathā kalkaṃ tatkaṣāyeṇa vā pibet’ iti pā.; vā kaṣāyeṇa majjñaḥ kalkaṃ tathā pibet

div.p: kaṣāyeṇetyādiko leho navamaḥ||12||

div.quote: majjñaḥ kalkena dhātrīṇāṃ rase tatsādhitaṃ pibet
div.p: caturaṅguletyādinā prathamaṃ ghṛtam| majjña iti caturaṅgulamajjñaḥ||13||
tadevetyādinā ca dvitīyaṃ ghṛtam| śyāmādibhiriti madanakalpapaṭhitairnavabhiḥ ‘śyāmātrivṛddantī ... ’ (ka.a.1) ityādibhiḥ||14||
div.quote: kaṣāye sādhitaṃ sarpiḥ kalkaiḥ śyāmādibhiḥ pibet

div.p: dantītyādinā+ariṣṭayogamāha| guḍasya cāñjalimiti sambandhaḥ| māsārdhamāsasthamiti sārdhamāsastham||15||
div.quote: dattvā māsārdhamāsasthamariṣṭaṃ pāyayeta‘pāyayedbhiṣak’ iti pā. ca

div.p: yasya yadityādinā+anuktamaparāparasādhanaṃ vidhatte| hṛdyena hi virecanayogasya priyatā syāt| pānamannaṃ ceti hṛdyamityādibhiḥ pratyekaṃ sambadhyate||16||
div.quote: yasya yat pānamannaṃ‘pānamamlaṃ ca’ iti pā. ca hṛdyaṃ svādvatha vā kaṭu

div.p: drākṣetyādisaṅgraho vyaktaḥ||17-18||
div.quote: sauvīrake kaṣāye ca trivṛto bilvakasya ‘sauvīrake+atha trivṛtaḥ kaṣāye tilvakasya ca’ iti, ‘sauvīrake kaṣāyābhyāṃ bilvaśampākayostathā’ iti ca pā.; ca
lehe+ariṣṭe ghṛte dve ca yogā dvādaśa kīrtitāḥ
ityagniveśakṛte tantre carakapratisaṃskṛte+aprāpte dṛḍhabalasampūrite kalpasthāne caturaṅgulakalpo nāmāṣṭamo+adhyāyaḥ
div.p: iti śrīcakrapāṇidattaviracitāyāmāyurvedadīpikāyāṃ carakatātparyaṭīkāyāṃ kalpasthāne caturaṅgulakalpo nāmāṣṭamo+adhyāyaḥ||8||
caturaṅgulavattilvakasyānapāyitvāccaturaṅgulakalpānantaraṃ tilvakakalpo+abhidhīyate||1-2||

antarvalkalavarjitāmiti tilvakasyāntarvalkalaṃ kaṭhinaṃ bhavati, tadarthaṃ tadvarjanam| ścotayediti vacanena ṣaḍguṇadraveṇaikaviṃśativārān srāvayediti jñeyaṃ, madanaphalakalpe evambhūtasyaiva srāvaṇasya dṛṣṭatvāt| bhāvanāvidhiśca nirantaraṃ vyākṛta eva||3-5||
div.quote: cūrṇayettu tridhā kṛtvā dvau bhāgau ścotayettataḥ
bhāgaṃ taṃ daśamūlasya punaḥ‘kaṣāye bhāvitaṃ punaḥ’ iti pā. kvāthena bhāvayet
śuṣkaṃ cūrṇaṃ punaḥ kṛtvā tata‘snigdhasvinne pradāpayet’ iti pā. ūrdhvaṃ prayojayet

div.p: dadhimaṇḍetyādinā pibedityantena pañca yogāḥ||6||
meṣaśṛṅgītyādinā viśiṣṭasauvīrakeṇa yoga ekaḥ| marujā bhṛṣṭayavāḥ||7||-
surāmityādinā surāyogamāha| dantītyādinaikamariṣṭayogamāha| dantīcitrakayorāḍhakaṃ pṛthak saliladroṇe pacet| tilvakacūrṇamāvāpaḥ||8-9||-
div.quote: āvapettat paraṃ pakṣānmadyapānāṃ‘madyapānādvi...’ iti pā. virecanam

div.p: kampillaketyādinā kampillakayogamāha| kampillakaḥ guṇḍārocanikā| mātrāmiti tilvakacūrṇamātrām||10||-
div.quote: kampillakakaṣāyeṇa‘tilvakasya kaṣāyeṇa’ iti pā. daśakṛtvaḥ subhāvitām

div.p: caturaṅguletyādinā prathamo lehaḥ| caturaṅgulakalpeneti ‘kaṣāyeṇāthavā tasya’ (ka.a.8) ityādinoktavidhānena| tenātra tilvakakvāthena guḍānvitatrivṛccūrṇaṃ paktvā lehaḥ kartavyaḥ| triphalāyā ityādinā dvitīyo lehaḥ| tilvakasyetyādinā tṛtīyaḥ||11-13||
div.quote: lodhracūrṇayutaḥ siddho lehaḥ śreṣṭho‘śreṣṭhaṃ virecanam’ iti pā. virecane
saghṛtaḥ sādhito lehaḥ sa ca śreṣṭho‘śreṣṭhaṃ virecanam’ iti pā. virecane

div.p: aṣṭāṣṭāvityādinā prathamaṃ ghṛtam| sanakhāniti vidyamānanakhān| atra trivṛdādigṛhītalodhrasya ‘trivṛtādigṛhīte lodhre lodhrasya pradhānatvāt’ iti pā.; pradhānatvāddviguṇo bhāgo bhavati| uktaṃ hi jatūkarṇe- “trivṛdādidviguṇo lodhrakvāthaḥ” iti| samabhāgatve tu lodhraprayogatvasya kena viśeṣaḥ syāt, tasmād yathāvyākhyātameva sādhu| lavaṇamapyatra palāṃśameva| lodhretyādi dvitīyaṃ ghṛtam| caturaṅguletyādinā ghṛtadvayamatidiśyate| evaṃ ghṛtena catvāro yogā bhavanti| caturaṅgulaghṛte ca “caturaṅgulasiddhāt” (ka.a.8) ityādinā, tathā “tadeva daśamūlasya” (ka.a.8) ityādinā prokte jñeye; tathā ca caturaṅgulakalpena lodhrādinā dve lodhraghṛte bhavataḥ||14-16||
div.quote: droṇe+apāṃ sādhayet pādaśeṣe prasthaṃ ghṛtāt pacet
tatra ślokau- pañca dadhyādibhistvekā surā sauvīrakeṇa ca
div.p: pañca dadhyādibhirityādisaṅgraho vyaktaḥ||17-18||

div.quote: ityagniveśakṛte tantre carakapratisaṃskṛte+aprāpte dṛḍhabalasampūrite kalpasthāne tilvakakalpo nāma navamo+adhyāyaḥ
div.p: iti śrīcakrapāṇidattaviracitāyāmāyurvedadīpikāyāṃ carakatātparyaṭīkāyāṃ kalpasthāne tilvakakalpo nāma navamo+adhyāyaḥ||9||

ṣoḍaśasaṅkhyaprayogābhidhāyakatilvakakalpānantaraṃ yathākramamadhikasaṅkhyāprayogābhidhānakramādviṃśatiyogābhidhāyakasudhākalpo+abhidhīyate; itaścānantaramatiriktasaṅkhyābhidhānakrameṇaiva ūnacatvāriṃśatprayogābhidhāyakasaptalāśaṅkhinīkalpo+abhidhāsyate||1-2||

virecanānāmiti virecanadravyāṇām| kaṣṭavibhrameti duḥkhasādhyavibhramajanikā| tasmāditi atitīkṣṇatvāt kaṣṭavibhramatvācca| sati mārgaparikrama iti upakramamārgāntare sati na sudhā prayoktavyā, tena gatyantarāsambhava eva sudhā prayoktavyetyarthaḥ||3-4||
div.quote: na doṣanicaye cālpe sati mārgaparikrame‘cānyaparikrame’ iti pā.

div.p: pāṇḍurogetyādau madhumehaśabdena pramehā evocyante; viśiṣṭastu vātikamadhumeho+asādhya eva, tena taṃ prati virecanopadeśo+anarthaka eva syāt; madhumehaśabdaśca yathā pramohamātra eva vartate tat pratipāditameva pramehacikitsite| doṣavṛddhyā vibhrāntaṃ ceto yasmin tasmin doṣavibhrāntacetasi unmāde| saprāṇamiti balavantam||5-6||-
div.quote: sadyo harati‘nudati’ iti pā. doṣāṇāṃ mahāntamapi sañcayam

div.p: pravaro bahukaṇṭaka iti anatitīkṣṇatayā+alpakaṇṭakamahāvṛkṣataḥ śreṣṭha ityarthaḥ| tāviti svalpakaṇṭakabahukaṇṭakau mahāvṛkṣau| yadyapi madanakalpe “śaradi tvakkandakṣīrāṇi” (ka.a.1) ityuktaṃ, tathā+api sudhāyā ‘sudhāṃ prāpya’ iti pā.; atra śiśirānte kṣīragrahaṇamapavādarūpaṃ jñeyam| śiśirasya śeṣā divasāḥ śiśirāntāḥ||7-9||
div.quote: sa nāmnā snugguḍā nandā sudhā nistriṃśapatrakaḥ
tau‘taṃ’ iti pā. vipāṭyāharet kṣīraṃ śastreṇa matimān bhiṣak
dvivarṣaṃ vā trivarṣaṃ vā śiśirānte viśeṣataḥ

div.p: bilvādīnāmiti bilvādipañcamūlasya| aṅgāreṣu śoṣayediti aṅgāroparisthitapātrasthaṃ tat sudhākṣīraṃ bilvādīnāmanyatamasya kaṣāyeṇa samānaṃ śoṣaṇena kaṭhinaṃ kuryāt; tataḥ kolamātrā guṭikāḥ kāryāḥ, tataḥ sauvīrakādīnāmanyatamena pātavyā| evaṃ sauvīrakādibhedāt sapta yogā bhavanti; tathā+atra bilvādikaṣāyasya bhedena bhedo na vivakṣitaḥ||10-11||-
div.quote: tataḥ‘kolapramāṇāṃ guṭikāṃ pibet sauvīrakeṇa tām’ iti pā. kolasamāṃ mātrāṃ pibet sauvīrakeṇa vā

div.p: sātalāmityādinā vātasādhanaghṛtamāṃsarasabhedādyogadvayamāha| sātalā carmakaśā| śyāmādigrahaṇenaiva sātalāyāmapi labdhāyāṃ pṛthak sātalābhidhānamekayā+api sātalayā kṛtasudhāyogasya prādhānyakhyāpanārtham||12-13||
div.quote: sātalāṃ kāñcanakṣīrīṃ śyāmādīni kaṭutrikam ‘phalatrikam’ iti pā.;
tryūṣaṇaṃ triphalāṃ dantīṃ citrakaṃ trivṛtāṃ tathā
div.p: tryūṣaṇamityādinā pānakayogamāha| guḍapānakamiti guḍasaṃskṛtapānakam||14||
trivṛtetyādinā ghreyayogamāha| gomūtre rajanīṃ kṛtveti rajanīṃ vyāpya gomūtre sthāpayitvā| paṭameveti yathoktavidhibhāvitaṃ paṭamāvṛtyetyarthaḥ||15-17||
div.quote: gomūtre rajanīṃ kṛtvā‘niśi sthitaṃ gavāṃ mūtre’ iti pā. śoṣayedātape tataḥ
gandhamālyaṃ tadāghrāya‘samāghrāya’ iti pā. prāvṛtya paṭameva ca

div.p: śyāmetyādinā lehayogamāha| mātrayeti anapāyimātrayā||18||
div.quote: lehaṃ paktvā‘kṛtvā’ iti pā. virekārthaṃ lehayenmātrayā naram

div.p: pāyayedityādinā pṛthagyūṣamāṃsarasaghṛtairyogatrayamāha|19|
bhāvitānityādinā śuṣkamatsyamāṃsayogāvāha||19||

div.quote: surāṃ vā kārayet kṣīre ghṛtaṃ vā pūrvavat pacet
div.p: kṣīreṇetyādinā ekaṃ ghṛtam| ghṛtaṃ vetyādinā ekaṃ vakṣyati| āmalakaiścaturaṅgulavaditi vacanādāmalakarasayuktaṃ yaccaturaṅgulakalpe “caturaṅgulasiddhādvā” (ka.a.8) ityādinoktaṃ tasya vidhānamatidiśati| surāṃ vā kārayet kṣīre iti snukkṣīrabhāvitamityādividhinā surāṃ kuryāt| ghṛtaṃ vā pūrvavat pacedityatra pūrvavadityanena tilvakakalpe pūrvaṃ yat “lodhrakalkena” (ka.a.9) ityādigranthavihitaṃ, tadvidhireva pratyāsannatvādatidiśyate||20||

div.quote: tatra ślokau- sauvīrakādibhiḥ sapta sarpiṣā ca rasena ca
dvau śuṣkamatsyamāṃsābhyāṃ suraikā dve ca sarpiṣī
div.p: sauvīraketyādiḥ saṅgraho vyākṛta eva||21-22||

div.quote: ityagniveśakṛte tantre carakapratisaṃskṛte+aprāpte dṛḍhabalasampūrite kalpasthāne sudhākalpo nāma daśamo+adhyāyaḥ
div.p: iti śrīcakrapāṇidattaviracitāyāmāyurvedadīpikāyāṃ carakatātparyaṭīkāyāṃ kalpasthāne sudhākalpo nāma daśamo+adhyāyaḥ||10||
pūrvādhyāyoktasambandhādeva saptalāśaṅkhinīkalpo+abhidhīyate| iha cādhyāye ye yogā abhidhīyante te saptalayā vā śaṅkhinyā vā ubhābhyāṃ vā sampādyante śyāmātrivṛdyogavat||1-3||
div.quote: saptalā carmasāhvā ca bahuphenarasā ca sā

div.p: te gulmetyādi| te saptalāśaṅkhinyau||4-5||

akṣamātramityādinā kalkasya prasannālavaṇayuktasya priyālādikaṣāyeṣu ṣoḍaśayogā bhavanti| atra yadyapi maireyaikṣavau na kaṣāyau tathā+api bahukaṣāyāntargatatvāt kaṣāyāveva vaktavyau, saṅgrahe ‘kaṣāyā daśa ṣaṭ’ ityanena vyapadiṣṭau| kaṣāyaśabdena kalkakaṣāyo+abhipretaḥ| karkandhūkolabadaraśabdena triprakārabadaragrahaṇam||6-8||
div.quote: hṛdroge kaphavātotthe‘hṛdrogakaphavātārte’ iti pā. gulme caiva prayojayet
sīdhau cāpyeṣa kalpaḥ syāt sukhaṃ śīghravirecanaḥ

div.p: tailamityādinā prathamastailayogaḥ| trivṛcchyāmārdhabhāgike iti saptalāśaṅkhinīkalkayorardhabhāgena trivṛcchyāmākalko deyaḥ| śaṅkhinītyādinā pañcatailayogānāha, evaṃ ṣaṭtailayogā bhavanti| tailaṃ tatpīḍitamiti śaṅkhinīcūrṇaṃ tilacūrṇaṃ ca harītakīkaṣāyeṇa sandhāya‘sannīya’ iti pā. pīḍitaṃ tat tailaṃ pibediti| atasyādiṣveṣa saṃvidhiriti vacanena tilasthāne+atasyādīnāṃ prayogaṃ vidhatte||9-11||
div.quote: dadhimaṇḍena sannīya siddhaṃ tat pāyayeta ca
śaṅkhinīcūrṇabhāgau dvau tilacūrṇasya ‘nīlīcūrṇasya cāparaḥ’ iti pā.; cāparaḥ

div.p: śaṅkhinīsaptaletyādi prathamaṃ ghṛtam| dantīdravantyorityādinā dvidvidravyakalkena saptalāśaṅkhinīkalkārdhena pūrvaghṛtavatpākācca pañcaghṛtayogā apare| dravantī dantībhedaḥ| ajaśṛṅgī viṣāṇikā| kṣīriṇī dugdhikā| masūravidalā śyāmalatā| pratyakparṇī mūṣikaparṇī| dvivargārdhāṃśakalkeneti dantyādidvivargaśaṅkhinīsaptalārdhabhāgikena kalkena| śaṅkhinītyādinā saptamaṃ ghṛtaṃ, trivṛtkalkenetyādyaṣṭamaṃ ghṛtam| atra tvadhikṛtatvāt saptalāśaṅkhinyordviguṇaḥ kaṣāyo vidhīyate| lodhravaditi lodhrakalpavat; lodhrakalpe yathā trayo lehāḥ “caturaṅgulakalpena” (ka.a.9) ityādinoktāḥ, tena lodhrasthāne saptalāśaṅkhinīyogaḥ kartavyaḥ| tathā surāyogaḥ kampillayogaśca lodhravaditi atrāpi lodhrasthāne saptalāśaṅkhinīprakṣepaḥ kartavyaḥ||12-16||
div.quote: kṣīreṇāloḍya sampakvaṃ‘vipacet’ iti pā. pibettacca virecanam
kṣīriṇyā nīlikāyāśca‘syāt kṣīriṇīnīlikayoḥ’ iti pā. tathaiva ca karañjayoḥ
trivṛtkalpena sarpiśca trayo lehāśca lodhravat ‘pūrvavat’ iti pā.;

div.p: dantīdravantyorityādinā sandhānacatuṣṭayamāha| etat sandhānacatuṣṭayaṃ pūrvasurāyogena samaṃ ‘pañca madye” iti vacanena saṅgrahagṛhītaṃ; sauvīrakādīnāṃ ca madyaśabdenābhidhānamihāsūtatvasāmānyājjñeyam| dantīdravantyoḥ kalpeneti anāgatāvekṣaṇena dantīdravantīkalpe sauvīrakatuṣodake ye vaktavye tadvidhānamihāpyatidiśati| tatra “ajagandhākaṣāyeṇa sauvīrakatuṣodake” (ka.a.12) iti vaktavyaṃ, tenehāpyajagandhākaṣāyayuktasaptalāśaṅkhinyoḥ sauvīrakatuṣodake kartavye| atra “tathā dantīdravantyośca kaṣāye sājagandhayoḥ| gauḍaḥ kāryo+ajaśṛṅgyā ca sa vai sukhavirecanaḥ” (ka.a.12) ityanenoktasya gauḍāriṣṭasya dantīdravantīkalpoktasya vidhānamatidiśati||17||
div.quote: ajagandhājaśṛṅgyośca tadvat‘kārye syātāṃ’ iti pā. syātāṃ virecane
tatra ślokau- kaṣāyā daśa ṣaṭ caiva ṣaṭ taile+aṣṭau ca sarpiṣi
pañca madye trayo lehā yogaḥ kampillake tathā
yogāḥ siddhāḥ samastābhyāmekaśo+api ca te hitāḥ
div.p: kaṣāyā ityādisaṅgraho vyākṛtaḥ||18-19||
iti śrīcakrapāṇidattaviracitāyāmāyurvedadīpikāyāṃ carakatātparyaṭīkāyāṃ kalpasthāne saptalāśaṅkhinīkalpo nāmaikādaśo+adhyāyaḥ||11||
div.quote: ityagniveśakṛte tantre carakapratisaṃskṛte+aprāpte dṛḍhabalasampūrite kalpasthāne saptalāśaṅkhinīkalpo nāmaikādaśo+adhyāyaḥ

div.p: pāriśeṣyāt dantīdravantīkalpo+abhidhīyate||1-2||
tayoḥ paryāyānāha- dantītyādi||3||
div.quote: pratyakśreṇī sutaśreṇī dantī ra(ca)ṇḍā ca kīrtitā ayaṃ ślokaḥ kvacitpustake na paṭhyate; )

div.p: sthirāṇīti sārabhūtāni| bahalānīti ghanatvakkāni| hastidantaprakārāṇīti antapūrvopacitāni| śyāvatāmrāṇīti yathākrameṇa dantyāḥ śyāvāni, dravantyāstāmrāṇi||4||

svedayenmṛtkuśāntara iti pippalīmadhukakalkābhyāṃ parilipya kuśaiḥ pariveṣṭya tato mṛdāvaliptāni svedayet| agnisvedātapaśoṣaṇaphalamāha- agnyarkau hato hyeṣāṃ vikāśitāmiti|- eṣāṃ dantīdravantīmūlānāṃ vikāśitālakṣaṇaṃ guṇaṃ svedopaśoṣaṇābhyāmagnyarkau hataḥ; tena nātidoṣāṇi dantīdravantīmūlāni syuriti bhāvaḥ||5||

div.quote: vilāyayanti doṣau dvau mārutaṃ kopayanti ca
div.p: tīkṣṇoṣṇānītyādinā teṣāṃ guṇakathanam| doṣau dvāviti pittaśleṣmāṇau||6||

dadhītyādinā saptabhirdravyaiḥ saptaprayogānāha| śīdhuśabdaḥ priyālādibhiścaturbhiḥ pṛthak sambadhyate| abhikhinna iti ākrāntaḥ| gomṛgājarasairityatrāpi ‘piṇḍamakṣasamaṃ tayoḥ’ ityanuvartate| atrāpi gavādirasaistribhistrayaḥ prayogā bhavanti| tayorityādinā trīn snehayogānāha| anayoḥ kalkakaṣāyeṇa daśamūlarasatulyabhāgena ghṛtaṃ pacedvisarpādiṣu, tailaṃ tu pūrvavanmehādiṣu, catuḥ snehaṃ tu śakṛcchukravātasaṅgādiṣu| rase ityādinā eko lehaḥ| vātatarṣe ityādinā dvitīyaḥ| sa evājagandhayetyanena pūrvoktalehe evājaśṛṅgīsthāne+ajagandhādānaṃ viśiṣṭaṃ khyāpayati| dantītyādinā tṛtīyo lehaḥ| bhāgaśa iti pratyekabhāgagrahaṇena| evametadantaiḥ prayogairādyaḥ ṣoḍaśako bhavet||7-14||
div.quote: pibedgulmodarī doṣairabhikhinnaśca ‘doṣairabhiṣyaṇṇaśca’ iti pā.; yo naraḥ
kakṣyālajīvisarpeṣu‘visarpālajikakṣyāsu’ iti pā. dāhe ca vipacedghṛtam
tailaṃ mehe ca gulme ca sodāvarte kaphānile
lehaḥ siddho virekārthe dāhasantāpamehanut ‘deyaḥ santāpamehanut’ iti pā.;
vātatarṣe jvare paitte syāt sa evājagandhayā
trīṃstu tasya kaṣāyasya bhāgau dvau phāṇitasya ca
tapte sarpiṣi taile vā bharjayettatra cāvapet

div.p: rase cetyādai evamityanena pūrvoktalehatrayamatidiśati| tayorityādikaścaturthaḥ; tayoriti dantīdravantīmūlayoḥ| asṛṣṭe iti vibaddhe| pāṭayitvetyādinā pañcamaḥ| kalkenālipya cāntareti dantīdravantīkalkena pāṭitekṣukāṇḍamadhye ālipya| mūlaṃ dantītyādinā+aṣṭau kṛtākṛtarasānāha| atra lāvavartīrakādayaḥ “lāvo vartīrakaścaiva vārtīkaḥ sakapiñjalaḥ| cakoraścopacakraśca kakubho raktacarmakaḥ” (sū.a.27) iti granthenāṣṭāvuktāḥ; teṣāṃ pratyekayogādaṣṭau rasā bhavanti| tayorvā+apītyādinā yavāgūjāṅgalarasayogaṃ māṣayūṣayogaṃ cāha| evametairdravaiḥ pūrvayogaiśca militvā dvitīyaḥ ṣoḍaśako bhavet||15-19||
div.quote: rase ca daśamūlasya tathā baibhītake rase
harītakīrase caiva lehānevaṃ pacet pṛthak‘bhiṣak’ iti pā.
asṛṣṭe viśi vātotthe gulme cāmlayutaṃ śubham
svedayitvā tataḥ‘naraḥ’ iti pā. khādet sukhaṃ tena viricyate
lāvavartīrakādyaiśca‘lāvatittirikābhyāṃ ca’ iti pā. te rasāḥ syurvirecane
māṣayūṣaṃ‘māṃsaṃ yūṣāṃśca’ iti pā. ca saṃskṛtya dadyāttaiśca viricyate

div.p: tatkaṣāyādityādinā utkārikāyogaṃ modakayogaṃ cāha| tatkaṣāyāditi dantīdravantīkaṣāyāt| modakakaraṇe+api tatkaṣāyāttrayo bhāgā ityādividhānamanuvartate| tayoścāpi kaṣāyeṇa madyānīti tṛtīyaḥ| dantītyādinā bhakṣyayogaścaturthaḥ| dantīṃ dravantīṃ maricamityādikaḥ pañcamaḥ| hemadugdhā svarṇakṣīrī| cūrṇitamityantaṃ pibediti sambandhaḥ| palamityādikaḥ ṣaṣṭhaḥ| harītakyāśca viṃśatiriti ākṛtimānena| ayaṃ yogastantrāntare “agastyamodaka” iti khyātaḥ| dantīdvipaletyādikaḥ saptamaḥ| atra dantīdvipaladrākṣārdhaprasthayoḥ kvāthaḥ kartavyaḥ| dantīkalkamityādiko+aṣṭamaḥ| śyāmetyādiko navamaḥ| gauḍa iti guḍaprakṛtikaḥ| lipte ityatra ‘ghaṭe’ iti śeṣaḥ| tathā dantīdravantyoścetyādiko daśamaḥ| tathetyanena pūrvayogoktapippalyādighaṭāvalepa atidiśyate| ajaśṛṅgyā vetyādika ekādaśaḥ| tathā ajaśṛṅgyā dantīdravantyośca kaṣāye gauḍo+ariṣṭaḥ kārya iti sambandhaḥ| taccūrṇetyādiko dvādaśaḥ| atra tayordantīdravantyoścūrṇakvāthābhyāṃ tathā māṣāmbunā kiṇvakaraṇapūrvakaṃ yā surā kṛtā tatsurodbhavā madirā kartavyeti vākyārthaḥ| ajagandhetyādinā yogadvayamāha| tatrājagandhākaṣāyeṇa dantīdravantībhyāṃ sauvīrakatuṣodake kartavye| suretyādinā+aparaṃ yogadvayamāha| lodhravacca tayoriti yathā lodhrakalpeṣu “surā lodhrakaṣāyeṇa” ityādinā surā proktā, tathā “kampillakakaṣāyeṇa” (ka.a.9) ityādinā kampillakayoga uktaḥ, tathā tayorapi dantīdravantyorlodhrasthāne prakṣepāt surāyogaḥ sauvīrakatuṣodakavidhānenaiva kartavyaḥ| iti tṛtīyaḥ ṣoḍaśakaḥ||20-35||
div.quote: eko godhūmacūrṇānāṃ kāryā‘kāryaiṣotkārikā’ iti pā. cotkārikā śubhā
modako vā+asya kalpena‘kalkena’ iti pā. kāryastacca virecanam
dantīkvāthena cāloḍya‘dantīkaṣāyairlulitān’ iti pā. dantītailena sādhitān
nāgaraṃ hemadugdhāṃ ca citrakaṃ ceti cūrṇitam
pibetghṛtena jīrṇe‘cūrṇa’ iti pā. tu viriktaścāpi tarpaṇam
gaṇḍamālāsu vāte‘gaṇḍamālāsravāte ca’ iti pā. ca pāṇḍuroge ca śasyate
uṣṇāmbu ca pibeccānu‘pibeccheṣān’ iti pā. daśame daśame+ahni ca
virecanaṃ mukhyatamaṃ‘etadvirecanaṃ mukhyaṃ’ iti pā. kāmalāharamuttamam
gauḍaḥ kāryo+a+ajaśṛṅgyā vā sa‘rase’ iti pā. vai sukhavirecanaḥ

div.p: dantītyādyadhyāyārthasaṅgraho vyakta ‘vyāhṛta eva’ iti pā.; eva| bhaktidoṣāmayān prati uktānāṃ nānāvidhānāṃ yogānāṃ trayaḥ ṣoḍaśakāḥ proktā iti yojanā| bhaktiḥ icchā||36-40||
div.quote: tatra ślokāḥ- (dadhyādiṣu trayaḥ pañca priyālādyaistrayo rase
sneheṣu vai trayo lehyāḥ ṣaṭ cūrṇe tveka eva ca
dve śate navakāḥ pañca yogānāṃ tu virecane
prādhānyataḥ samāśritya dravyāṇi daśa pañca ca
div.p: samprati kalpasthānārthasaṅgrahamāha- triśatamityādinā| triśataṃ pañcapañcāśaditi pañcapañcāśadyogādhikaṃ triśatam| prādhānyataḥ samāśrityeti prādhānyena madanaphalādīni dravantīparyantāni pañcadaśadravyāṇi yogavyapadeśatayā+a+aśritya||41-42||

athātra vamanādiyogeṣu dravyāntarāṇāṃ surādīnāmapi vidyamānatvāt kathaṃ madanaphalādyāśrayavattvenaivāmī ‘madanaphalādīnāmavayavattvenaivāmī’ iti pā.; yogā vyapadiśyanta ityāha- yaddhītyādi| yadyapi madanādibhiḥ surādibhiśca militvaivāmī yogāḥ kriyante, tathā+api phalādīnāṃ prādhānyāt phalādīnāṃ yogā ete iti vyapadeśo bhavati, na surādiyogā iti| guṇabhūtā iti apradhānabhūtāḥ ‘apradhānībhūtāḥ’ iti pā.| surādīnāmaprādhānya eva hetumāha- te hi tānyanuvartanta iti; surādayo hi madanādīni vamanavirecanaprakārakāryānuguṇatayā+apratīghātena cānuvartante||43-44||
div.quote: bhavanti cātra- yaddhi yena pradhānena dravyaṃ samupasṛjyate
tatsañjñakaḥ sa yogo vai bhavatīti viniścayaḥ ‘saṃyogo bhavatīti viniścitam’ iti pā.;

div.p: nanu ye tāvadanuguṇā madanādīnāṃ te guṇabhūtā bhavantu, viparītā ye dantyā ugratāyā māṃsarasādayaḥ, tathā elādayo hṛdyatayā vamanapratikūlā madanādīnāṃ te kathaṃ guṇabhūtā ityāha- viruddhavīryamapyeṣāṃ pradhānānāmabādhakamiti| viruddhavīryamapīti virecanarūpakāryāprabādhakatayā guṇabhūtamityarthaḥ| yadi hi viruddhavīryaṃ guṇabhūtaṃ na syāt tadā madanādīnāṃ kāryaṃ pratihanyāt; viruddhasyāpi ca kāryāpratīghāto+avaśyamabādhakatvameveti bhāvaḥ| viparītasya kāryābādhanarūpaṃ sāhāyyamabhidhāya‘mahārthatvamabhidhāya’ iti pā. tulyavīryasya kāryamāha- adhikamityādi| tulyavīrye saṃyukte sati kriyāsāmarthyamadhikaṃ bhavatītyarthaḥ||45||
div.quote: adhikaṃ tulyavīrye hi kriyāsāmarthyamiṣyate ‘samānavīrye tvadhikaṃ kriyāsāmānyamiṣyate’ iti pā.;

div.p: atha tulyavīryaṃ tāvat kriyāsāmarthyādhikyakārakaṃ ‘kriyāsāmānyādhikyakārakaṃ’ iti pā., tena tatsaṃyogo+astu, viruddhavīryasaṃyogāstu kimarthaṃ kriyanta ityāha- iṣṭetyādi| iṣṭavarṇatvādisampattyartham; ato madanaphalāderviruddhavīryāṇāṃ prayogastathā‘yogaḥ’ iti pā. viruddhāmayaṃ ca prati viruddhavīryāṇāṃ prayogo‘yogaḥ’ iti pā. vamanavirecanahartavyāmayaviśeṣe yaugika ityarthaḥ||46||
atha madanaphalādīnāṃ vīryotkarṣādike vidhimāha- bhūyaścaiṣāmityādi| tulyavīryairveti tulyavīryaiḥ svarasaiḥ kvāthairvā||47||-

tulyātulyavīryasaṃyogādikāryamāha- alpasyāpītyādi| tatrālpamātrasya samānavīryasaṃyogānmahārthatvaṃ bhavati, tathā viruddhavīryasaṃyogāt prabhūtamātrasyāpyalpakarmatā kartavyā| iyaṃ cālpakarmakatā prabhūtabheṣajasya dīptikāraṇakoṣṭhavyāptyādiprayojanāt kriyate, tena na niṣprayojanā| viśleṣādapyalpasya mahārthatvaṃ viruddhavīryaviśleṣādboddhavyaṃ; samādhikaviśleṣāttu prabhūtasyālpakarmatā jñeyā| evaṃ saṃskārādapi samānāsamānaguṇānmahārthatvamalpakarmatā vā yuktā| alpasyāpi mahārthatvaṃ yathā snigdhe+alpamātramapi śodhanaṃ bahudoṣaharaṇāya bhavati, tadviparyayeṇa prabhūtasyālpakarmatā udāharaṇīyā||48||-

samprati, uktaprayogaṣaṭśatabījenānuktaprayogakalpanaṃ darśayannāha- pradeśetyādi| pradeśa ekadeśaḥ| atha kasmānniḥśeṣeṇa naiva yogā abhidhīyanta ityāha- bahudravyetyādi| asaṅkhyatvānniḥśeṣānabhidhānamiti bhāvaḥ||49-50||
div.quote: bahudravyavikalpatvādyogasaṅkhyā‘... ddravyasaṅkhyā’ iti pā. na vidyate
nātiglānikaraṃ pāyau hṛdaye na ca rukkaram
div.p: atha vamanavirecanānāṃ tadupodghātācca nirūhāṇāṃ tīkṣṇamadhyamṛdutāyā lakṣaṇaṃ kāraṇaṃ cāha- tīkṣṇetyādi| sukhamiti duḥkhamakurvan| asaktamiti apratibaddham| nātiglānikaraṃ pāyāviti virecanasya nirūhasya ca, hṛdaye na ca rukkaramiti tu vamanasya lakṣaṇaṃ jñeyam| akṣiṇvanniti apīḍayan| virecanamiti vamanaṃ virecanaṃ ca; uktaṃ hi- ubhayaṃ hi śarīradoṣamalavirecanādvirecanaśabdaṃ labhate (ka.a.1) iti||51-52||-

jalāgnītyādinā tīkṣṇatve kāraṇamāha| deśakālaguṇānvitamiti anuguṇadeśakālaprāptyotkṛṣṭaguṇavat| snehasvedopapannasyeti susnigdhasvinnasya| kiñcidityādinā madhyasya vamanādeḥ kāraṇalakṣaṇe āha| ebhirguṇairityanena kṣipratvādi jalāgnikīṭāspṛṣṭhatvādi ca pratyavamṛṣyate| mandavīryamityādinā mṛdūnāṃ lakṣaṇaṃ kāraṇaṃ cāha| mandavegavaditi lakṣaṇaṃ, śeṣaṃ tu kāraṇam||53-56||

tīkṣṇādiśuddhiviṣayāvacāraṇārthamāha- akṛtsnetyādi| te madhyālpaśuddhī balīyasāṃ puruṣāṇāṃ kṛtsnadoṣaṃ yasmānna nirharataḥ, tasmādaśuddhī| akṛtsnadoṣaharaṇāditi hetuvarṇanena yadā balīyaso+alpadoṣatayā kṛtsnadoṣaharaṇakārike madhyālpaśuddhī bhavataḥ, tadā samyakśuddhī eva te iti sūcayati| madhyetyādi madhyabale madhyā, avarabale tu mṛdvī śuddhiḥ prayojyeti vākyārthaḥ| tatra prayojyabhāṣayā asamyakśuddhī api balāpekṣayā kartavye, madhyāvarau prati tayoḥ samyakśuddhikartṛtvaṃ bhavatīti darśayati||57||

vyādhitīkṣṇatvādivibhāgena viśuddhau tīkṣṇatvādividhānamāha- tīkṣṇo madhya ityādi| sarvamadhyālpalakṣaṇa iti yathāsaṅkhyaṃ tīkṣṇādivyādhilakṣaṇaṃ; sarvalakṣaṇaḥ tīkṣṇaḥ, madhyalakṣaṇaḥ madhyaḥ, alpalakṣaṇaḥ mṛdurvyādhiḥ| balāvekṣītyanena vyādhestīkṣṇatve yadi balaṃ mahadbhavati tadaiva tīkṣṇaśodhanaṃ kartavyamiti darśayati||58||
div.quote: tīkṣṇādīni balāvekṣī‘bhiṣak teṣu balāpekṣī prayojayet’ iti pā. bheṣajānyeṣu yojayet
deyaṃ tvanirhṛte pūrvaṃ pīte paścāt punaḥ punaḥ
div.p: vamane kriyamāṇe+avasthāviśeṣakartavyamāha- deyamityādi| evaṃ pīte vamane sati anirhṛte doṣe paścāt punaḥ punarvamanārthīyaṃ bheṣajaṃ deyam| āpittadarśanāditi yāvat pittaṃ na dṛśyate tāvat punaḥ punarvamanaṃ deyam| vamanaṃ hi pittāntatayā samyagyuktaṃ bhavati| uktaṃ hi- “pittāntamiṣṭaṃ vamanaṃ virekādardhaṃ” (si.a.1) iti||59||

punaḥ punarbhaiṣajyaprayogasyāpavādaviṣayamucitaviṣayaṃ ca darśayannāha- baletyādi| balavati doṣe puruṣe+api punaḥ prayojyaṃ bhaiṣajyaṃ, hīnabale doṣe puruṣe ca sarvaśo vā bheṣajaṃ śodhanārthaṃ vivarjayet, śodhanaṃ na kuryādityarthaḥ| vāśabdena ca madhyamabale puruṣe doṣe ca na sarvathā vivarjanenaikavāraprayogaṃ śodhanasya darśayati||60||
div.quote: balatraividhyamālakṣya‘balaṃ trividhamālakṣya’ iti pā. doṣāṇāmāturasya ca
nirhṛte vā+api jīrṇe vā doṣanirharaṇe budhaḥ
div.p: nirhṛte ityādau doṣanirharaṇe iti doṣanirharaṇakaprayojane bheṣaje| nirhṛte iti doṣamanirhṛtyaiva nirgate| jīrṇe veti yena vamanamadhikṛtyaitaducyate, tena vamanasya pākakālāpratīkṣaiveti ‘apakvaṃ vamanaṃ’ ityādinā vaktavyam| jīrṇasadṛśatā ca vamanasya kṣobhākartṛtayā pākonmukhatayā ca jñeyā| anyat prayuñjīteti vamanārthabheṣajapānānantaraṃ tadahareva dadyāt||61||
vamanaprayogeṣvayogapratīkārārthaṃ bheṣajāntaraprayoge kartavye pākakālāpratīkṣaṇaṃ sopapattikamāha- apakvamityādi||62||
div.quote: apakvaṃ vamanaṃ doṣaṃ‘doṣān’ iti pā. pacyamānaṃ virecanam

div.p: vamane āvaśyakaṃ kartavyamabhidhāya virecane+apyāha- pīte prasraṃsane ityādi| vamite cauṣadhe iti virecanauṣadhamātre vamite| punariti tadahareva||63||
div.quote: pīte prasraṃsane‘praskandane’ iti pā. doṣānna nirhatya jarāṃ gate

div.p: virecanena stokadoṣaharaṇe sati kartavyamāha- dīptāgnimityādi| dṛḍhasnehaguṇamityanena snehalakṣaṇo guṇo dehe yadā dṛḍho nāsti tadā+asya bheṣajaṃ na dātavyaṃ, kintu sneha eva tāvat kartavyaḥ; asamyaksnigdhe hi punarapi kriyamāṇaṃ virecanamasamyagyogāyaiva bhavati| duḥśuddhamiti ayogenāviśuddham ‘ayogena śuddhaṃ’ iti pā.; | śvobhūte, dināntare bhūte, kiṃvā ‘śvo bhūyaḥ’ iti pāṭhaḥ| doṣapākeneti pakvadoṣe+avibaddhatvādbahutvācca śanairviricyate| bhojyairiti anulomanaiḥ| atra ca pravṛttadoṣe+atiyogabhayānna punarvirecanaprayogamanujānīte||64-65||

vamanavirecanābhyāṃ kiñciccheṣīkṛtadoṣapratīkārārthamāha- vamanaiścetyādi| atra bahuvacanaṃ vegabahutvāpekṣayā| apramāṇata iti na niḥśeṣeṇa| tatra bhojanaṃ pācanaṃ yavāgvādibhojanam| antarapānaṃ kaṣāyapānam| ye tu ‘pramāṇataḥ’ iti paṭhanti, te samyakśuddhāvapi koṣṭhopalepakadoṣapraśamanārthaṃ bhojanāntarapānaṃ vyākhyānayanti||66||
div.quote: vamanaiśca virekaiśca viśuddhasyāpramāṇataḥ ‘viśuddhasya pramāṇataḥ; bhojanottarapānābhyāṃ’ iti pā.;

div.p: mṛduśodhanopapādanīyamāha- durbalamityādi| śodhitaṃ pūrvamiti pūrvaśodhitasya durbalatayā mṛdu bheṣajaṃ deyaṃ, tīkṣṇena hi balabhraṃśo+atiyogaśca syāt||67||
div.quote: durbalaṃ śodhitaṃ pūrvamalpadoṣaṃ‘pūrvamalpaśeṣaṃ’ iti pā. ca mānavam

div.p: mṛdubheṣajaprayogopapattimāha- śreya ityādi| asakṛtpītamiti asakṛtpītamalpabādhaṃ bhavatītyarthaḥ| śreya iti śreyastvaṃ cāsyātivyāpattikaratīkṣṇāpekṣayā jñeyam| na cātitīkṣṇamiti na cātitīkṣṇaṃ durbalādīnāṃ deyaṃ; yasmādatitīkṣṇaṃ durbalādīn prāpya kṣipraṃ prāṇasaṃśayaṃ janayet||68||
durbale bahudoṣe kartavyamāha- durbalo+apītyādi| bahuśo+alpaśa iti punaḥ punaḥ stokamātrayā| evambhūtānāṃ mahādoṣanirharaṇe hetumāha- doṣā hanyurhyenamanirhṛtā iti||69||
yasyetyādāvānulomikaṃ virecanamauṣadhamūrdhvaṃ yāti yasya, taṃ pāyayet ‘virecanamauṣadham’ iti śeṣaḥ| kavalaiḥ śuddhamiti kavalaiḥ śodhitamukhakaṇṭham| teneti uṣṇajalena pītena||70-72||
div.quote: vamitaṃ kavalaiḥ śuddhaṃ laṅghitaṃ pāyayettu tam
vibaddhe+alpe‘vibandhe+alpaṃ’ iti pā. cirāddoṣe sravatyuṣṇaṃ pibejjalam
sodgāraṃ sāṅgaśūlaṃ‘saśūlaṃ ca’ iti pā. ca svedaṃ tatrāvacārayet

div.p: atiyogaśaṅkāyāṃ kartavyamāha- suvirikte ityādi| suvirikte iti samyakpramāṇena nirhṛte ityarthaḥ| sodgāramiti udgāreṇa pacyamānāvasthā+abhihitā ‘apacyamānāvasthā’ iti pā.| etena samyagvirecane bhūte+api yadauṣadhaṃ tiṣṭhati tattaddine evollikhet| tasyāpyauṣadhaikadeśasyāpacyamānatāyāṃ virecanātiyogaḥ syāditi darśayati||73||
div.quote: suvirikte‘suviriktastu’ iti, ‘suviriktasya’ iti ca pā. tu sodgāramāśvevauṣadhamullikhet
atipravartanaṃ‘atipravṛttaṃ jīrṇe tu’ iti pā. jīrṇe suśītaiḥ stambhayedbhiṣak

div.p: kadācidityādinā virecanasyāvikramatve ‘virecanasyāviriktatve’ iti pā. hetumāha| atra kartavyaṃ yadyapi noktaṃ, tathā+api śleṣmaṇā nirodhaṃ bheṣajasya gauravādibhirupalabhya rātriparyantaṃ bheṣajasyāyogapravṛttirupekṣaṇīyeti kartavyamūhanīyam| pravartate iti doṣasahitaṃ bheṣajaṃ pravartate||74||
div.quote: kṣīṇe śleṣmaṇi sāyāhne rātrau vā tatpravartate

div.p: rūkṣetyādāvayogājjīrṇe viṣṭabhya ūrdhvaṃ gate vā bheṣaje anyadvirecanaṃ sasnehalavaṇaṃ dātavyam|75||
div.quote: rūkṣānāhārayorjīrṇe‘virūkṣānāhayorjīrṇe’ iti pā. viṣṭabhyordhvaṃ gate+api vā

div.p: tṛṇmohetyādinā pittāvṛtabheṣajasya lakṣaṇaṃ cikitsitaṃ cāha| syurjīryatīti jīryati bheṣaje tṛḍādayo bhavantītyarthaḥ||76||
div.quote: tṛṇmohabhramamūrcchāyāḥ syuścejjīryati ‘syurjīryati hi bheṣaje’ iti pā.; bheṣaje
pittaghnaṃ svādu śītaṃ ca bheṣajaṃ tatra śasyate

div.p: lāletyādinā kaphāvṛtabheṣajasya lakṣaṇaṃ cikitsitaṃ cāha||77||
susnigdhamityādau avirecitamiti īṣadvirecitam| snehaja iti snehaprayogajanitaḥ śleṣmā| saṅgaḥ doṣasaṅgaḥ| tena laṅghanena doṣapākādeva prabalaśleṣmopaśamo doṣasaṅgopaśamaśca kriyata ityarthaḥ||78||

rūkṣādīnāṃ virecanaprayoge kramaviśeṣaṃ sopapattikamāha- rūkṣetyādi| bastiṃ purā dattvetyatra bastiśabdena snehabastimicchanti, nirūhastu vātakopakatayā tathā nirūhānantaraṃ virecanasya niṣiddhatvādiha neṣyate; uktaṃ hi “nirūhadānāt pavanādbhayaṃ syāt” (si.a.1) iti, tathā “naro viriktastu nirūhadānaṃ vivarjayet saptadinānyavaśyam| śuddho nirūhena virecanaṃ tu” (si.a.1) iti; kintu bastiśabdena nirūhaḥ snehabastiśca gṛhyate; nirūhasya yadvātakartṛtvamuktaṃ tadekasyaiva snehabastirahitasyābhyāsāt, utsargatastu vātahantṛtvaṃ “bastirvātaharāṇāṃ” (sū.a.25) ityanenaivoktam| nirūhānantaraṃ virecananiṣedhastvautsargikaḥ, tena viśeṣavidhinā tasyāpavādo yujyata eva; kiñca, iha bastyanantaraṃ yadvirecanaṃ vidhīyate tacca bastidānādūrdhvaṃ saptāhānantarameva bhaviṣyatīti na kaścidvirodhaḥ| pravartitamiti pravṛttyunmukhīkṛtam||79-80||
div.quote: bastipravartitaṃ‘bastipracālitaṃ’ iti pā. doṣaṃ harecchīghraṃ virecanam

div.p: rūkṣāśanā ityādinā snehyā api na vyādhivyatirekeṇa śodhanīyā ityāha| karmanityā iti nityaṃ vyāyāmādikarmakarāḥ| viruddhādhyaśanājīrṇān doṣān sahantīti viruddhāśanādayo doṣarūpā na teṣāṃ vikāraṃ janayantītyarthaḥ; viruddhādhyaśanādayaśca doṣajanakatayā doṣaśabdenocyante| nāvyādhāviti avidyamānasaṃśodhanaikasādhye vyādhau na tān viśodhayediti; anyatrāpyukto+ayamarthaḥ “anīritānāṃ doṣāṇāmīraṇaṃ na praśasyate| uparyupari saktānāmaśmanāmiva tāḍanam ‘ghaṭṭanam’ iti pā.” iti||81-82||
div.quote: teṣāṃ doṣāḥ kṣayaṃ yānti karmavātātapāgnibhiḥ ‘vāyukarmāgnibhisteṣāṃ yānti doṣāḥ kṣayaṃ sadā’ iti pā.;
snehyāste mārutādrakṣyā nāvyādhau tān viśodhayet ‘virecayet’ iti pā.;

div.p: uktaṃ vidhimupasaṃharannāha- evaṃ jñātvetyādi| virecyebhya iti virecanārhebhyaḥ| vibhraṃśa ityādau yasyeti saṃśodhanasya| nanu viṣatulyavibhraṃśametacchodhanaṃ tatkimanenācaritenetyāha- kāleṣvavaśyaṃ peyaṃ ceti; saṃśodhanasādhyavyādhāvavaśyaṃ peyam| tena, avasthāviśeṣe+avaśyakartavyatayā na śodhanaṃ parihartuṃ pāryata iti bhāvaḥ||83-85||

samprati yadetacchodhanasya kvacit karṣādimānamuktaṃ na tat sarvapuruṣaviṣayaṃ, kintu madhyeṣu koṣṭhavayobaleṣu tanmānaṃ jñeyamiti darśayannāha- dravyetyādi| tanmūlamālambyeti uktapramāṇamanuktapramāṇānumānabījaṃ kṛtvā| vikalpārthamāha- teṣāṃ vikalpyo+abhyadhikonabhāva iti; bheṣajapramāṇasyādhikabhāva ūnabhāvaśca vikalpya ityarthaḥ||86||
div.quote: tanmūlamālambya‘tanmulamālakṣya bhavedvikalpaḥ’ iti pā. bhavedvikalpyaṃ teṣāṃ vikalpyo+abhyadhikonabhāvaḥ
