div.p: idānīṃ vayobhedena nirūhapramāṇaṃ darśayannāha- nirūhetyādi| ādye varṣe bālasya palamāne nirūhe kvāthādi yathoktamānānusāreṇa vaktavyam; ardhaprasṛtābhivṛddhiḥ tataḥ prativarṣaṃ bhavati; tena dvādaśavarṣe ṣaṭprasṛto bastirbhavati; dvādaśādūrdhvamaṣṭādaśavarṣaparyantaṃ prativarṣaṃ prasṛtavṛddhyā dvādaśaprasṛtapūraṇaṃ bhavati; ‘dvādaśataḥ paraṃ syuḥ’ ityanenādhikapramāṇabastimānaṃ mahātyayakaraṃ kaiścidanumataṃ niṣedhayati; yathā hārīte ekīyamataṃ paṭhyate- “ardhāḍhakaṃ paramatamaṃ‘paramataṃ’ iti pā. pramāṇam” iti asyāgre hastalikhitapustake ‘tathāhi hārīte ekīyamatamapyanumatam, ‘apratiṣiddhaṃ paramatamanumatam’ iti nyāyāt’ ityadhikaṃ paṭhyate; ; tathā suśrute+api (?)- “dvādaśaprasṛtaṃ kecit triṃśatpalamathā+apare” ityādi| bastimānaṃ darśayitumāha- āsaptaterityādi| āsaptatestaditi dvādaśaprasṛtamānaṃ saptatiṃ yāvadbhavati| ṣoḍaśavaditi daśaprasṛtapramāṇam| bālavṛddhayoryathoktaprasṛtamānaviṣayaṃ darśayan‘darśayitumevānyaṃ’ iti pā. tatrānyaṃ viśeṣamāha- nirūhamātretyādi| bālavṛddhayoryathoktaiva nirūhamātrā prasṛtapramāṇā kāryā, viśeṣeṇa tayorbastirmṛduḥ kāryaḥ| tīkṣṇatvamārdavakaraṃ ca vidhānaṃ vakṣyati; yathā- “tīkṣṇatvaṃ mūtrapīlvagnilavaṇakṣārasarṣapaiḥ| prāptakālaṃ vidhātavyaṃ kṣīrādyairmārdavaṃ tathā” (si.a.7) iti||31-32||-
div.quote: ādvādaśāt syāt prasṛtābhivṛddhiraṣṭādaśād dvādaśataḥ paraṃ syuḥ
āsaptatestadvihitaṃ‘āsaptateruktamidaṃ’ iti pā. pramāṇamataḥ paraṃ ṣoḍaśavadvidheyam
nirūhamātrā prasṛtapramāṇā bāle ca vṛddhe ca mṛdurviśeṣaḥ

div.p: samprati ‘śayane vidhiḥ kaḥ’ iti praśnasyottaramāha- nātyucchritamityādi| pūrvaṃ yaḥ śayanavidhiruktaḥ sa tātkālikaḥ, ayaṃ tūttarakālika iti viśeṣaḥ| pradhānaṃ mahanmṛdu cāstaraṇaṃ pradhānamṛdvāstaraṇaṃ, tenopapannaṃ yuktam| prākśīrṣakamiti “prācyāṃ diśi sthitā devāstatpūjārthaṃ ca prākśirāḥ” (su.sū.a.19) iti vacanāt||33||-

yūṣādi bhojyavidhānaṃ yathākramaṃ kaphe, pitte, vāte; kiṃvā, agnyapekṣaṃ yathāyogyatayā vyākhyeyam| yathoktavidhānaṃ vakṣyamāṇavidhiṣu kartavyatayā darśayannāha- sarveṣvityādi| etadādyamiti pradhānam, autsargikamiti yāvat; tena viśeṣavidhānenāpavādo+apyasya bhaviṣyatīti sūcayati||34||-
div.quote: bhojyaṃ punarvyādhimavekṣya tadvat‘samyak’ iti pā. prakalpayedyūṣapayorasādyaiḥ

div.p: ‘ke bastaya’ ityādipraśnasyottaraṃ- dvipañcamūlasyetyādi| atra māṃsaṃ daśamūlasamam| rasaḥ kvāthaḥ| amlaṃ kāñjikādi| sapūrvapeṣya iti balādyuktakalkayuktaḥ| trisnehayukta ityanena, majjaparityāgaṃ sarvabastisiddhaṃ smārayati; uktaṃ hyanyatra- “vijñeyastrividhaḥ sneho bastyartha majjavarjitaḥ” iti| sthirādivargasyetyādau madhusaindhave yadyapi sāmānyenoktabastividhānalabdhe, tathā+api tailādīnāmatrāprakarṣārthaṃ punastayorabhidhānaṃ, kiṃvā sāmānyavidhismaraṇārthamatrābhidhānam; evamanyatrāpi sāmānyavidhiprāptasya punarabhidhāne vyākhyeyam| eraṇḍamūlamityādau palāśā śaṭī| hrasvāni mūlānīti sthirādipañcamūlam| kaṃsa āḍhakaḥ| bhāgākṣamātramiti bhāgenākṣamātram| chāgācchatārdha iti pañcāśatpalo bhavati| sapeṣya iti balādikasya kalkayuktaḥ||35-45||
div.quote: prastho rasācchāgarasārdhayuktaḥ sādhyaḥ punaḥ prasthasamastu yāvat
syāddīpano māṃsabalapradaśca cakṣurbalaṃ cāpi dadāti bastiḥ ‘sadyaḥ’ iti pā.
eraṇḍamūlaṃ tripalaṃ palāśā‘palāni’ iti pā. hrasvāni mūlāni ca yāni pañca
bhāgāḥ palāṃśā madanāṣṭayuktā‘madanāṣṭakaṃ ca’ iti pā. jaladvikaṃse kvathite+aṣṭaśeṣe
peṣyāḥ śatāhvā hapuṣā priyaṅguḥ sapippalīkaṃ madhukaṃ balā ‘vacā’ iti pā. ca
rasāñjanaṃ vatsakabījamustaṃ bhāgākṣamātraṃ‘akṣapramāṇaṃ’ iti pā. lavaṇāṃśayuktam
sasaindhavaḥ kṣaudrayutaḥ satailo deyo nirūho balavarṇakārī

div.p: yaṣṭyāhvayasyetyādikāścatvāraḥ pitte, pūrvaṃ tūktāḥ pañca vāte| atra payaḥsādhanaṃ kṣīrapākaparibhāṣayaiva| yaṣṭyāhvalodhretyādinā jīvanīyamityantenaiko yogaḥ| jīvanīyānāmatra kalkaḥ| suśītatvamihautsargikaṃ mṛdukoṣṭheṣvadhikaṃ ‘mṛdukoṣṭhasambādhakaṃ’ iti, ‘mṛdukoṣṭhatvabādhakaṃ’ iti ca pā.; pittahitatvāt; anayā ca diśā+aparapittaharabastāvapi śītatvaṃ jñeyam| dvikārṣikamityādau anantā utpalasārivā| tṛṇapañcamūlaṃ- “śarekṣudarbhakāśānāṃ śālīnāṃ mūlameva ca” (ca.ci.a.1pā.1) ityādinoktam| ambuhīnamiti kṣīrāvaśeṣaparyantaṃ śṛtam| rājakaśeruḥ kaśerureva| sasaindhavamiti īṣatsaindhavam| sasārivetyādau śītapākī śītalī| madhuyaṣṭitailaṃ madhuyaṣṭisādhitaṃ tailam| uttamadehaḥ mastakam||46-55||
div.quote: saśarkaraṃ kṣaudrayutaṃ suśītaṃ pittāmayān hanti sajīvanīyam
toye samutkvāthya rasena tena śṛtaṃ payo+ardhāḍhakamambuhīnam
pratyāgate dhanvarasena śālīn kṣīreṇa vā+adyāt pariṣiktagātraḥ
pathyāvidārīkṣurasairguḍena‘tathā’ iti pā. bastiṃ yutaṃ pittaharaṃ vidadhyāt
hṛnnābhipārśvottamadehadāhe ‘hṛnnābhipārśvodaradehadāhe’ iti pā.; dāhe+antarasthe ca sakṛcchramūtre
kṣīṇe kṣate retasi cāpi naṣṭe paitte+atisāre ca nṛṇāṃ praśastaḥ

div.p: koṣātaketyādikāścatvāraḥ kaphe bastayaḥ| śārṅgeṣṭā guñjā| atra kvāthadaśaprasṛtena tathā kalkena kṣaudrādinā ca yadyapi mānamadhikaṃ bhavati, tathā+apyevameva dravyasaṃyogaṃ kṛtvā dvādaśaprasṛta eva bastirdeyaḥ, tadadhikamānasya niṣiddhatvāt| paṭoletyādau paṭolādipippalyantaistoyaṃ sādhayitvā pūrvavad dvitīyaḥ, kapharogiṇe dvipañcamūlyādibhistṛtīyaḥ kartavyaḥ| kṣāraḥ yavakṣāraḥ| rāsnetyādau śampākaḥ caturaṅgulaḥ| tiktā kaṭurohiṇī| atra piṇḍītakakvātho+apyāvāpakalpo ‘…+avayavakalpaḥ’ iti pā. yena praviśati; piṇḍītakaḥ madanaḥ| rūkṣauṣadhairatyapatarpitebhyo+apyeteṣu kuṣṭhādirogeṣvayaṃ datto balaṃ karotīti yojanā||56-64||
div.quote: paktvā kulatthān bṛhatīṃ ca toye rasasya tasya prasṛtā daśa syuḥ
phalāhvatailasya samākṣikasya ‘kṣaudrasya tailasya phalāhvayasya’ iti pā.; kṣārasya tailasya ca sārṣapasya
dadyānnirūhaṃ kapharogiṇe jño mandāgnaye cāpyaśanadviṣe ca
dvipañcamūle triphalāṃ sabilvāṃ phalāni gomūtrayutaḥ kaṣāyaḥ
nihatya vātaṃ jvalanaṃ pradīpya vijitya rogāṃśca balaṃ karoti

div.p: punarnavetyādikaḥ sarvavātādisaṃsargaviṣayaḥ| vṛścīraḥ śvetapunarnavā| dhānyāni phalāni ceti dhānyaphalāni| payojaladvyāḍhakavaditi samajalakṣīradviprasthayuktam||65-68||
div.quote: dvipañcamūlaṃ ca palāṃśikāni kṣuṇṇāni dhautāni phalāni ‘palāni’ iti pā.; cāṣṭau
payojaladvyāḍhakavacchṛtaṃ ‘payojaladvyāḍhakapācitaṃ’ iti, ‘payojalārdhāḍhakapācitaṃ’ iti, ‘payojaladvyāḍhakayoḥ śṛtaṃ’ iti ca pā.; tat kṣīrāvaśeṣaṃ sitavastrapūtam
kṣaudrasya tailasya ca sarpiṣaśca tathaiva yuktaṃ prasṛtaistribhiśca‘prasṛtitrayeṇa’ iti pā.
snigdhoṣṇa ekaḥ pavane samāṃso dvau svāduśītau payasā ca pitte
trayaḥ samūtrāḥ kaṭukoṣṇatīkṣṇāḥ kaphe nirūhā na paraṃ vidheyāḥ
div.p: uktānāṃ vātādiharabastīnāṃ saṅkhyākalpanāṃ viśiṣṭāṃ darśayannāha- snigdhoṣṇa ityādi| eka iti eka eva puṭakaḥ| payasā ceti payoyuktau| kaṭukoṣṇatīkṣṇatvaṃ kaphaharadravyayogādeva jñeyam| na paraṃ vidheyā ityanena tantrāntaravihitaṃ caturthabastidānamatyarthaśarīrahiṃsakaṃ niṣedhayati; yathā suśrute- “dvitīyaṃ vā tṛtīyaṃ vā caturthaṃ vā yathārhataḥ| samyaṅnirūḍhaliṅge tu prāpte bastiṃ nivartayet” (su.ci.a.32) ityanenoktaṃ caturthadānamiti||69||

div.quote: rasena vāte pratibhojanaṃ syāt kṣīreṇa pitte tu kaphe ca yūṣaiḥ
tathā+anuvāsyeṣu ca bilvatailaṃ syājjīvanīyaṃ phalasādhitaṃ ca
yo+adhītya vidvāniha bastikarma karoti loke labhate sa siddhim
div.p: samprati vātādibhedena pratibhojanaṃ viśiṣṭaṃ tathā+anuvāsanaṃ cāha- rasena vāte ityādi| pratibhojanaṃ nirūhānantarabhojanam| vāte bilvatailānuvāsanaṃ, pitte jīvanīyasādhitaṃ, kaphe ca madanaphalasādhitam| atra bilvatailādīni vakṣyamāṇāni vyākhyānayanti; tena snehavyāpatsiddhau yad vakṣyati “daśamūlaṃ” (si.a.4) ityādinā bilvatailaṃ, jīvanīyaṃ ca “jīvantī madanaṃ” (si.a.4) ityādinā vakṣyamāṇayamakaṃ, tathā “madanairvā+amlasaṃyuktaiḥ” (si.a.4) ityādinā vakṣyamāṇaṃ madanatailaṃ jñeyam||70-71||

div.quote: ityagniveśakṛte tantre carakapratisaṃskṛte+aprāpte dṛḍhabalasampūrite siddhisthāne bastisūtrīyasiddhirnāma tṛtīyo+adhyāyaḥ
div.p: iti śrīcakrapāṇidattapraṇītāyāmāyurvedadīpikāyāṃ carakatātparyaṭīkāyāṃ siddhisthāne bastisūtrīyasiddhirnāma tṛtīyodhyāyaḥ||3||

pūrvasiddhau‘pūrvādhyāye’ iti pā. bilvatailādīnyabhyaṅgasevānuvāsanārthaṃ nirdiṣṭāni, tadabhidhāyikā ceyaṃ siddhirityanantaraṃ snehavyāpatsiddhirucyate; snehānāmānuvāsanikānāṃ tadvyāpadāṃ ca bheṣajānāmabhidhāyikā siddhiḥ||1-2||
div.quote: athātaḥ snehavyāpatsiddhiṃ‘snehavyāpadikīṃ siddhiṃ’ iti pā. vyākhyāsyāmaḥ

div.p: adhyāyavaktavyamāha- snehabastīnityādi| bastiprayojyāḥ snehā etacchlokābhihitā ityarthaḥ; prapañcānabhidheyā ye tvapare+atrārthāḥ “snehabastiṃ nirūhaṃ ca” ityādinā vaktavyāḥ, te na prapañcavācyā iti te na pratijñātāḥ||3||
daśamūlamityādau bhūtīkaṃ kattṛṇaṃ yavānikā vā; kākanāsā vāyasīphalam, anye tu vāsāphalaṃ ‘kāyuyāṭuṭī’ iti khyātaṃ dravyāntaramevāhuḥ| etad daśamūlasthitabilvena bilvatailamiti vadanti||4-7||
div.quote: śatāvarīṃ sahacaraṃ kākanāsāṃ palāṃśikam‘palonmitām’ iti pā.
tailāḍhakaṃ samakṣīraṃ‘pacettailāḍhakaṃ kṣīraiḥ’ iti pā. jīvanīyaiḥ palonmitaiḥ

div.p: ānūpānāmityādau tadvaditi pūrvakvāthena sādhitā| śatāhvetyādi yogāntaram| saindhavenetyapi yogāntaram||8||
jīvantīmityādinā yamakamanuvāsanam| etadyamakaṃ pūrvādhyāye jīvanīyasañjñayā vyāpadiṣṭam| lābhata iti yathālābham| candanādyaṃ jvaracikitsitoktam| tailaṃ pādaṃ yasmin tat tailapādam||9-12||
div.quote: jīvantīṃ madanaṃ medāṃ śrāvaṇīṃ madhukaṃ balām
mūtraretorajodoṣān ‘putryaṃ retorajodoṣān harettadanuvāsanāt’ iti pā.; harettadanuvāsanam
tailapādaṃ‘tailapātraṃ’ iti pā. ghṛtaṃ siddhaṃ pittaghnamanuvāsanam

div.p: madanairvā+amlasaṃyuktairityatra madanasya kalkatvam, kāñjikādīnāmamlānāṃ dravatvam| etacca madanatailamiti khyātam| bilvādyo gaṇaḥ daśamūlaṃ; daśamūlaṃ cātra kvāthakalkābhyāmapi deyam| uktaṃ hi- “kvāthakalkāvanirdeśe gaṇāttasmāt samāvapet” iti| kaphaharairiti pūrvodhyāyoktakaphaharabheṣajaiḥ, kiṃvā trikaṭukapañcakolādibhiḥ||13-17||
div.quote: saindhavaṃ madanaṃ kuṣṭhaṃ śatāhvāṃ niculaṃ vacām ‘valām’ iti pā.;
nāgaraṃ puṣkaraṃ medāṃ cavikāṃ citrakaṃ śaṭīm
bilvājamode kṛṣṇāṃ ca dantīṃ rāsnāṃ ca peṣayet

div.p: viḍaṅgetyādau ebhiśca kalkitairiti vakṣyamāṇaiḥ| latā mañjiṣṭhā, gaurī haridrā| snehabastirbalaprada iti etaistailaiḥ kṛtaḥ snehabastirityarthaḥ||18-24||
div.quote: janayedaprajānāṃ ca prajāṃ strīṇāṃ tathā nṛṇām

div.p: vātapittetyādinā snehabastervyāpadaḥ prāha| etāśca vyāpado mithyāyogena snehasya kriyamāṇā ucyante; pratijñātaṃ hi ‘mithyāpraṇihitānāṃ ca vyāpada’ iti, tena snehāyogātiyogajanyavyāpadāmihānavasara eva; anuvāsanāyogātiyogajanyāśca vyāpadaḥ kalpanāsiddhāvevoktāḥ; tadbheṣajaṃ cātisnehite śodhanabastiḥ, asnehite punaḥ snehabastidānameva jñeyam| etacca “tasmānnirūḍhaḥ saṃsnehyo nirūhyaścānuvāsitaḥ” ityādinoktatvāt prasaṅgenehoktam ‘prabādhanenoktaṃ’ iti, ‘prabandhenoktaṃ’ iti ca pā.||25||

yathākramaṃ ṣaḍvyāpadāṃ hetumāha- śīta ityādi| gururiti gurutvayuktaḥ‘guruṇā yuktaḥ’ iti pā.| varcaḥsañcaye+alpabala iti sañcite male sati alpabalo varcaḥsañcayapravartanākṣama ityarthaḥ| tairāvṛta iti padaṃ pratyekaṃ vātādiṣu pañcasu yojanīyam| abhibhavādapīti vātādinā+a+avṛtamārgatvānna yāti; tathā tena vātādinolbaṇenābhibhūtaguṇatvācca na āyāti| anāvṛtatvāditi annenordhvamārgasyāpihitatvāt| tasya lakṣaṇamiti yathākramaṃ vātādyāvṛtasya lakṣaṇaṃ vakṣyamāṇamaṅgamardādi| veṣṭanairiti pārśvaveṣṭanaireva| ete ca stambhādayo vātāvṛtasnehamahimnaiva jāyante, tena snehaprayogāt pūrvaṃ na bhavantyeva||26-28||
div.quote: śīto+alpo vā+adhike vāte pitte+atyuṣṇaḥ kaphe mṛduḥ
dattastairāvṛtaḥ sneho na yātyabhibhavādapi ‘na yātyabhibhavādadhaḥ’ iti pā.;

div.p: rāsnātailaṃ “rāsnāsahasraniryūhe” (ci.a.28) ityādinā vihitaṃ‘abhihitaṃ’ iti pā. vātavyādhāvuktam| pītadrutailaṃ ca pītadru-sauvīrakādidraveṇa‘pītadravyasauvīrakādidraveṇa’ iti pā. sādhyamiti bruvate| tābhyāmiti rāsnāpītadrutailābhyām||29-31||
phalatailaṃ pūrvavyāhṛtameva jñeyam||32-33||
āmaliṅgairiti āmalakṣaṇairālasyādibhiḥ| āmavihitā kriyeti “āmaṃ praduṣṭamannābhibhūtaṃ‘alasībhūtaṃ’ iti trividhakukṣīye pā. punarullikhet” (vi.a.2) ityādinā vihitā+anusartavyā||34-35||

snehaṃ viḍāvṛtamityādau vartibhiriti phalavartibhiḥ, kecittu ‘bastibhiḥ’ iti paṭhanti| śyāmābilvādīni ca śyāmā ca bilvādīni daśamūlāni ca śyāmābilvādīni; kiṃvā, śyāmādīnyapyatra kalpoktāni nava gṛhyante; tairnirūhasya tathā+anuvāsanasya ca sādhanamiha jñeyam| udāvartahareṇeti trimarmīyoktodāvartacikitsitena||36-37||

abhukte ityādihetutrayaṃ snehabasterūrdhvagamanakāraṇaṃ jñeyaṃ; pūrvaṃ ca yadyapyabhojanadānameva kāraṇaṃ pratiśrutaṃ, tathā+apyekakāryatayā cikitsitasāmānyācca śūnyapāyutvātipīḍane apyatra hetutvenokte; śūnyapāyutvaṃ cādhonirodhākartṛtayā snehamūrdhvaṃ nayati| ūrdhvebhyaḥ khebhya iti mukhanāsādibhyaḥ| etīti nirgacchati| apiśabdānmukhādinirgamanasya kādācitkatvaṃ darśayati| tatsiddhataila iti mūtraśyāmādisādhitatailena yuktaḥ| sānuvāsana iti tatsiddhatailena cānuvāsanaṃ deyam| āgacchata iti āgamanasamaya eva stambhādi kartavyam| stambhaḥ vyajanaśītajalasekādinā; kaṇṭhagrahaḥ ūrdhvagamanapratiṣedhārthaṃ kaṇṭhapīḍanam| chardighnīḥ kriyāḥ chardiścikitsite “mano+abhighāte tu mano+anukūlāḥ” ityādinā “sukha eva jetum” (ci.a.20) ityantenoktā ‘sugandhimālāgrahaṇādikā ihodantopayuktāḥ’ iti pā.; ihābhipretā jñeyāḥ||38-40||

vātādyāvṛtasnehapravartanamabhidhāya apravartanīyasnehamāha- yasya nopadravamityādi| nopadravaṃ kuryāditi aniḥsṛto+api stambharugādīnūrdhvoktānna kuryāt| alpo vā+a+avṛta iti stokaniḥsṛtaḥ, stokaśca vṛtaḥ| vṛtasyāpi stambhādyupadravākaraṇe hetumāha- raukṣyāditi| tadā+atyartharūkṣatayā śarīrasya tiṣṭhannapi sneho na vyāpadamāvahatītyarthaḥ; upekṣya iti na tatra yathoktavātāvṛtasnehacikitsā kartavyetyarthaḥ; anyatrāpyuktam- “ahorātrādapi snehaḥ pratyāgacchanna dūṣyati| kuryādbastiguṇāṃścāpi jīrṇastvalpaguṇo bhavet” (su.ci.a.37) iti||41||

utpannavyāpatpratīkāramabhidhāyāvyāpannānuvāsanānuguṇaṃ bhojanamāha- yuktasnehamityādi| yuktasnehamiti avyāpannasnehamiti bhāvaḥ| upasevanaṃ‘upasevanaṃ vyañjanam’ iti pā. bhojanam| tryahāditi ‘tryahādividhānaṃ’ iti pā. vidhānaṃ prāyikam| dhānyetyādau ṣaḍaṅgavidhinā toyaṃ sādhanīyam| kalyamiti prabhāte| snehājīrṇamiti snehasyājīrṇaṃ koṣṭhopalepakamaṃśam||42-45||
div.quote: vyuṣitāya niśāṃ kalyamuṣṇaṃ vā kevalaṃ jalam
vamane ca vireke ca nirūhe sānuvāsane

div.p: pratyahānuvāsanīyānāha- rūkṣanityastvityādi| vaṅkṣaṇaśroṇigataśca tathodāvṛttaśca vāto yeṣāṃ te vaṅkṣaṇaśroṇyudāvṛttavātāḥ| arhā iti anuvāsanārhāḥ| uktaṃ cānyatra- “rūkṣasya bahuvātasya snehabastiṃ dine dine| dadyādvaidyastato+anyeṣāmagnyābādhabhayāttryahāt” (su.ci.a.37) iti| pratyahadānatryahadānopapattimāha- eṣāmityādi| tryahāt snehaṃ pacatīti pakvāśayopalepakaṃ‘koṣṭho hyupalepakasnehaṃ’ iti pā. snehaṃ bahirniḥsṛtenoṣmaṇā pacati; yadyapyatrāgninordhvasthitena tādṛśaḥ sambandhaḥ snehasya nāsti, tathā+api jāṭharasyaiva‘jaṭharasya bahirniḥsṛtenaivoṣmaṇā’ iti pā. vimiśritairavayavaistatpāko vaktavyaḥ| prāyaḥśabdena pañcāhapākamapi darśayati, tena pañcāhadānamapyanuvāsane mandāgniṃ prati prāguktaṃ jñeyam, uktaṃ hi- “paratastryahe vā dvyahe+anuvāsyo+ahani pañcame vā” (si.a.10) iti||46-47||
div.quote: rūkṣanityastu dīptāgnirvyāyāmī ‘…rbhṛśaṃ vyāyāmapīḍitaḥ’ iti pā.; mārutāmayī
eṣāṃ cāśu jarāṃ sneho yātyambu sikatāsviva

div.p: āmamiti apakvam| praṇayediti anuvāsanaṃ dadyāt| sāvaśeṣaṃ kurvīteti na niḥśeṣaṃ dadyāt| gudakaṇṭhābhyāmiti anuvāsanapānābhyām| anantaramiti ekakālam| vātamagniṃ ca dūṣayediti atra vātadūṣaṇamajīrṇajanakatayā vātāvaraṇācca jñeyam||48-49||
div.quote: na tvāmaṃ praṇayet snehaṃ sa hyabhiṣyandayedgudam
sāvaśeṣaṃ ca kurvīta vāyuḥ śeṣe hi tiṣṭhati
ubhayasmāt‘saṅgataḥ sa hyubhayato vātāgnī dūṣayet samam’ iti pā. samaṃ gacchan vātamagniṃ ca dūṣayet

div.p: nirūhānuvāsanayoḥ parasparāvyavadhānadāne doṣamāha- snehavastiṃ nirūhaṃ vetyādi| ekameviti parasparānantaritam| utkleśaḥ kaphapittotkleśaḥ| nirūhāt pavanādbhayamiti nirantaranirūheṇa śarīrasya śodhanātiyogāt pavanādbhayaṃ bhavati| nirūḍhaḥ saṃsnehya iti nirūheṇa srotaḥsu śodhiteṣu kaphapittajaye kṛte snehavastirabhyasyaḥ; tathā+anuvāsitaśca samyaganuvāsanena hi snigdhaḥ sannirūhya eva| evaṃ prayujyamānasnehanirūhayostridoṣahantṛtvaṃ snehena vātajayānnirūheṇa kaphapittajayādbhavatītyāha- snehaśodhanetyādi| śodhanamiha nirūho+abhipretaḥ||50-51||
div.quote: tasmānnirūḍhaḥ saṃsnehyo‘snehyaḥ syāt’ iti pā. nirūhyaścānuvāsitaḥ

div.p: anuvāsanaviśeṣasya mātrābasterviṣayaṃ pramāṇaṃ guṇāṃśca yathākramamāha- karmetyādi| karmātra kandukacālanādi‘kuddālapātanādi’ iti pā., vyāyāmaḥ dhanurākarṣaṇādiḥ| vātabhagne vātena pīḍite| sadeti pratyaham| hrasvāyā iti ardhāhaḥpariṇamanīyāyāḥ; uktaṃ hi- “ahorātramahaḥ kṛtsnaṃ dinārdhaṃ ca pratīkṣate| uttamā madhyamā hrasvā snehamātrā jarāṃ prati” (sū.a.13) iti| tantrāntare snehamātrātrayaṃ pramāṇairevoktaṃ; yathā- “ṣaṭpalī tu bhavejjyeṣṭhā, madhyamā tripalī bhavet| kanīyasī sārdhapalā tridhā mātrā+anuvāsane” iti| suśrutenāpi bastipramāṇamuktaṃ; yathā anuvāsane- “tasyāpi vikalpo+ardhārdhamātrāvakṛṣṭo+aparihāryo mātrābastiḥ” (su.ci.a.35) iti| anena ca sārdhapalamāno mātrābastirukto bhavati; tatra hi ṣaṭpalaḥ snehabastiruktaḥ, anuvāsanaṃ tu tripalam| sukhopacaryamiti ceṣṭāhāraniyamābhāvādeva||52-54||
div.quote: durbale vātabhagne‘vātarugṇe’ iti pā. ca mātrābastiḥ sadā mataḥ

div.p: saṅgrahe bhojyagrahaṇena dhānyanāgarajalādyapi saṅgrāhyam| dhruvaṃ ye+arhā iti pratyahamanuvāsanīyāḥ| vidhiścokta iti ‘na tvāmaṃ praṇayet’ ityādigranthokto+arthaḥ||55-56||
div.quote: tatra ślokau- vātādīnāṃ śamāyoktāḥ pravarāḥ snehabastayaḥ
prāgbhojyaṃ snehabasteryad dhruvaṃ ye+arhāstryahācca ye snehabastividhiścokto mātrābastividhistathā
ityagniveśakṛte tantre carakapratisaṃskṛte+aprāpte dṛḍhabalasampūrite siddhisthāne snehavyāpatsiddhirnāma caturtho+adhyāyaḥ
div.p: iti śrīcakrapāṇidattaviracitāyāmāyurvedadīpikāyāṃ carakatātparyaṭīkāyāṃ siddhisthāne snehavyāpatsiddhirnāma caturtho+adhyāyaḥ||4||

snehavyāpatsiddhyabhidhānaprasaṅgāt snehadānasādhananalikādivyāpatpratīkārārthā netrabastivyāpatsiddhirucyate| netragatā tathā bastipuṭakagatā ca vyāpat tathā netrāsamyakpraṇidhānajanyā ca yā vyāpadastāsāṃ siddhiḥ; tena netrabastivyāpatsiddhiḥ duṣṭanetrabastipuṭakayośca vyāpatsiddhiḥ tayoḥ sadoṣatvena jñātvā parivarjanam||1-3||
div.quote: athāto netrabastivyāpatsiddhiṃ ‘netravyāpadikīṃ siddhiṃ’ iti pā.; vyākhyāsyāmaḥ
atha netrāṇi bastīṃśca śṛṇu varjyāni karmasu
netrasyājñapraṇītasya vyāpadaḥ‘doṣāṃśca sacikitsitān’ iti pā. sacikitsitāḥ

div.p: tadevāha- hrasvamityādi| netradoṣakathane aṣṭāvitipadamanuktakarkaśatvādidoṣāṇāmatraivāntarbhāvopadarśanārtham| karkaśatvasya‘karkaśaśabdasya’ iti pā. jīrṇena kartṛtvasāmyādagrahaṇam ‘kartavyasāmyāt’ iti pā.| evamanyatrāpi saṅkhyāvacane prayojanamiha varṇanīyam| tanu kṛśam| aprāptyādi yathākramaṃ hrasvanetrādiṣu jñeyam| atigatiḥ dūrapraveśaḥ| kṣobhaḥ gudapraviṣṭasyetastato gamanam| gudapīḍeti pārśvacchidranirgatena bastidraveṇa yogādgudapīḍā| jihmeti kuṭilā||4-5||
div.quote: hrasvaṃ dīrghaṃ tanu sthūlaṃ jīrṇaṃ śithilabandhanam
pārśvacchidraṃ‘pārśvāśritaṃ’ iti pā. tathā vakramaṣṭau netrāṇi varjayet

div.p: viṣamaḥ viṣamasaṃsthānaḥ, sthulaḥ atipramāṇaḥ, jālikaḥ sūkṣmānekacchidraḥ, vātalaḥ vātaduṣṭaḥ, sa cātra vihitasnehādeḥ phenilatvādinā niścīyate| snigdhaḥ atisnigdhaḥ| klinnaḥ śīrṇāvayavaḥ| gativaiṣamyādayo yathākramaṃ viṣamādiṣvaṣṭau doṣāḥ| visratvam āmagandhatā, daurgrāhyaṃ‘vai grāhyaṃ’ iti pā. durgrahatā, cyutiḥ hastādbhraṃśaḥ, adhāryatvaṃ basteriti klinnatvāddhi dhāraṇāyogyatvaṃ bastipuṭakasya||6-7||
div.quote: snigdhaḥ klinnaśca tānaṣṭau bastīn karmasu varjayet

div.p: savātetyādayaḥ praṇetṛdoṣajanitāḥ praṇetṛdoṣā ucyante| tatra savātatā anucchvāsya baddhe bastau tathā niḥśeṣaṃ ca datte bhavati| atidrutatvamapi praṇayane nirgamanena| utkṣiptatvam ūrdhvakṣiptatvam| tiryagiti tiryakpraṇidhānam| ulluptatvamiha pīḍanadoṣo yaḥ pīḍanavicchedaṃ kṛtvā punaḥ pīḍyate sa jñeyaḥ| kampitatvaṃ netrasya| atīti atipraṇayanaṃ netrasya| bāhyagaṃ gude na praviṣṭamauṣadham| mandatvaṃ ca pakvāśayāprāptatvam, etaddhi mandapīḍanādbhavati| ativegaḥ dūrapraveśādbhavati, sa cātipīḍanakṛtaḥ||8||

etadvyāpadāṃ cikitsitāni pratyekamāha- anucchvāsyetyādi| ete cānucchvāsanādayo yadyapi pūrvameva niṣiddhāḥ “subaddhamucchvāsya ca nirvalīkaṃ” (si.a.3) ityādinaiva, tathā+api pramādāttathāprayoge sati jātavyāpadāṃ cikitsābhidhānārthamasmin prakaraṇe punaruktāḥ||9||-
div.quote: anucchvāsya ca baddhe vā datte niḥśeṣa eva vā
praviśya kupito‘kṣubhitaḥ’ iti pā. vāyuḥ śūlatodakaro bhavet

div.p: drutamityādi| utkṣiptamapi samānavyāpattikaratayaikagranthenaiva paṭhyate| niṣkṛṣṭe sahaseti cchedaḥ, utkṣepastvasahasā+api vyāpattikara eva| bastermūtrāśayasya stambho bastistambhaḥ| sabastaya iti vātaharabastiyuktāḥ||10-11||
div.quote: drutaṃ praṇīte niṣkṛṣṭe sahasotkṣipta eva vā
bhojanaṃ tatra vātaghnaṃ snehāḥ svedāḥ sabastayaḥ
netre tadṛju niṣkṛṣya saṃśodhya ca praveśayet
div.p: tiryakpraṇidhānadoṣe+abhidhātavye nalikāmukharodhi dravyāntaraṃ tatsamānavyāpattikaratvāducyate| tiryagvalyāvṛtadvāre baddhe vā+apīti tiryakpraṇihite netre valyāvṛtadvāre sati tathā bastidravyagatasūtradravyādinā vibaddhe netre bastidravyaṃ na yāti; tannetraṃ tiryakpraṇihitaṃ niṣkṛṣya ṛju praveśayet, baddhadvāraṃ ca saṃśodhya praveśayediti yojyam||12||
antarā mukte madhye vicchede kṛte| gude pratihato+anila iti pīḍanavicchedajanito vāyurgudāt pratyāhataḥ| bilvādi daśamūlaṃ; śyāmādi śyāmātrivṛdādivirecanadravyam||13-14||-
div.quote: uraḥśirortimūrvośca‘uraḥśirorujaṃ sādamūrvośca’ iti pā. sadanaṃ janayedbalī

div.p: atimātrapraṇīteneti punaḥ punaḥ praṇītena; anye tu duṣpraveśanamatimātrapraṇītamāhuḥ‘dūrapraveśanaṃ’ iti pā.; atipraṇayanaṃ yadyapi grathitakarṇikāyā upari na bhavati, tathā+api karṇikāpīḍayā gudapīḍanādatipraveśo jñeyaḥ| picchābastiḥ vakṣyamāṇaḥ||15-16||
div.quote: tatra sarpiḥ picuḥ kṣīraṃ picchābastiśca śasyate

div.p: na bhāvayatīti pakvāśayaṃ na prāpnoti| atipīḍane koṣṭhe vā tiṣṭhatīti pakṣaḥ mandādatipīḍanādvātāvaraṇācca jñeyaḥ; galagamanaṃ tu tīvrātipīḍanādanāvaraṇācca bhavati| iyaṃ ca vyāpat pūrvādhyāye āhāraṃ vinā dattānuvāsanaviṣayatayoktā, iha tu nirūhasyānuvāsanasya cātipīḍanajanyatayā bodhyata iti viśeṣaḥ| iha bastirvireko vā koṣṭhasthe+apravartamāne, kaṇṭhapīḍanādi tu galagate jñeyam||17-18||
div.quote: na‘na vā vahati’ iti, ‘na ca dhāvati’ iti ca pā. bhāvayati mandastu bāhyastvāśu nivartate

div.p: saṅgrahe teneti yathoktabheṣajābhijñabhiṣajā||19||

div.quote: ityagniveśakṛte tantre carakapratisaṃskṛte+aprāpte dṛḍhabalasampūrite siddhisthāne netrabastivyāpatsiddhirnāma pañcamo+adhyāyaḥ
div.p: iti śrīcakrapāṇidattapraṇītāyāmāyurvedadīpikāyāṃ carakatātparyaṭīkāyāṃ siddhisthāne netrabastivyāpatsiddhirnāma pañcamo+adhyāyaḥ||5||

vyāpatsiddhyabhidhānaprasaṅgādvamanavirecanayorapi vyāpatsiddhirucyate, bastivyāpatsiddhistu vamanavirecanapūrvakatvādbasteḥ paścādabhidhīyate; tena bastivyāpatsiddhyabhidhānena basteriha karmabhyaḥ prādhānyamapi dyotitaṃ; bastiprādhānyaṃ “tasmāccikitsārdhamiti bruvanti sarvāṃ cikitsāmapi bastimeke” (si.a.1) ityanenoktam| atra cānāgatavyāpaccikitsārthatvādvamanavirecanayoḥ ‘cānāgatavyāpaccikitsārthameva vamana…’ iti pā.; samyagvidhyabhidhānaṃ tena notsūtratā vamanavirecanavidhyabhidhānasya||1-2||

athetyādau samyagiti vidhiviśeṣaṇam| ūrdhvānulomayoriti vamanavirecanayoḥ| doṣāniti vyāpadaḥ| śodhanayośca vidhiryadyapi kalpanāsiddhyupakalpanīyādau tatra tatrābhihitaḥ, tathā+apyanuktaviśeṣapratipādanārthamabhidhānaṃ, tatprasaṅgācca tatrāpyukto+artha ucyate, sarvathā+anuktābhidhānaṃ ‘nātisnigdhān virecayet’ ityādi jñeyam||3||

autsargikaṃ saṃśodhanayogyaṃ kālaṃ darśayannāha- atyuṣṇetyādi| atyuṣṇetyādi grīṣmādiṣu yathāsaṅkhyaṃ jñeyam| tadantare iti grīṣmādīnāṃ madhye| prāvṛḍādyā iti prāvṛṭśaradvasantāḥ| teṣāṃ sādhāraṇā iti uṣṇavarṣaśītānāṃ sādhāraṇāḥ; anudbhūtoṣṇavarṣaśītā iti yāvat||4||
div.quote: tadantare‘antareṣu prāvṛḍādyā jñeyāḥ sādhāraṇāstrayaḥ’ iti pā. prāvṛḍādyāsteṣāṃ sādhāraṇāstrayaḥ

div.p: prāvṛḍādīn māsavibhāgena darśayannāha- prāvṛṭ śucinabhāvityādi| śucinabhau āṣāḍhaśrāvaṇau| ūrjasahau kārtikamārgaśīrṣau| tapasyaḥ phālgunaḥ| madhu caitraḥ| śodhanaṃ pratīti śodhane kartavye+ayaṃ yathoktaḥ prāvṛḍādiṛtuvibhāgo bhavati; svasthavṛttau rasotpattau vā tasyāśitīyokta eva varṣāśaraddhemantaśiśiravasantagrīṣmarūpaḥ ṛtukramo bhavati| etānṛtūniti prāvṛḍādīnṛtūn| vikalpyaivamiti yathoktamāsavibhāgena vyavasthāpya saṃśodhanaṃ dadyāt| etaduktasaṃśodhanāṅgartukramavibhāgenaiva carakasaṃskāra+api navegāndhāraṇīye “mādhavaprathame māsi” (sū.a.7) ityādinā granthena caitraśrāvaṇāgrahāyaṇeṣu vamanādisaṃśodhanamuktaṃ, tathā rogabhiṣagjitīye (vi.a.8) ca śiśiraṃ parityajya prāvṛḍādinaiva ṛtukramaḥ saṃśodhanāṅgatayoktaḥ; tena, rasabalotpādacintāyāṃ svasthavṛttānuṣṭhāneṣu ca śiśirādikramo bhavati, saṃśodhanavyavasthāyāṃ tu prāvṛḍādiriti prāvṛḍādikramo+ayaṃ saṃśodhanānukūlatayā+a+acāryeṇa kalpito na pāramārthikaḥ| ye tu, prāvṛḍādikramaṃ gaṅgāyā dakṣiṇe kūle, uttare+api śiśirādikramaṃ vadanti, tanmate ‘śodhanaṃ prati’ iti grantho+anupapannaḥ; tena, “bhūyo varṣati parjanyo gaṅgāyā dakṣiṇe jalam| tena varṣāprāvṛḍākhyau ṛtū teṣāṃ prakalpitau ‘prakīrtitau’ iti pā.” ityādinā granthena yadi nāma deśabhedenāpi ṛtukramaḥ pāramārthiko+abhidhīyate, tathā+api nāsāvācāryasyehābhimataḥ, prapañcitaścāyamarthaḥ sūtrasthāna eva| ayaṃ ca śodhanakālopadeśo+anātyayike vyādhau jñeyaḥ, ātyayike tu ūṣmādipratikāraṃ kṛtvā atyuṣṇe+api kāle saṃśodhanapravṛttirbhavatyeva, ukto hyayamartho rogabhiṣagjitīye- “ātyayike tu punaḥ karmaṇi kāmamṛtuṃ vikalpya kṛtrimaguṇopadhānena” (vi.a.8) ityādinā granthena||5-6||
div.quote: etānṛtūn ‘etānṛtūn vicintyaivaṃ dadyāt’ iti, ‘etānṛtūn vikalpyātha’ iti ca pā.; vikalpyaivaṃ dadyāt saṃśodhanaṃ bhiṣak

div.p: karmaṇāmityādau antareṣviti vamanānantaraṃ virecane kartavye virecanānantaraṃ vā bastau kartavye snehasvedau yathoktavidhānena punaḥ kartavyau, na sakṛtprayuktenaiva snehasvedena pañcakarmāṇi kartavyānītyarthaḥ| snehaṃ cānte prayojayediti saṃśodhanakarmaparisamāptau saṃśodhanajanitaglāniparihārārthaṃ saṃśamanīyasnehaṃ prayojayedityarthaḥ||7||
div.quote: karmaṇāṃ vamanādīnāmantareṣvantareṣu ‘…mantare cāntare punaḥ’ iti pā.; ca

div.p: nātisnigdhāniti anatisnigdhakāyān narān||8||

avaśyakartavye virecane sati atisnigdhāsnigdhayoḥ samyagyogakārakaṃ virecanaṃ darśayannāha- nātītyādi| snehavirecanamiti snigdhaṃ virecanamityarthaḥ| anatisnigdhe snehavirecanamanatisnigdhatvena kriyamāṇavirecanāyogapratiṣedhārtham; atisnigdhasya ‘atisnigdhe cātiyogaḥ śakyate, tatpratiṣedhārthaṃ rūkṣavirecanam’ iti pā.; snehavirecanaṃ snehanaprakarṣādativegaṃ gacchan pracalitānapi doṣān nihantuṃ na śaknoti, doṣāstu tena virecanena svasthānāt pracyāvitā bhūyaḥsrotaḥsu līyante, tatpratiṣedhārthaṃ rūkṣaṃ virecanaṃ samyagyogakārakaṃ dadyādityayamāśayaḥ||9||
div.quote: snehotkliṣṭaśarīrāya rūkṣaṃ‘dadyādrūkṣaṃ virecanam’ iti pā. dadyādvirecanam

div.p: samyagyogakārikāṃ saṃśodhanasāmagrīmāha- snehasvedopapannenetyādi| mātrāvaditi ‘alpamātraṃ mahāvegaṃ’ ityādinā vakṣyamāṇamalpamātrāvattvaṃ jñeyam| ekāgramanaseti saṃśodhanaikacittena, kāmādivyagramanaso hi vegavighātādayogaḥ syāt||10||

snehasvedayoḥ phalaṃ ‘snigdhāt pātrāt’ ityādinā bhūridṛṣṭāntena darśayan snehasvedayoravaśyakartavyatāṃ sūcayati| ayatneneti alpāyāsena| praṇudyante iti ākṛṣyante| viṣyandayati sarvata iti sarvataḥ sthitaṃ dravamākarṣati| agnidṛṣṭāntena snigdhagātrasya samyagdoṣaharaṇamucyate, tṛtīyadṛṣṭāntena tu snehasvedayormilitayoḥ phalamucyate| kliṣṭamiti mlānam| utkleśyeti kṣārāgnisambandhāt samutkleśya||11-13||
div.quote: tathā snigdhasya vai doṣān svedo viṣyandayet sthirān

div.p: śodhanasamyagyogasāmagryabhidhāne proktasnehasvedayoḥ phalamabhidhāya, kramāgatasya jīrṇe pītamityasya viparyaye doṣamāha- ajīrṇe vardhate glāniriti; ajīrṇāvasthāyāṃ pīte śodhane sati glānirmahatī bhavati| viparītaṃ pravartate iti vamanamadho yāti, virecanaṃ cordhvaṃ yāti||14||

div.quote: avikāri ca vyāpattau nātiglānikaraṃ ca yat
div.p: mātrāvaditi yaduktaṃ tadvivṛṇoti- alpamātramityādi| alpamātraṃ mahāvegamiti alpamātratve satyapi praśastamahāvegam| avikārīti vyāpattāvapi īṣadvikārakāri| mātrāvaditi praśastamātrāvat| yadyapi ca sukhāsvādādayo mātrāyāḥ phalaṃ na bhavanti, tathā+apīha mātrāyāḥ praśastatvena dravyasaṃskārādiviśeṣādhīnā api te gṛhyante; sukhādyāśrayadravyagatatvamapi hi mātrāyāḥ prāśastyamiha; kiṃvā, evambhūte eva saṃśodhane etanmātrāvattvaṃ paribhāṣitaṃ jñeyam||15-16||
ekāgramanaseti yaduktaṃ tadvivṛṇoti- vidhūyetyādi||17||
div.quote: vidhūya mānasān doṣān kāmādīnaśubhodayān ‘kāmakrodhabhayādikān iti pā.
naraḥ śvo vamanaṃ pātā bhuñjīta kaphavardhanam
div.p: vamanavirecanayoḥ pūrvadine yathā bhoktavyaṃ tadāha- nara ityādi| etat prāguktamapi prakaraṇavaśādviśeṣābhidhitsayā+abhidhīyate| pāteti pātukāmaḥ| dravabhūyiṣṭhamiti cchedaḥ| virecanaṃ pātā laghu aśītaṃ ca bhuñjīteti sambandhaḥ| evambhūtabhojanopapattimāha- utkliṣṭetyādi| utkliṣṭālpakaphatveneti vamanaṃ prati utkliṣṭakaphatvena, virecanaṃ prati tvalpakaphatveneti vibhāgaḥ||18||-

vamanavirecanayoḥ śuddhiliṅgāni yadyapi prāguktāni, tathā+apīha śeṣauṣadhamalādiviśeṣābhidhānārthaṃ punaḥ pītauṣadhasyetyādinā tānyabhidhatte| kaphānuge pitte ūrdhvahṛtadoṣaṃ‘ūrdhvakṛtadoṣaṃ’ iti pā. vadet, viṭpitte cānukaphe dṛśyamāne+adhohṛtadoṣaṃ‘adhaḥkṛtadoṣaṃ’ iti pā. vadediti yojanā; etat kaphāntatvaṃ virecanasya, vamanasya ca pittāntatvaṃ pūrvameva vyāhṛtam| etat pittāntatvaṃ kaphāntatvaṃ vā+asamyakśuddhe+api doṣasyānupūrvyā+avasthānādbhavatīti kṛtvā lakṣaṇāntarāṇyapi etayoḥ sāhacaryeṇāha- kārśyadaurbalye cet salāghave iti||19-20||

virecanayoge sāvaśeṣa evauṣadhe śuddhilakṣaṇadarśane sati kartavyamāha- vāmayettu tataḥ śeṣamauṣadhamiti; śuddhilakṣaṇe jāte śeṣamauṣadhamupalabhya virecanātiyogapratiṣedhārthaṃ vāmayedityarthaḥ| na tvalāghave ityanena lāghavavyatiriktaśeṣaśuddhilakṣaṇadarśane satyapi na virecanaśeṣauṣadhavamiḥ kartavyā| vamanauṣadhaprayoge kartavyamāha- staimitye ityādi| vamanauṣadhaprayoge yāvat staimityānilasaṅgau vartete, tāvannirudgāre+api bheṣaje sati vamanaṃ kārayitavyam| etadvamanāvadhimāha- ālāghavāttanutvācca kaphasyeti| pramādāllāghavatanutvayoḥ parataḥ kriyamāṇavamanasya doṣamāha- āpat paraṃ bhavediti; āpaditi atiyogalakṣaṇā| anye tu, staimitye ityādinā+api virecanauṣadhasyaivāvasthikaṃ vamanamucyate ityāhuḥ||21||-

div.quote: vamite vardhate vahniḥ śamaṃ doṣā vrajanti hi
tāni dṛṣṭvā tu peyādikramaṃ kuryānna laṅghanam
div.p: yathoktavamanaphalamāha- vamite vardhate ityādinā| samyagjīrṇaliṅgānyalakṣayanniti saṃśodhanabheṣajasya vakṣyamāṇasamyagjīrṇaliṅgānyalakṣayan| tānīti jīrṇauṣadhaliṅgāni||22-23||

śuddhasya peyādikramopapattimāha- saṃśodhanābhyāmityādi| yadyapi nirūḍhasyāpyagnimāndyaṃ bhavati, tathā+api nirūḍhasya tādṛgagnimāndyaṃ na bhavati yena peyādikramaḥ kriyate, ato nirūhavyudāsārthaṃ saṃśodhanābhyāmiti dvivacanaṃ kṛtam| yā tu samyagviriktalakṣaṇe “ūrjo+agniḥ” (si.a.1) ityanenāgnivṛddhiruktā, sā ca virecanauṣadhakṣobhātisaṅgāt kṛtā+agnimāndyāpekṣayā+agnivṛddhiḥ‘virecanauṣadhajanyāśayakṣobhakṛtāgnimāndyāpekṣayaudaryāgnivṛddhiḥ’ iti śivadāsasenaḥ; teneha yātyagnirmandatāmiti vacanena samaṃ na virodhaḥ||24||
div.quote: saṃśodhanābhyāṃ śuddhasya hṛtadoṣasya ‘laṅghitasya ca’ iti pā.; dehinaḥ
yātyagnirmandatāṃ‘yātyagniraṇutāṃ’ iti pā. tasmāt kramaṃ peyādimācaret

div.p: tarpaṇādiviṣayamāha- kaphapitte ityādi| viśuddhe+alpamiti asamyagviśuddhe| tarpaṇādikrame ca peyāyāḥ sthāne svacchatarpaṇaṃ, vilepyāḥ sthāne ca ghanatarpaṇaṃ deyam||25||
jīrṇauṣadhaliṅgānyāha- anuloma ityādi| ūrjaḥ balam| indriyaśuddhiḥ indriyapāṭavam| udgārasya cauṣadhagandhādivirahitvameva śuddhiḥ||26-27||

div.quote: akāle+alpātimātraṃ ca purāṇaṃ na ca bhāvitam
div.p: yādṛśamauṣadhaṃ vyāpadyate tadāha- akāle ityādi| alpaṃ vā atimātraṃ vā+alpātimātram| na ca bhāvitamiti svarasaistulyavīryairvā+abhāvitam||28||

saṃśodhanāyogātiyogajanyā āviṣkṛtā vyāpadaḥ prāha- ādhmānamityādi| (ādhmānādayaścāmīayaṃ pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake na paṭhyate nāvaśyamayogātiyogānte bhavanti, tenopadravabhūtatvāt pṛthaguktāḥ|) etā vyāpadaḥ preṣyādivaiguṇyādutpannā ayogādatiyogācca bhavantīti vākyārthaḥ| tatrādhmānamayogādbhavati, parikartikā tvatiyogāt, srāvo+ayogāt, hṛdgraho+apyayogādeva, tathā+aṅgagraho+ayogācca bhavati, jīvādānamatiyogāt; vibhraṃśastu gudabhraṃśa-sañjñābhraṃśa-kaṇḍvādilakṣaṇabhraṃśabhedāttrividho vaktavyaḥ; gudabhraṃśa-sañjñābhraṃśāvatiyogajanyau, śeṣastu vibhraṃśo+ayogajanyaḥ; upadravo+apyayogajanya eva, klamo+apyayogajaḥ| eteṣāṃ cāyogātiyogajanyatvavibhāga uttaragranthe sphuṭo bhaviṣyati| yadyapi cāyogātiyogamithyāyogāstatra tatra kāraṇatvenoktāḥ, tathā+apīha vamanavirecanayormithyāyogaṃ necchati; yato doṣāṇāṃ caturvidhaiva pravṛttirbhavati, yat- atipravṛtiḥ, asamyakpravṛttirvā, apravṛttiḥ, alpapravṛttirvā; tatrāpyapravṛttyalpavṛttī ayogagṛhīte eva; yā+api cātra prātilomyena pravṛttiḥ, sā+api doṣasyāpekṣitasyāpravartakatvādayogagṛhītataiva; vakṣyati hi “ayogaḥ prātilomyena na cālpaṃ vā pravartanam” iti||29-30||

yogātiyogāyogasvarūpamāha- yoga ityādi| ativartanamiti saṃśodhyātiriktapravartanam| prātilomyeneti vamanasya virecanena, virecanasya vamanena pravartanam; etacca prātilomyapravartanaṃ ‘yadā gacchati cālpaśaḥ’ iti, ‘navā gacchati cālpaśaḥ’ iti ca pā.; prāyo vivakṣitadoṣāpravartakatayaivāyoganikṣiptam| na cālpaṃ vā pravartanamiti sarvathā+apravartanamalpaṃ vā pravartanamiti| sthitamiti jhaṭiti ūrdhvaṃ gacchat‘sthitaṃ’ iti pā.| etatprātilomyapravṛttyā yathā+ayogatvaṃ tadāha- prātilomyenetyādi| prātilomyenākṛtsnaharaṇāt ayogasañjñe te iti yojyam| prātilomyaharaṇe+akṛsnadoṣaharaṇameva darśayannāha- kṛcchreṇetyādi| pratilomaharaṇe kṛtsno doṣo na yāti, alpaśo vā yātīti bhāvaḥ; tenākṛtsnadoṣaharaṇaṃ pratilomaharaṇe upapannamiti bhāvaḥ| ‘kṛcchreṇa yadāgacchati cālpaśa’ iti pāṭhe, yacchabdo hetau; pūrvatra pāṭhe vā śabdo hetau||31-34||
div.quote: ayogaḥ prātilomyena na cālpaṃ vā pravartanam
tīkṣṇaṃ pītaṃ sthitaṃ kṣubdhaṃ vamanaṃ syādvirecanam
pītauṣadho na śuddhaścejjīrṇe tasmin punaḥ pibet
koṣṭhasya gurutāṃ jñātvā laghutvaṃ balameva ca
ayoge mṛdu vā dadyādauṣadhaṃ tīkṣṇameva vā
div.p: ādhmānādīnāmayogātiyogau kāraṇatvenoktau, tena kāraṇayorayogātiyogayoḥ prathamaṃ hetuliṅgacikitsitāni prāha- pītauṣadha ityādi| jīrṇe iti auṣadhe jīrṇe| punaḥ pibediti tadahareva| bhayaṃ syādatiyogata iti pūrvājīrṇauṣadhanavīnauṣadhābhyāmatiyogaḥ syāt| mṛdu vā dadyādityādau gurukoṣṭhe balavati tīkṣṇaṃ, laghukoṣṭhe durbale ca mṛdu dadyāditi vyavasthā||35-36||
punarvamanavirecanādānaviṣayau prāha- vamanaṃ na tvityādi| punaḥ‘punaḥ pītaṃ bhūyo hanyādityarthaḥ’ iti pā. pītaṃ tu hanyādityarthaḥ||37||
div.quote: vamanaṃ na tu duśchardaṃ duṣkoṣṭhaṃ ‘duśchardyāṃ mṛdukoṣṭhe’ iti pā.; na virecanam
pāyayetauṣadhaṃ bhūyo hanyāt pītaṃ punarhi tau

div.p: stokapravṛttirūpamayogaṃ kāraṇabhedenāha- asnigdhetyādi| asnigdhasyeti asamyaksnigdhasya| rūkṣasyeti na manāgapi snigdhasya| anavamiti jīrṇatayā mandavīryam| nirhartumiti niḥśeṣeṇa hartum| vibhraṃśamiti viparītapravṛttisāmarthyam||38-39||
div.quote: vibhraṃśaṃ śvayathuṃ hikkāṃ tamaso darśanaṃ bhṛśam ‘tṛṣāṃ’ iti pā.;

div.p: aparamayogamāha- snigdhasvinnasya cetyādi| jīrṇamiti alpatvāddīptāgnitvācca jīrṇam| āme iti apakve doṣe, ‘pītaṃ’ iti śeṣaḥ| ete+atrāyogalakṣaṇatrayeṇa ye pratipāditā gadā na te bhinnasāmagrījanyā bhinnacikitsā vā, tena na pūrvamayogajanyavyāpattiprastāve paṭhitāḥ; evamatiyogalakṣaṇatayā vakṣyamāṇagadeṣvapi vācyam| yathoktamiti ‘pītauṣadho na śuddhaścet’ ityādinoktaṃ; kiṃvā+agre ‘taṃ taila’ ityādigranthenoktam| pāyayeteti saṃśodhanaṃ pāyayeta| dhānvairiti dhanvamṛgapakṣimāṃsarasaiḥ||40-44||

atiyogasya hetvādikamāha- atitīkṣṇamityādi| iyaṃ ca sāmagrī virecanātiyogasyaiva ghaṭate; yato mṛdukoṣṭhe bubhukṣite ca viṭpittakaphaharaṇakrameṇa ca saivātiyujyate‘tadevātiyujyate’ iti pā.; vamanātiyogasāmagrī cānenodāharaṇenonneyā; kiṃvā, atitīkṣṇamiti padenaiva vamanasyāpyatitīkṣṇatvamatiyogakāraṇamuktaṃ, viṭpittakaphaharaṇaṃ yathāyogyatayā krameṇa virecane vamane ca boddhavyam| śeṣamauṣadhamullikhediti tādātvikī cikitsā| mṛdvitipadaṃ vamanena virecanena ca sambadhyate| vaṭādīnāmiti nyagrodhodumbarāśvatthakapītanānām| varcaḥsaṅgrāhikāḥ ṣaḍvirecanaśatāśritīyoktāḥ priyaṅgvanantādayaḥ||45-51||
div.quote: balasvarakṣayaṃ dāhaṃ kaṇṭhaśoṣaṃ bhramaṃ‘klamaṃ’ iti pā. tṛṣām
vamane tu virekaḥ syādvireke vamanaṃ punaḥ‘mṛdu’ iti pā.
varcaḥsāṅgrāhikaiḥ siddhaṃ kṣīraṃ bhojyaṃ ca dāpayet

div.p: purato+amlaphalakhādanaṃ mukhasrāvaṇena jihvāstabdhatvaṃ hantum‘hanyāt’ iti pā.| atiyoge niḥsṛtāmiti jihvāviśeṣaṇam||52-56||
div.quote: yavāgūṃ tanukāṃ dadyāt‘tanvīṃ dadyādyavāgūṃ ca’ iti pā. snehasvedau ca buddhimān

div.p: atiyoge+api yathā peyādikramo bhavati tadāha- vamitaścetyādi| atiharaṇādativamito+ativiriktaśceti boddhavyam||57||
div.quote: agniprāṇavivṛddhyarthaṃ kramaṃ peyādikaṃ bhajet ‘peyādimācaret’ iti pā.;

div.p: ayogātiyogayorādhmānādivyāpadāṃ yathākramaṃ hetuliṅgacikitsādi nirdiśannāha- bahudoṣasyetyādi| etāśca vyāpado nāvaśyamatiyogāyogayorbhavanti, upadravabhūtatvāt‘upadravarūpatvāt’ iti pā.; ata evopakalpanīye- “atiyogāyoganimittānimānupadravān vidyāt”- “ādhmānaṃ parikartikā”(sū.a.15) ityādinā granthena etā daśa vyāpadaḥ pratipāditāḥ||58-60||

parikartikāmāha- snigdhenetyādi| pītaṃ gatvā gudamityādi virecanātiyogajanyaparikartikāyāṃ saṅgataṃ, na vamanātiyogajanyaparikartikāyām; upakalpanīye ca sākṣādvamanāyogātiyogajanyatayaivādhmānādaya uktāḥ, tenānukto+api vamanavyāpattau parikarto+anenodāharaṇena ‘anilodāharaṇena’ iti, ‘+anehodāharaṇena’ iti ca pā.; kalpanīyaḥ; tantrāntare+apyuktaṃ- ‘yā tu parikartikā virecane, tadvamane kaṇṭhakarṣaṇaṃ; yo+adhaḥparisrāvo virecane, sa vamane kaphaprasekaḥ” (su.ci.a.34) iti; tadanayā diśā ādhmānādīni vamanavirecanayorayogātiyogajanyatayā vyākhyātānītyeke| āśu doṣaṃ nirasyeti vamanātiyogajanyeyaṃ vyāpat| atra laṅghanādikriyā atiyoge satyapyāmapācanāya jñeyā| kṣāmeṇa mṛdukoṣṭhenetyādisamprāptijanitasya kṣāmapuruṣaprabhavasya laṅghanapācanādyamupakrāntameva||61-63||
div.quote: pītaṃ gatvā gudaṃ sāmamāśu doṣaṃ nirasya ca
laṅghanaṃ pācanaṃ‘dīpanaṃ’ iti pā. sāme rūkṣoṣṇaṃ laghubhojanam

div.p: āmāvasthākartavyamāha- āme jīrṇa ityādi| kṣārāmlaṃ laghu śasyata iti atīsāre yaduktaṃ- “cāṅgerīkoladadhyamlanāgarakṣārasaṃyutam| ghṛtaṃ” (ci.a.19) iti; laghumātraṃ ca śasyata iti jñeyam| puṣpakāsīsamityatra puṣpaśabdena kecit sāṅgrāhikāni dhātakīkusumādīni grāhayanti||64-67||
div.quote: dadhyamlaṃ bhojane‘dadhyannaṃ bhojanaṃ’ iti pā. pāne saṃyuktaṃ dāḍimatvacā
kaṣāyamadhuraṃ śītaṃ‘bastiṃ’ iti pā. picchābastimathāpi vā
alpālpaṃ srāvayet kaṇḍūṃ śophaṃ kuṣṭhāni gauravam
div.p: alpamityādinā parisrāvamāha| śamayedvāmayedapītyādau alpadoṣe śamanaṃ, bahudoṣe ūrdhvagatadoṣe tu vamanamiti vyavasthā| vāmayedapītyatrāpi snehitaṃ punariti sambadhyate| cūrṇāsavāriṣṭā grahaṇyarśaścikitsādiṣu jñeyāḥ||68-70||

pītauṣadhasyetyādinā hṛdgrahamāha| na gacchedvibhramaṃ tatreti hṛdgrahapīḍito+ayaṃ mriyamāṇo vā+ayamiti bhrāntiṃ na gacchedityarthaḥ| vamanaṃ cātra mūrcchite duḥśakaprayogaṃ, tena mūrcchārambha eva vamanaṃ kārayitavyaṃ; kiṃvā mūrcchāyāmapyaṅgulīpraveśādinā vamanaṃ kārayitavyam| pittamūrcchārtamiti pittaprabaladoṣajanitamūrcchārtam| ativamata iti vamanāyātipravāhaṇaṃ kurvataḥ| pittakaphe+anyatheti pitte kaphe vā hṛdayapīḍākare snigdhāmlalavaṇaviparītaṃ rūkṣatiktakaṭukādikramaṃ kuryāt||71-75||
div.quote: kupitā hṛdayaṃ gatvā ghoraṃ kurvanti hṛdgraham
na gacchedvibhramaṃ tatra vāmayedāśu taṃ bhiṣak
kāyāgniṃ ca balaṃ cāsya krameṇotthāpayettataḥ ‘krameṇābhipravardhayet’ iti pā.

div.p: pītauṣadhasyetyādinā aṅgagrahaṇamayogajamatiyogajaṃ cāha| kaphena vā ruddho doṣaḥ punaraṅgāni nigṛhṇāti; śuddhasya vā mārutaḥ kupito+aṅgāni pratigṛhṇāti stambhādibhiḥ||76-77||
div.quote: ruddho+ati‘ruddho+atīva viśuddhasya’ iti pā. vā viśuddhasya gṛhṇātyaṅgāni mārutaḥ
tatra vātaharaṃ sarvaṃ snehasvedādi kārayet‘śasyate’ iti pā.

div.p: atitīkṣṇamityādinā jīvādānamāha| laghudoṣasyeti svalpadoṣasya| vinirmathyeti śoṇitameva kṣobhayitvā‘kṣodayitvā’ iti pā.| jīvamiti jīvanahetudhāturūpaṃ śoṇitam| śoṇitaṃ kiñcidraktapittakṣobhādbhavati, kiñcicca jīvaśoṇitaṃ bhavati; tadviśeṣaparīkṣārthamāha- tenānnamityādi| pittamādiśediti śoṇitagataṃ pittamādiśed raktapittamiti yāvat| āvānamiti śuṣkam| pitte iti raktapitte sati kṣālitaṃ vastraṃ vivarṇaṃ bhavati, jīvaśoṇite tu sati śuddhaṃ vastraṃ bhavati| parīkṣā ca cikitsābhedārthameva; raktapitte raktapittaharī kriyā, jīvaśoṇitaṃ tu dṛṣṭvā ‘tṛṣṇāmūrcchāmadārtasya’ ityādinoktā kartavyā| atiyoge ca yā hiteti atraiva ‘pariṣekāvagāhādyaiḥ suśītaiḥ stambhayecca tam’ ityādinoktā jñeyā| jīvaṃ taddhyāśu gacchatīti asṛkprabhāvādāśveva śoṇitarūpatāṃ yāti sadyaskamasṛk| śyāmetyādau śyāmā priyaṅguḥ||78-84||
div.quote: doṣān hṛtvā vinirmathya jīvaṃ harati śoṇitam
prakṣālitaṃ vivarṇaṃ syāt pitte‘pittaṃ śuddhaṃ tu śoṇitam’ iti pā. śuddhaṃ tu śoṇite
tasya pittaharīṃ sarvāmatiyoge ca yā hitā‘matā’ iti pā.
pibejjīvābhisandhānaṃ jīvaṃ taddhyāśu gacchati ‘pāyayetāśu sandhānaṃ jīvo jīvena gacchati’ iti pā.;
tadā kurvanti kaṇḍvādīn doṣāḥ prakupitā gadān
div.p: gudaṃ bhraṣṭamityādinā gudabhraṃśarūpaṃ vibhraṃśamāha| kaṣāyairiti kaṣāyarasaiḥ| sāmetyādinā sañjñāvibhraṃśarūpavibhraṃśacikitsāmāha| sāma sāntvanam| gāndharvaśabdo gītam| etau ca vibhraṃśāvatiyogajanyau| yadetyādinā tṛtīyamayogajanyavibhraṃśamāha| viḍantamavatiṣṭhata iti malamātramapahṛtyāvatiṣṭhate| bheṣajāntamiti bheṣajamātraṃ vamanenāvatiṣṭhate| nāvahediti nāpaharati| etadvyāpadaśca vibhraṃśasañjñā pāribhāṣikī| yathāvyādhibheṣajamiti kaṇḍvādiviparītaṃ bheṣajam||85-87||

div.quote: tīkṣṇaṃ bastiṃ virekaṃ vā so+arho laṅghitapācitaḥ
div.p: pītaṃ snigdhenetyādinā stambhamāha| mārdavādvṛtamiti bheṣajasya mṛdutayā doṣairvṛtam| svasthānāccyutān stambhayediti yojanīyam| so+arha iti laṅghanapācanānantaraṃ tīkṣṇaṃ bastiṃ virekaṃ vā tīkṣṇamarhatītyarthaḥ||88-89||

rūkṣamityādinā upadravānāha| yadyapyādhmānādayo+apyamī upadravā eva, tathā+api teṣāṃ sañjñāntareṇaiva gṛhītatvācchūlādaya eva upadravaśabdābhihitāḥ| śūlādayaścāmī pradhānānyuttarakālabhāvitvādanupadravarūpā apyupadravaśabdenocyante; yathā- “dhūmaḥ kuryādupadravān” (sū.a.5) iti; kiṃvā, ayogākhyasya vyādheramī upadravā iti jñeyam||90-91||
snigdhasyetyādinā klamamāha| kaphaṃ pittaṃ cotkliśya vātaṃ ca tābhyāmeva saṃrudhya bheṣajaṃ tandrādiyuktaṃ klamaṃ kuryāt| tadullikhediti tad bheṣajaṃ kaphapittaṃ collikhedityarthaḥ||92-93||
div.quote: pittaṃ vātaṃ ca saṃrudhya satandrāgauravaṃ klamam
laṅghanaṃ pācanaṃ cātra‘kāle’ iti pā. snigdhaṃ tīkṣṇaṃ ca śodhanam

div.p: ityetā ityādinā adhyāyārthasaṅgrahaṃ darśayitvā vyāpadutpādahetumāha| dadyāt saṃśodhanaṃ samyagiti tathā saṃśodhanaṃ dadyād yathā vyāpado notpadyanta evetyarthaḥ||94-95||
div.quote: tatra ślokau- ityetā vyāpadaḥ proktāḥ sarūpāḥ sacikitsitāḥ
vamanasya virekasya kṛtasyākuśalairnṛṇām ‘virecanasyākuśalairdattasya vamanasya ca’ iti pā.
etā ‘dhīmān vijñāya tāstasmādavasthāścaiva tattvataḥ’ iti pā.; vijñāya matimānavasthāścaiva tattvataḥ
dadyāt‘kuryāt’ iti pā. saṃśodhanaṃ samyagārogyārthī ‘samyagārogyārthaṃ’ iti pā. nṛṇāṃ sadā
ityagniveśakṛte tantre carakapratisaṃskṛte+aprāpte dṛḍhabalasampūrite siddhisthāne vamanavirecanavyāpatsiddhirnāma ṣaṣṭho+adhyāyaḥ
div.p: iti śrīcakrapāṇidattaviracitāyāmāyurvedadīpikāyāṃ carakatātparyaṭīkāyāṃ siddhisthāne vamanavirecanavyāpatsiddhi(saṃśodhanavyāpatsiddhi)rnāma ṣaṣṭho+adhyāyaḥ||6||
vamanavirecanānantarabhāvitvādbasteḥ saṃśodhanavyāpatsiddheranantaraṃ bastivyāpatsiddhirucyate; atra bastiśabdo nirūha eva vartate, tadvyāpadāmevātra vaktavyatvāt||1-2||

kāḥ katītyādi pañca praśnāḥ| nātiyogāvityādinā ādyapraśnasyottaram| nātiyogāviti ayogātiyogau| etaddvādaśavyāpadāṃ ca vivaraṇa eva sphuṭārtho bhaviṣyati| asamyagyogasambhavā iti nirūhasyāyogātiyogamithyāyogarūpāsamyagyogasambhavāḥ| anena ca samutthānapraśnasya sāmānyakāraṇābhidhānenottaraṃ dattaṃ bhavati| atra bastiprayogasyāsamyagyogena nirūhakāryadoṣaharaṇasyātiyogāyogau vyāpattirūpau janyete klamādayo+api cātiyogāyogajātā eva viśiṣṭahetulakṣaṇacikitsitatayā ihāpi pṛthagucyante, yathā saṃśodhane ādhmānādayo+ayogātiyogajātā api pṛthaguktāḥ| kecit ‘nātiyogāt klamādhmāne’ ityādi, tathā ‘daśaitā vyāpado basteḥ’ ityādi paṭhanti; tatra pūrvādhyāyoktavyākhyānādartho neyaḥ‘artha unneyaḥ’ iti pā.; kintu pūrva eva pāṭho nirvyūhaḥ| āsāmityādau rūpaśabdenaiva prati prati vakṣyamāṇahetuviśeṣo+avaruddho jñeyaḥ, yena heturapi hi vyāsagamakatayā rūpameva||3-6||
div.quote: pravāhikā śiroṅgārtiḥ parikartaḥ‘parikartiḥ’ iti pā. parisravaḥ

div.p: gurukoṣṭhe iti krūrakoṣṭhe malapūrṇakoṣṭhe vā| alpaśabdo mātrāntaiḥ pratyekaṃ sambadhyate| uṣṇāyāḥ pramathyāyā iti atīsāroktapramathyānāṃ yā pramathyā uṣṇā tasyāḥ prayogaḥ; pramathyeti pācanakaṣāyasyāyurvedasamayasiddhasañjñeti pratipāditamevātīsāre| kālaṃ jñātveti virecanayogyāvasthāṃ jñātvā| surādimūtravānityatra ādiśabdena sauvīrakatuṣodakādīnāṃ grahaṇam| saprākpeṣya iti bastisūtrīyoktabalādibastyuktakalkayuktaḥ| tamānayediti ayogakārakaṃ vibaddhaṃ bastiṃ harati||7-11||

ayogamabhidhāyātiyogamāha- snigdhasvinne ityādi| atiyujyate iti atiyogakārako bhavati| śodhanābhyāṃ samā bhavediti vamanavirecanātiyogoktaliṅgacikitsitābhyāṃ samā bhavet| bastyatiyogaje dāhe viśiṣṭacikitsāmāha- pṛśniparṇīmityādi| atra kṣīrādiṣu pañcadraveṣu kalkasya vilayanam| drākṣādiprasādāḥ śītakaṣāyavidhikṛtā jñeyāḥ||12-14||
div.quote: tasya liṅgaṃ cikitsā ca śodhanābhyāṃ samā bhavet
pṛśniparṇīṃ sthirāṃ padmaṃ kāśmaryaṃ madhukaṃ balām
piṣṭvā drākṣāṃ madhūkaṃ‘madhukotpalam’ iti pā. ca kṣīre taṇḍuladhāvane
vinīya saghṛtaṃ bastiṃ dadyāddāhe+atiyogaje ‘…ddāhātiyogine’ iti pā.;

div.p: āmaśeṣe ityādinā klamamāha| āmaśeṣe sati dattena nirūheṇa doṣa īrita iti yojyam| doṣaśabdena cātra pittakaphāvāmasahitau mārgāvarakāvucyete| mūrcchayatīti mārgāvarodhāt kopayati| mārgaṃ ruṇaddhīti dehe srotāṃsi ruṇaddhi| ye tu, doṣaśabdeneha kaphamātraṃ grāhayanti, tanmate sadāhatvaṃ klamasyāpyanupapannam| vacetyādau mūrcchitā iti āloḍitāḥ| kṣārāṃśca dīpanāniti grahaṇīcikitsādyuktān| dāśamūlikamiti “dvipañcamūlasya raso+amlayuktaḥ” (si.a.3) ityādinoktaṃ; kiṃvā daśamūlakvāthakṛtam| mādhutailikaḥ vakṣyamāṇaḥ||15-20||
div.quote: āmaśeṣe‘āmadoṣe’ iti pā. nirūheṇa mṛdunā ‘mūrcchayatyanilaṃ mārgaṃ ruṇaddhyagniṃ hinasti ca’ iti pā. doṣa īritaḥ
klamaṃ vidāhaṃ‘sadāhaṃ’ iti pā. hṛcchūlaṃ mohaveṣṭanagauravam
dāru trikaṭukaṃ‘trikaṇṭakaṃ’ iti pā. pathyāṃ palāśaṃ citrakaṃ śaṭīm
piṣṭvā kuṣṭhaṃ ca mūtreṇa pibet kṣārāṃśca dīpanān

div.p: alpavīrya ityādinā ādhmānamāha| ruddhamārga iti nivāritādhomārgaḥ; sa cānilaṃ ruṇaddhi, anilaśca ruddhamārgatayā ādhmānaṃ karotīti| marmapīḍanamityādhmānaviśeṣaṇam| ruṇaddhi hṛdayaṃ śūlairiti śūlairhṛdayaṃ vyāpnoti| śyāmāphalādibhiriti śyāmādibhirnavabhiḥ, phalādibhiśca ṣaḍbhiḥ kalpasthānoktaiḥ| dhūmaśabdeneha gṛhadhūmagrahaṇam| guḍaścātra‘guḍasyātra pṛthak palam’ iti pā. tāvanmātro bhavati yāvatā vartiḥ kartuṃ yujyate| karāṅguṣṭhetyatra karagrahaṇaṃ pādāṅguṣṭhaniṣedhārtham| athavetyādinoktadvitīyavartāvapi vartitvasampattyarthaṃ guḍo deyaḥ| bilvādibhiśca nirūha iti “bilvamūlatrivṛddāruyavakolakulatthavān” ityādinoktaḥ| saraletyādau siddhamityatra ‘tailaṃ’ iti śeṣaḥ||21-26||
div.quote: karāṅguṣṭhanibhāṃ vartiṃ yavamadhyāṃ nidhāpayet ‘praveśayet’ iti pā.;

div.p: mṛdvityādinā hikkāmāha| atinirharanniti atiyogena doṣānnirharan| hikkāghnamiti hikkācikitsoktaṃ bheṣajam| hikkāyāṃ ca yadyapi “prasaktacchardiniṣṭhīvikākāsaśvāsahikkārtānāmūrdhvībhūto vāyurūrdhvaṃ bastiṃ nayet” (si.a.2) ityanena bastirniṣiddhaḥ, tathā+apīha viśiṣṭahikkāyāmanuvāsanasya hitatvāt, “balāsthirādi” ityādinoktamanuvāsanamanavadyam| vātanuditi padaṃ liṅgavipariṇāmena dhūmādibhiśca sambadhyate; tena vātahitānāmevātra dhūmādīnāṃ prayogaḥ||27-29||
div.quote: kuryāddhikkāṃ, hitaṃ tasmai hikkāghnaṃ bṛṃhaṇaṃ ca yat
kṛṣṇālavaṇayorakṣaṃ pibeduṣṇāmbunā yutam ‘uṣṇāmbunā+akṣaḥ pippalyā hito lavaṇasaṃyutaḥ’ iti pā.;
atitīkṣṇaḥ savāto vā na vā samyak prapīḍitaḥ
div.p: atitīkṣṇa ityādinā hṛtprāptimāha| savātatvaṃ basterniḥśeṣadānādinā jñeyam| asamyakpīḍitatvameva hṛtprāptijanakatayā jñeyam| lavaṇaskandhaḥ rogabhiṣagjitīyoktaḥ| vātaghnairiti daśamūlādibhiḥ||30-31||

vātamūtretyādinordhvatāmāha| datte iti bastau datte| tasyordhvaṃ gacchato bastermūrcchārūpaṃ vikāraṃ dṛṣṭvā mukhasecanādi kartavyam| ākāśe dhunuyāditi niravalambaṃ dhunuyāt| trāsayecca gokharādibhiriti jñeyam| evamanyairiti anuktairapi trāsanaprakāraiḥ| kaṇṭhāvarodho yathā kartavyastadāha- na mriyate yatheti| kaṇṭhoparodhaprayojanamāha- prāṇodānanirodhāddhi prasiddhataramārgavānityādi| kaṇṭhapragraheṇa prāṇodānanirodhāt prasiddhataramārgavānapāno bhavati, gudapravartanasvarūpo bhavatītyarthaḥ; tataśca bastimūrdhvakṣiptamadho nayati; prāṇodānanirodhena tu prāṇodānābhyāṃ pīḍito+apānaḥ svamārgagāmī bhavatīti jñeyam| kecittu ‘yāvat prāṇoparodhāddhi’ iti paṭhanti, tatra prāṇoparodhaṃ yāvat kaṇṭhapīḍanaṃ kartavyamityarthaḥ| kramukaṃ pūgaphalam| śiraḥstha iti bastyekadeśe śirasi sthite sati| pracchādyamiti ālepanīyam||32-39||
div.quote: keśeṣvālambya cākāśe‘cākeśaṃ dhunuyānnāmayedbhṛśam’ iti pā. dhunuyāttrāsayecca tam
ulkābhirevamanyaiśca bhītasyādhaḥ ‘bastiṃ tasyānayedadhaḥ’ iti pā.; pravartate
śiraḥsthe nāvanaṃ dhūmaḥ pracchādyaṃ sarṣapaiḥ śiraḥ

div.p: snigdhasvinnetyādinā pravāhikāmāha| pravāhikāmatīsāroktalakṣaṇāmuktāṃ janayati| śodhanīyānulomikānityatra śodhanīyāniti trivṛdādiśodhanadravyayuktān; ānulomikāniti anulomanakṣīrekṣurasayuktān| vṛttimiti peyādikramam||40-42||

durbale ityādinā śirortimāha| tanuḥ aghanaḥ| tadvihata iti nirūhabastiprakopitaḥ| ūrdhvaṃ mūrdhni vihanyate iti ūrdhvamanusaran mūrdhni vihanyate; ye tu ‘ūrdhvaṃ vidhāvati’ iti paṭhanti, tanmate uparyupari dhāvatītyarthaḥ| asya virecayediti atra ‘śira’ iti śeṣaḥ, ‘anu virecayet’ iti vā pāṭhaḥ| tīkṣṇānulomike+anne bhukte sati anuvāsayediti yojyam; kiṃvā tīkṣṇānulomikenaivānuvāsanaṃ sādhyamityarthaḥ||43-46||
div.quote: mārgairgātrāṇi ‘mārgairgātrāṇyanusarannūrdhvaṃ mūrdhni vidhāvati’ iti pā.; sandhāvannūrdhvaṃ mūrdhni‘mūrdhanyupāhitaḥ’ iti pā. vihanyate
grīvāṃ manye ca gṛhṇāti‘saṃstabhya’ iti pā. śiraḥ kaṇṭhaṃ bhinatti ca
tīkṣṇānulomikenātha snigdhaṃ bhukte+anuvāsayet ‘virecanairnirūhaiśca bastibhiścānulomikaiḥ’ iti pā.;

div.p: snehasvedairityādinā aṅgārtimāha| anāpādyeti snehasvedaiḥ śarīraṃ nopapādya| so+atimātraṃ pravartayet ‘doṣān’ iti śeṣaḥ| tataḥ stabdhodāvṛtakoṣṭhasya rujāṃ karoti| bhuktavato yadyapyanuvāsanaṃ sarvatra bhavati, tathā+api bhuktavata iti vacanena bhojanānantaramevānuvāsanaṃ darśayati||47-53||
div.quote: snehasvedairanāpādya ‘susnigdhasvinnadehasya yasya bastirvidhīyate; atitīkṣṇo guruścaiva’ iti, ‘virecanairnirūhaiśca bastibhiścānulomikaiḥ; atitīkṣṇo guruścaiva’ iti ca pā.; gurustīkṣṇo+atimātrayā

yavān ‘yavakolakulatthānāṃ pañcamūladvayasya ca; jaladroṇe samutkvāthya kaṣāyaṃ saindhavena tam;; bilvatailena saṃyojya bastiṃ dadyādvikāravit; taṃ nirūhasamāśvastaṃ’ iti pā.; kulatthān kolāni pañcamūle tathobhaye

yaṣṭīmadhukatailena bilvatailena vā bhiṣak ‘snehasvedairanāpādya gurustīkṣṇo+atimātrayā; yasya bastiḥ prayujyeta nātimātraṃ sa yujyate; stabdhodāvṛtakoṣṭhasya ruddhaḥ srotaḥsu mārutaḥ; prapanno+aṅgarujaṃ kuryāttaṃ tailalavaṇānvitam; uṣṇambuprastarakvāthaiḥ svedaiḥ samupapādayet;; sabilvatailalavaṇo nirūhastasya śasyate; tailāvagāhasvinnasya kārayedanuvāsanam’ iti pā.;

div.p: mṛdvityādinā parikartikāmāha| bastinirlekhanāditi vāyunā ca tīkṣṇena bastikarṣaṇāt| vyaktāmla iti bastiviśeṣaṇam||54-57||
pittaroge ityādinā parisrāvamāha| kṣiṇotīti hinasti| eṣa kalpa iti ārdraśālmalīvṛntoktakṣīrasaṃskārakalpaḥ| suvarcalamiti suniṣaṇṇakamāhuḥ| karbudāraḥ kāñcanāraḥ||58-62||
div.quote: pittaroge+amla‘pittarakte’ iti pā. uṣṇo vā tīkṣṇo vā lavaṇo+athavā
sāryate bahuvegena‘bahudhā hyativegena’ iti pā. mohaṃ gacchati cāsakṛt
gude sekāḥ pradehāśca śītāḥ syurmadhurāśca ye

div.p: samprati tatra tatra bastīnāṃ mṛdutvaṃ tīkṣṇatvaṃ ca vihitaṃ; tena tadvijñānārthaṃ mārdavatīkṣṇatvakārakadravyagaṇamāha- tīkṣṇatvamityādi| pīluḥ auttarapathikaṃ phalaṃ; pīlusthāne kecid bilvaṃ paṭhanti| prāptakālamiti uktāvastham||63||

bastiprabhāvamāha- āpādetyādi| pakvāśaye sthita iti pakvāśayagata eva| ādatte vīryeṇeti śaktyā svabhāvasambaddhayā| evambhūtavīryaṃ bastāveva; tena pācanādiprayogāṇāṃ na bastivattadahareva sakaladehagatadoṣavijetṛtvaṃ bhavati| khastha iti ākāśagataḥ| suśrute tūktaṃ- “vīryeṇa bastirādatte doṣānāpādamastakāt| pakvāśayastho+ambarago bhūmerarko rasāniva” (su.ci.a.35) iti||64||
samprati basteḥ śarīre malaprasādasahite+api yathā malāṃśamātrahārakatvaṃ bhavati, taddṛṣṭāntena darśayannāha- yadvadityādi| dravīkṛtāditi snehasvedābhyāṃ vilāyitāt| malāniti doṣān purīṣaṃ ca||65||

div.quote: tatra ślokaḥ- ityetā vyāpadaḥ proktā basteḥ sākṛtibheṣajāḥ
div.p: ityetā ityādisaṅgrahaḥ| yasmādetā vyāpado bastiduṣprayogajanyā bhavanti, tasmāt kārtsnyena bastīn buddhvā niyuñjannāparādhyati, bastivyāpadaṃ nāsādayatītyarthaḥ||66||
iti śrīcakrapāṇidattaviracitāyāmāyurvedadīpikāyāṃ carakatātparyaṭīkāyāṃ siddhisthāne bastivyāpatsiddhirnāma saptamo+adhyāyaḥ||7||
div.quote: ityagniveśakṛte tantre carakapratisaṃskṛte+aprāpte dṛḍhabalasampūrite siddhisthāne bastivyāpatsiddhirnāma ‘bastivyāpadikī siddhirnāma’ iti pā.; saptamo+adhyāyaḥ

div.p: samprati bastivyāpatpraśamakabastyabhidhāyakatayaiva prāsṛtayogīyā siddhirucyate| prasṛtopalakṣitā ye yogāḥ tānadhikṛtya kṛtā siddhiḥ; tena prasṛtālakṣitā‘prasṛtopalakṣitāḥ’ iti pā. apyatra yogā vaktavyā eva||1-2||
div.quote: athātaḥ prāsṛtayogīyāṃ‘prāsṛtayogikīṃ’ iti pā. siddhiṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ

div.p: imāniti agre vakṣyamāṇān| tenādhyāyaśeṣavaktavyānāṃ nāvaśyaṃ prasṛtopalakṣitavidhānam| sukumārāṇāmiti tanvādiguṇasambaddhaṃ bhavati||3||
div.quote: athemān sukumārāṇāṃ nirūhān snehanān‘śodhanān’ iti pā. mṛdūn
karmaṇā viplutānāṃ ca vakṣyāmi prasṛtaiḥ pṛthak

div.p: prasṛtaṃ paladvayam| madhutailaghṛtāttraya iti militāt| atra ca yathoktaireva dravyairbastirdeyaḥ; tena netarabastinyāyenānuktakalkādikalpanā; yatra niyatamānadravyavibhāgena bastyabhidhānaṃ, tatra sāmānyabastidravyamānānavakāśaḥ; yatra tvekadeśakathanaṃ, tatra nirūhayogitayoktadravyamānādhikāraḥ; saindhavapraveśastvatyājya eva| bilvādimūlaṃ daśamūlam| sa vātanuditi sa bastirvātaṃ hantīti||4-6||
hapuṣākarṣaḥ||7||
div.quote: prasṛto‘prasṛtau hapuṣākṣaudrānnirūhaḥ’ iti pā. hapuṣākarṣo nirūhaḥ śukrakṛt param

div.p: paṭoletyādau ambhasaḥ iti kvāthāt| sarṣapakalkita iti atra yadyapi kalkamānaṃ noktaṃ, tathā+api dvādaśaprasṛte nirūhe dvipalakalkasya vihitatvādiha pañcaprasṛte tadanusārāt ṣaḍbhāgonaṃ palaṃ bhavati; evamanyatrāpyanuktamānakalkavyavasthā||8||-
viḍaṅgetyādau phalaṃ madanaphalam| ākhuparṇī dantī||10||
div.quote: kaṣāyāt‘kaṣāyāḥ’ iti pā. prasṛtāḥ pañca tailādeko vimathya tān

div.p: payasyetyādau yadyapi payasyādīnāṃ kvātho na śrūyate, tathā+api dravāntaraiḥ samamekaikaprasṛtavidhānāt pratyekaṃ payasyādikvāthasya prasṛtamānatvam| vṛṣatvakṛditi śukravṛddhikṛt||11-12||
śvadaṃṣṭretyādau śvadaṃṣṭrādidravyatrayakvāthasya pratyekaṃ prasṛtamānatvam, evaṃ tailasurāsavaprasṛtābhyāṃ saha pañcaprasṛtāḥ pūraṇīyāḥ; surākṛta āsavaḥ surāsavaḥ||13-14||
div.quote: kalkaḥ ‘kalkobastistu sānāhe mūtrakṛcchre paro mataḥ’ iti pā.; syānmūtrakṛcchre tu sānāhe bastiruttamaḥ

div.p: etaduktamṛdubastiprayogānāmante kartavyamāha- mṛdvityādi| svādu pratyāsthāpanamiṣyata ityatra svādu drākṣādidravyakṛtam| kecittadahareva pratyāsthāpanamicchanti| āsthāpanaṃ lakṣyīkṛtya dīyata iti pratyāsthāpanam||15||
div.quote: tīkṣṇairvikarṣite svādu pratyāsthāpanamiṣyate ‘pratyāsthāpanameva vā’ iti pā.;

div.p: vātopasṛṣṭasyetyādau uṣṇairiti bastiviśeṣaṇam| dāhādayo dāhamohatṛḍādayo vātapittajanyāḥ| drākṣāmbunā trivṛtpānasya dāhādikārake pitte vāte ca hitatvaṃ darśayannāha- taddhītyādi||16-17||
div.quote: vātopasṛṣṭasyoṣṇaiḥ syurgudadāhādayo ‘…rgadā dāhādayo yadi’ iti pā.; yadi

div.p: kulmāṣā iti ardhasvinnayavādimayā ‘ardhasvinnayavādipiṣṭamayāḥ’ iti pā. bhakṣyāḥ||18||
div.quote: māṣayūṣeṇa kulmāṣān pibenmadhvathavā‘pibeddadhyathavā’ iti pā. surām

div.p: bastimithyāprayogodīritānāmatīsārabhedānāṃ cikitsitamāha- sāmaṃ cedityādi| sāmaṃ yathā syāt‘bhavati’ iti pā. tathopaviśediti; tena malādivyatiriktāmamātropaveśarūpo+ayamatīsāraḥ kevalāmaśakṛdvātaraktapittakaphajanyānāmiha ṣaṇṇāmatīsārāṇāṃ vaktavyānāṃ prathama ukto bhavati| kuṇapamiti śavagandham| śūlaiḥ ‘yukta’ iti śeṣaḥ| ghanaṃ mustakam||19||
div.quote: sāmaṃ‘sāmaṃ cedatisāryeta pūti śūlairarocakī’ iti pā. cet kuṇapaṃ śūlairupaviśedarocakī

div.p: kevalaśakṛdādijanyāṃścātisārānāha- śakṛdvātamityādi| pakvamiti nirāmam| āmaśabdenehāgnidaurbalyādavipakvāhārarasa eva koṣṭhopalepaka āmo gṛhyate; yaduktamanyatra- “āmāśayasthaḥ kāyāgnerdaurbalyādavipācitaḥ| ādya āhāradhāturyaḥ sa āma iti sañjñitaḥ” iti| svavargīyairiti purīṣasaṅgrahaṇavātaghnaśoṇitāsthāpanapittakaphaharabheṣajavargaiḥ; kiṃvā uttaratra pratyekaṃ śakṛdādivakṣyamāṇabheṣajaiḥ||20||
div.quote: pakvaṃ‘pakvastatra’ iti pā., tatra svavargīyairbastiḥ śreṣṭhaṃ bhiṣagjitam

div.p: atīsārabhedānāha- ṣaṇṇāmityādi| eṣāmiti etadabhihitānām| anye tu bastivibhraṃśajāḥ ṣaṭsaṅkhyā bhavantīti vadanti; pūrvavyākhyānameva sādhu||21||
upadravāneṣāmāha- śūletyādi||22||

yathoktātīsāreṣu cikitsāmāha- tatrāme ityādi| antarapānaṃ pācanamāhuḥ| pācanamityanena ceha pūrvaṃ ‘sa ghanātiviṣā’ ityādyuktaṃ pācanaṃ gṛhyate| vyoṣāmlalavaṇairyutamiti vyoṣāmlalavaṇayogena kṛtam||23||
div.quote: tatrāme+antarapānaṃ‘tatrāme vamanaṃ kāryaṃ’ iti pā. syāt vyoṣāmlalavaṇairyutam

div.p: vātaghnairityādau vātaghnaṃ daśamūlaṃ; grāhivargaśca ṣaḍvirecanaśatāśritīyokta eva| atra jatūkarṇaḥ- “śakṛti śophaghnagrāhibhirbastiḥ” ityāha; śophaghnaṃ ca daśamūlameva|24|
svādvamlalavaṇaiḥ śastaḥ snehabastiriti svādvamlalavaṇadravyasādhitasnehakṛtamanuvāsanamityarthaḥ| samīraṇe iti kevalavātātīsāre||24||
rakte rakteneti sarakte+atīsāryamāṇe raktena bastirdeyaḥ| pitte tviti pitte+atīsāryamāṇe kaṣāyādikṛto bastireva||25||

saṃsarge cikitsāmāha- śakṛtetyādi| śakṛtā+a+ame pradhāne saṃsṛṣṭe, tathā vāyunā vā+a+ame saṃsṛṣṭe; tenetyāmenāpradhānena varcasi anile ‘anilena’ iti pā. ca pṛthak saṃsṛṣṭe, atra teneti pūrvavadvyākhyeyam| atra saṃsṛṣṭeṣu‘saṃsargeṣu’ iti pā. tṛtīyānirdiṣṭamalpamānatayā+apradhānaṃ, saptamīnirdiṣṭaṃ bahumānatvāt pradhānaṃ jñeyam| tayoriti pittāsṛjoḥ| saṃsṛṣṭayoriti ekamānena yuktayoḥ| kaphe vyoṣakaṣāyalavaṇairyutamityantaṃ yāvat ‘antarapānaṃ’ ityanuvartate| vātena viśītyādau madhurāmlakaṣāyo bastiriti madhurādidravyakvāthādikṛto bastirdeya ityarthaḥ| śakṛcchoṇitayorityādau anyonyasaṃsarge sati śakṛtā śoṇite śoṇitena vā śakṛti saṃsṛṣṭe; evaṃ pittaśakṛtoḥ raktapittayośca dvividhaḥ saṃsargo vyākhyeyaḥ| viṭpittaśoṇitairiti pratyekaṃ viḍādibhiḥ kaphe saṃsṛṣṭe| kaphavimūrcchite iti kaphenāpradhānena saṃsṛṣṭe ityarthaḥ||26-33||
div.quote: vātena viśi pitte vā viṭpittābhyāṃ‘viṭpittāsraiḥ’ iti pā. tathā+anile
kaphena viśi pitte vā kaphe viṭpittaśoṇitaiḥ
bastirvātena pitte‘rakte’ iti pā. tu kāryaḥ svādvamlatiktakaḥ

div.p: anuktasaṃsargacikitsāṃ sūtrayannāha- tricaturityādi| tricatuḥpañcasaṃsargāniti āmādīnāṃ trika-catuṣka-pañcakarūpān saṃsargān| evameva vikalpayediti pradhānādimelakena vikalpayet, tathā bheṣajamapi teṣāṃ yathoktabheṣajānusāreṇa kalpayedityarthaḥ| ete ca bhedā likhyamānā atibahuprabhedatayā granthagauravamāpādayanti, svayaṃ ca buddhimatā sukaravibhāgā eveti na likhyante| evamādisaṃsargakṛtaṃ rogabhedamanyatrāpi buddhyā kartavyatayā+atidiśannāha- sarvarogeṣvapi smṛteti| iyaṃ vyavasthā sarvarogeṣvevayathāsambhavamācāryānumatetyarthaḥ| tatra grahaṇīgade yatra tu ṣaḍapyāmādayaḥ sambhavanti, tatraivaṃ saṃsargāḥ prakalpyante; yatra ca trayodoṣāḥ sambhavanti, śoṇitena vā samaṃ catvāraḥ, tatra teṣāmeva parasparasaṃsargo bheṣajavibhāgārthaṃ‘bhiṣajā yogabhedārthaṃ’ iti pā. kalpanīyaḥ||34||

āmādiṣaṭkasamudayarūpasaṃsarge kāryamāha- yugapadityādi| yugapaditi ekadaiva militānāṃ ṣaṇṇāmiti yāvat| ṣaḍrasamiti militaṣaḍrasakṛtam| nirāmāṇāmiti āmavarjitānāṃ śakṛdādīnāṃ pañcānām| ṣāḍrasika iti ṣaḍrasamelakena kṛtaḥ||35||
div.quote: yugapat ṣaḍrasaṃ ṣaṇṇāṃ saṃsarge pācanaṃ bhavet ‘pibet’ iti pā.;
nirāmāṇāṃ tu pañcānāṃ bastiḥ ṣāḍrasiko mataḥ

div.p: sarvātīsārasādhāraṇaṃ bheṣajamāha- udumbaretyādi| ‘raktaśālibhiḥ’ ityatra ‘raktamūlibhiḥ’ iti pāṭhe ‘raktamūlī raktairaṇḍam’ ityapare| jale śṛtairiti ṣaḍaṅgavidhānena jale śṛtaiḥ| bālodumbaram udumbaraśalāṭu| bhavediti yavāgūrbhavet| ikṣvādīnāmiti tṛṇapañcamūlapaṭhitānāṃ śaravarjitānāmikṣukuśakāśaśālimūlānām| śālyāditaṇḍulairiti raktaśālikalamāditaṇḍulaiḥ| dadhyādibhiratra jalasthānīyairyavāgūḥ sādhanīyā||36-42||
div.quote: śaṅkhaṃ sarjarasaṃ lākṣāṃ kardamaṃ ca palāṃśikam
piṣṭvā taiḥ sarpiṣaḥ prasthaṃ kṣīradviguṇitaṃ pacet
kvātheṣu samasūrāṇāṃ yavāgvaḥ syuḥ pṛthak pṛthak

div.p: prapañcoktaṃ bheṣajaṃ saṅgraheṇābhidadhāti- bhavanti cātretyādi| pānamiti pācanapānam| bastiśceti snigdhāmlalavaṇamadhura eva bastiḥ| mārute iti mārutātisāre; evamanyatrāpi pitte ityādau pittādijātisāre iti jñeyam| saṅgrāhi vātanudityatra ‘bheṣajaṃ’ iti śeṣaḥ; tacca bheṣajaṃ yathoktabastyādirūpameva| pācanamāme pānamiti pācanaghanātiviṣādidravyakṛtaṃ pānamityarthaḥ| picchābastayo+asṛgbastayaśceti picchāsṛgbastayaḥ| uktamiti sākṣādatideśena ca trikādisaṃsarge proktam| miśramiti etadeva pratyekaṃ miśrīkṛtam| dvandvādiyogajeṣviti tricatuṣkādisaṃsargaje+atisāre| tatrodrekādiviśeṣāditi saṃsarga eva balābalaviśeṣādupakramasyāpi viśeṣo bhavati| etadeva balāpekṣaṃ bahudurbalā+apratyanīkaṃ bastyekabheṣajamiti śeṣaḥ(?)||43-45||
div.quote: bhavanti cātra ślokāḥ- snigdhāmlalavaṇamadhuraṃ pānaṃ bastiśca mārute koṣṇaḥ
śītaṃ tiktakaṣāyaṃ madhuraṃ pitte ca rakte ca
atisāraṃ pratyuktaṃ miśraṃ dvandvādiyogajeṣvapi ‘dvandvāmajeṣvapi ca’ iti pā. ca

div.p: prāsṛtikā ityādyadhyāyārthasaṅgrahaḥ| savyāpatkriyā iti vyāpadaśca mṛdubastikṛtajāḍyādikā uktāḥ, tathā kriyāśca tāsāmeva vyāpadāmuktāḥ| nirūhāścātisāracikitsite proktāḥ| rasakalpaścātīsāreṣu rasoddeśacikitsayā kṛtaḥ| ghṛtaṃ codumbaretyādinoktam||46||
iti śrīcakrapāṇidattapraṇītāyāmāyurvedadīpikāyāṃ carakatātparyaṭīkāyāṃ siddhisthāne prāsṛtayogīyasiddhirnāmāṣṭamo+adhyāyaḥ||8||
div.quote: ityagniveśakṛte tantre carakapratisaṃskṛte+aprāpte dṛḍhabalasampūrite siddhisthāne prāsṛtayogīyasiddhirnāmāṣṭamo+adhyāyaḥ ‘prāsṛtayogikī’ iti pā.

div.p: prāsṛtayogīyānantaraṃ trimarmīyā siddhirucyate, trimarmajarogāśrayivyāpadāṃ bastirūpacikitsopadarśanārthaṃ; vyāpatpratīkārānantaraṃ bastiprayogādhikāraśca pūrvādhyāyādanuvartate ‘pūrvādhyāye+apyanuvartate’ iti pā.; ; kiṃvā, bastivyāpaccikitsā pūrvādhyāyādikṛtā, bastivyāpādācca trimarmajā api rogā bhavanti, tena teṣāṃ jñānapūrvakacikitsopadarśanārthaṃ trimarmīyasiddhirucyate| etadadhyāyavaktavyāśca gadāstrimarmīyacikitsite+adhyāyavistarabhayānnoktāḥ, ta iha pratipādyante| atrāpi marmaśabdena marmagatā gadā ucyante, tānadhikṛtā ‘tānadhikṛtya kṛtā’ iti pā. siddhistrimarmīyasiddhiḥ||1-2||

saptottaraṃ marmaśatamiti śarīrasaṅkhyābhihitaṃ; tacca māṃsasirāsnāyvasthisandhiṣu niviṣṭam| skandhaśabdenānantarādhirucyate; śākhāśabdena ceha śākheva śākheti kṛtvā bāhudvayaṃ jaṅghādvayaṃ cocyate; neha śākhāśabdena raktādidhātūnāṃ grahaṇaṃ, raktādidhātūnāṃ skandhe+api, vidyamānatvāt| tatra śākhāśritāni catuścatvāriṃśanmarmāṇi, śeṣaṃ skandhāśritam| yaduktaṃ suśrute- “teṣāmekādaśaikasmin sakthi bhavanti, etenetarasakthi bāhū ca vyākhyātau; udarorasordvādaśa, caturdaśa pṛṣṭhe, grīvāṃ pratyūrdhvaṃ saptatriṃśat” (su.śā.a.6) iti; eteṣāṃ ca marmaṇāṃ pratyekaṃ vibhāga uktaḥ suśrute eva “talahṛdaya” (su.śā.a.6) ityādinā prapañcato+anusaraṇīyaḥ| saptottaraśatamarmaṇāmamarmaśarīradeśavilakṣaṇaṃ dharmamāha- teṣāmityādi| cetanānibandhavaiśeṣyāditi yasmānmarmasu cetanādhāturviśeṣeṇa nibaddha ityarthaḥ; cetanānibandhaśca marmasvadṛṣṭakṛta eva marmapīḍayā viśeṣapīḍādarśanādunnīyate| śākhānāṃ tadāśritatvāditi yasmācchākhā api skandhāśritāḥ, tena skandhāśritaśākhāśritebhyaḥ sākṣāt skandhāśritaṃ marma garīyo bhavatītyarthaḥ; skandhāśritatvaṃ ca śākhānāṃ skandhopaghātena tadupaghātāt, tathā skandhaniṣpannenaiva rasādinā tatpoṣaṇāt; kiñca skandhāśritānyeva marmāṇi sadyaḥprāṇaharāṇi, na śākhāśrayāṇi; tena ca skandhasya prādhānyam| yaduktaṃ suśrute- “śṛṅgāṭakānyadhipatiḥ śaṅkhau kaṇṭhaśirogudam| hṛdayaṃ bastinābhī ca ghnanti sadyo hatāni vai” (su.śā.a.6) iti| hṛdbastiśirāṃsi garīyāṃsīti sambandhaḥ| etadgarīyastve hetumāha- tanmūlatvāccharīrasyeti| tanmūlatvāditi tadāśritatvāt, tathā ca hṛdayāśritatvaṃ śarīrasya ‘tatra hṛdaye daśa dhamanyaḥ’ ityādinā ‘nābhyāmarā iva’ ityantena darśayiṣyati| yadyapi ca marmāntarāṇyapi viśeṣeṇa prāṇāśrayāṇyuktāni; yathā ‘daśaivāyatanānyāhuḥ prāṇā yeṣu pratiṣṭhitāḥ| śaṅkhau marmatrayaṃ kaṇṭho raktaṃ śukraujasī gudam’ (sū.a.29) ityanena, tathā+api śaṅkhādīni na śarīrāśrayabhūtāni yathā hṛdayādīni; tena prāṇāyatanatve samāne+apyuktaśarīrāśrayatvaviśeṣādiha hṛdayādīnāmeva prādhānyamucyate; kiñca, prāṇāśrayatvamapi yathā hṛdayādīnāṃ na tathā śaṅkhādīnām; uktaṃ hi “saptottaraṃ marmaśataṃ yaduktaṃ śarīrasaṅkhyāmadhikṛtya teṣu| marmāṇi bastiṃ hṛdayaṃ śiraśca pradhānabhūtānyṛṣayo vadanti|| prāṇāśrayān tānapi pīḍayanto vātādayo+asūnapi pīḍayanti” (su.śā.a.6) iti| anye tu śaṅkhādiprāṇāśrayāṇāṃ hṛdayādiṣveva sāmīpyādantarbhāvaṃ darśayanti, taccāmūlatvādupekṣitam||3||
div.quote: tatra śākhāśritebhyo marmabhyaḥ skandhāśritāni garīyāṃsi, śākhānāṃ tadāśritatvāt; skandhāśritebhyo+api hṛdvastiśirāṃsi, tanmūlatvāccharīrasya

div.p: daśa dhamanya iti ojovahā daśa dhamanyaḥ, “arthe daśa mahāmūlāḥ samāsaktāḥ” (sū.a.30) ityādinā arthedaśamahāmūlīye pratipāditāḥ| prāṇāpānāviti ucchvāsaniśvāsau, kecittu prāṇāpānau yathoktāveva vātau prāhuḥ; tatrāpāno yadyapi meḍhraśroṇyādyāśraya evetyāhuḥ, tathā+api hṛdayāvyatiriktānuvidhāyitvāddhṛdayāśrita ‘hṛdayārthasya vyatiriktānuvidhāyitvāt’ iti pā.; ityucyate| manaḥ antaḥkaraṇam| buddhiḥ mahacchabdābhilapyā| cetanā buddhivṛttibhedaḥ| mahābhūtānīti ātmasambaddhāni sūkṣmamahābhūtāni| etat sarvaṃ sāṅkhyadarśane vyavasthāpitaṃ śārīre ca vyutpāditamanusaraṇīyam| pradeśāntare coktaṃ- “ṣaḍaṅgamaṅgaṃ vijñānamindriyāṇyarthapañcakam| ātmā ca saguṇaścetaścintyaṃ ca hṛdi saṃsthitam” (sū.a.30) iti; te+arthā etacchlokoktāḥ, adhikārthānāṃ ca prokteṣvevāvarodho vyākhyeyaḥ; kiṃvā iha śāstroddhāreṇābhidhānam| yathā hṛdaye daśa dhamanyādīnyāśritāni, taddṛṣṭāntena darśayati- nābhyāmarā iva pratiṣṭhitānīti; nābhiḥ cakranābhiḥ, arāḥ cakranemimadhyasthakāṣṭhāni, yathā- cakranābhyāṃ sambaddhā, arāstadupaghātādupahanyante, tanmūlatvena‘mūle(na) vā’ iti pā. tatsambandhā bhavanti, evaṃ dhamanyādayo+apītyarthaḥ| ‘nābhyāmaparā’ iti vā pāṭhaḥ, tena garbhanābhyāmaparā ivetyarthaḥ (arāayaṃ pāṭho hastalikhitapustake na paṭhyate iva apareti vyākhyānayanti)| etena pradeśāntaravartināmapi dhamanyādīnāṃ hṛdayāśritatvaṃ siddhamiti bhāvaḥ| śirasa āśrayatvamāha- śirasītyādi| indriyaprāṇavahāni srotāṃsi yadyapi pradeśāntare+api bhavanti ‘bhramanti’ iti pā.; , tathā+api śirasi viśeṣeṇaivaitāni prabaddhānīti sūryamiva gabhastaya iti dṛṣṭāntena darśayati| śiraāśrayatvaṃ ca yathoktasrotasāṃ tadupaghātena viśiṣṭopaghātadarśanādunnīyate| basteḥ śarīrāśrayatvamāhu- bastistvityādi| sthūlagudādimadhyasthitatvapratipādanenāsya sthūlagudādīnāṃ bastyāśrayatvaṃ darśayati| ambuvahānāṃ srotasāṃ pratiṣṭheti sthānamityarthaḥ, udadhiryathā+a+apagānāṃ pūraṇīyasthānaṃ, tathā bastirapyambuvahasrotasāṃ viśrāmasthānam| tanmūlairiti tatsambaddhairmarmasañjñakaiḥ; nahi srotasāṃ marmatvamasti; kiṃvā srotomarmaśabdena sirāmarmaṇāṃ grahaṇaṃ; kiṃvā marmasambaddhāni marmapoṣakāṇi vā srotāṃsi marmasañjñakāni srotāṃsi| āśrayanāśādāśritasya nāśa iti āśrayanāśādāśritasya nāśo yasmādbhavati, tasmāddhṛdayādīnāmanyatamasya nāśāccharīranāśo bhavatīti yuktam| śarīrasya hṛdayāśritatvaṃ‘hṛdayādyāśritatvaṃ’ iti pā. śarīrārambhakapradhānadaśadhamanyādyāśrayatvenaiva jñeyam| upaghātāditi kiñcidvaikṛtāt||4-5||
div.quote: tatra hṛdaye‘hṛdi’ iti pā. daśa dhamanyaḥ prāṇāpānau ‘prāṇodānau’ iti pā. mano buddhiścetanā mahābhūtāni ca nābhyāmarā iva pratiṣṭhitāni, śirasi indriyāṇi indriyaprāṇavahāni ca srotāṃsi sūryamiva gabhastayaḥ saṃśritāni, bastistu sthūlagudamuṣkasevanīśukramūtravāhinīnāṃ ‘…mūtravahānāṃ’ iti pā.; nāḍī(lī)nāṃ madhye mūtradhāro+ambuvahānāṃ sarvasrotasāmudadhirivāpagānāṃ pratiṣṭhā‘pratiṣṭhitaḥ’ iti pā., bahubhiśca tanmūlairmarmasañjñakaiḥ srotobhirgaganamiva dinakarakarairvyāptamidaṃ śarīram

teṣāṃ trayāṇāmanyatamasyāpi bhedādāśveva śarīrabhedaḥ syāt, āśrayanāśādāśritasyāpi vināśaḥ; tadupaghātāttu‘tadupatāpāttu’ iti pā. ghorataravyādhiprādurbhāvaḥ; tasmādetāni viśeṣeṇa rakṣyāṇi bāhyābhighādvātādibhyaśca

div.p: hṛdayādyabhighātabhavān vyādhīn krameṇāha- tatretyādi| klomāpakarṣaṇaṃ klomāpakarṣaṇākārā vedanā| veṣṭanaṃ śirasi veṣṭanākārā vedanā| kuṇḍalaṃ bastau kuṇḍalarūpā vedanā| upastambhaḥ bastereva| cikitsite iti trimarmīyacikitsite| sakriyāvidhinīti sacikitsitavidhānāni||6||
div.quote: tatra hṛdyabhihate kāsaśvāsabalakṣayakaṇṭhaśoṣaklomākarṣaṇajihvānirgamamukhatāluśoṣāpasmāronmādapralāpacittanāśādayaḥ syuḥ; śirasyabhihate manyāstambhārditacakṣurvibhramamohodveṣṭanaceṣṭānāśakāsaśvāsahanugrahamūkagadgadatvākṣinimīlana- gaṇḍaspandanajṛmbhaṇalālāsrāvasvarahānivadanajihmatvādīni, bastau tu vātamūtravarconigrahavaṅkṣaṇamehanabastiśūlakuṇḍalodāvartagulmānilāṣṭhīlopastambhanābhikukṣigudaśroṇigrahādayaḥ ‘…gulmabradhnānila…’ iti pā.; vātādyupasṛṣṭānāṃ tveṣāṃ liṅgāni cikitsite sakriyāvidhīnyuktāni

div.p: marmaparipālane basteḥ prādhānyaṃ sopapattikamāha- kintvetānītyādi| yasmāt pittakaphayordvayorakriyayorīraṇe+anila eva hetuḥ, tena kaphapittaje+api vikāre vāyurnimittaṃ, vātajavikāre+api vāyuḥ svatantra eva kāraṇam, ataḥ sarvavikāreṣu marmāṇi rakṣayatā tatkāraṇādanilādeva marmāṇi rakṣaṇīyāni| tathā prāṇamūlaṃ ceti jīvitahetuścāvikṛto vāyuḥ, vikṛtaśca prāṇopaghātakaḥ; tena marmāṇyapi prāṇarakṣārthaṃ vātādrakṣyāṇi| bastisādhyatama iti itaracikitsāpekṣayā bastinā sādhyatamaḥ; uktaṃ hi- “bastirvātaharāṇām” (sū.a.25) iti| dvau cānuvāsanaskandhāviti rogabhiṣagjitīye “anuvāsanaṃ tu sneha eva, sa dvividhaḥ- sthāvaro jaṅgamaśca” (vi.a.8) ityanenoktau dvāvanuvāsanaskandhau jñeyau| iheti siddhisthāne| buddhyā vicāryeti doṣauṣadhādīni daśa buddhyā vicārya, vātavyādhicikitsāṃ ca buddhyā vicārya prayojayedityarthaḥ||7||
div.quote: kintvetāni viśeṣato+anilādrakṣyāṇi, anilo hi pittakaphasamudīraṇe hetuḥ prāṇamūlaṃ ca, sa bastikarmasādhyatamaḥ, tasmānna bastisamaṃ kiñcit karma marmaparipālanamasti
tatra ṣaḍāsthāpanaskandhān vimāne dvau cānuvāsanaskandhāviha ca vihitān bastīn buddhyā vicārya mahāmarmaparipālanārthaṃ prayojayedvātavyādhicikitsāṃ ca

div.p: viśeṣeṇa marmabhedacikitsitamāha ‘marmabhedādicikitsitamāha-’ iti pā.- bhūyaścetyādi| hṛdyupasṛṣṭe ‘vātena” iti śeṣaḥ| lavaṇānāmiti nirdhāraṇe ṣaṣṭhī| anya eva anyatamaḥ, yathā- śreṣṭhatama iti| hṛdyeneti mano+anukūlena; yad dveṣyarasasya hṛdahitatayā+ahṛdyatvaṃ, tanmano+ananukūlatvameva| hṛdrogavihitaṃ ca karmeti trimarmīyacikitsite| dhūmādīnīti ādiśabdena pariṣekopanāhādigrahaṇam| bastau tviti ‘praduṣṭe vātena’ iti prakaraṇājjñeyaṃ; pittakaphaduṣṭau ca vāyureva pradhānamiti prāgeva pratipāditaṃ; tena kaphapittaduṣṭirapi labhyate| vartaya iti phalavartayaḥ| śyāmādibhiriti “śyāmātrivṛccaturaṅgulatilvakamahāvṛkṣasaptalāśaṅkhinīdantīdravantīnām” (vi.a.8) ityādinā prāguktaḥ śyāmādiḥ| bilvādiriti bṛhatpañcamūlaṃ; kiṃvā “bilvamūlatrivṛddāruyavakolakulatthavān” (si.a.7) ityanenokto bilvādirjñeyaḥ| śarādimūlaśṛtakṣīrahapuṣādikalko+aparaḥ| kharāśvā ajamodā| pītadārusiddhatailena sādhitamanuvāsanaṃ yasminnirūhe sa tathā| kecittu saralasārākṛṣṭatailaṃ pītadārusiddhatailamāhuḥ| tailvakasarpiḥ tilvakakalpoktam| śatāvarītyādau dvisāriveti anantamūlaśyāme| śreyasī rāsnā| upakuñcikā kṛṣṇajīrakam| śitivārakaḥ śāliñcaḥ| aśmabhedakaḥ pāṣāṇabhedakaḥ| uttarabastiriti vakṣyamāṇottarabastividhānāddeya ‘…vidhānājjñeyaḥ’ iti pā. ityarthaḥ| nirūhaḥ nirūhasthāne deya ityarthaḥ||8||
div.quote: bhūyaśca ‘bhūyaśca hṛdyupasṛṣṭe vātena hiṅgucūrṇalavaṇānāmanyatamacūrṇasaṃyuktāṃ peyāṃ mātuluṅgarasenānyena vā+amlena hṛdyena vā pāyayet’ iti pā.; hṛdyupasṛṣṭe hiṅgucūrṇaṃ lavaṇānāmanyatamacūrṇasaṃyuktaṃ mātuluṅgasya ‘mātuluṅgarasenājyena vā bilvādisthirādipañcamūlarasasiddhā yavāgūḥ’ iti pā.; rasenānyena vā+amlena hṛdyena vā pāyayet, sthirādipañcamūlīrasaḥ saśarkaraḥ pānārthaṃ, bilvādipañcamūlarasasiddhā ca yavāgūḥ, hṛdrogavihitaṃ ca karma; mūrdhni tu vātopasṛṣṭe+abhyaṅgasvedanopanāhasnehapānanastaḥkarmāvapīḍanadhūmādīni; bastau tu kumbhīsvedaḥ, vartayaḥ, śyāmādibhirgomūtrasiddho nirūhaḥ, bilvādibhiśca surāsiddhaḥ, śarakāśekṣudarbhagokṣurakamūlaśṛtakṣīraiśca ‘…śṛtakṣīraṃ ca’ iti pā.; trapusairvārukharāśvābījayavarṣabhakavṛddhikalkito nirūhaḥ, pītadārusiddhatailenānuvāsanaṃ, tailvakaṃ ca sarpirvirekārthaṃ, śatāvarīgokṣurakabṛhatīkaṇṭakārikāguḍūcīpunarnavośīramadhukadvisārivālodhraśreyasīkuśakāśamūlakaṣāyakṣīracaturguṇaṃ balāvṛṣarṣabhakakharāśvopakuñcikāvatsakatrapusairvārubījaśitivārakamadhukavacāśatapuṣpāśmabhedakavarṣābhūmadanaphalakalkasiddhaṃ tailamuttarabastirnirūho vā śuddhasnigdhasvinnasya bastiśūlamūtravikārahara iti

div.p: gadyoktamarthaṃ ślokena darśayannadhikamapyāha- kiñcit hṛdaye ityādinā| ābādhavarjanamiti marmopaghātakahetuvarjanam| svasthavṛttānuvartanaṃ ca hṛdayādipoṣakatayaiva pālakaṃ bhavati| utpannārtivighāta iti utpannamarmarogapratīkāraḥ||9-10||
div.quote: bhavanti cātra ślokāḥ- hṛdaye mūrdhni bastau ca nṛṇāṃ prāṇāḥ pratiṣṭhitāḥ
tasmātteṣāṃ sadā yatnaṃ‘yatnāt kurvīta paripālanam;’ iti pā. kurvīta paripālane
ata urdhvaṃ vikārā ye trimarmīye cikitsite
div.p: marmaparipālakabastikathanaprasaṅgādanuktamarmagatarogān sacikitsitān darśayannāha- ata ūrdhvamityādi||11||

hṛdrogamapatantrakamāha- kruddha ityādi| sthānādūrdhvamiti vātasthānāpekṣayā yadūrdhvam| stabdhākṣo+atha nimīlana iti stabdhākṣo vā bhavati nimīlitākṣo vā bhavati| niḥsañjña iti vyādhivegakāle dṛṣṭiṃ saṃstabhya sañjñāṃ ca hatvā kaṇṭhena kūjati, niḥsañjñaśca bhavati| mohaṃ vṛte punariti hṛdaye vṛte punarvāyunā mohaṃ yāti; vāyuneti kaphayuktena; eke tamapatānakamevāpatantrakamāhuḥ| atra jatūkarṇaḥ- “vātakaphābhyāṃ hṛcchiraḥśaṅkhapīḍanānamanāṅgākṣepapramohākṣistambhānimīlanakṛcchrocchvāsakūjanānyapatantrake”iti| kiṃvā apatantrakaṃ dvividhaṃ varṇayanti- vātāt, kaphācca‘vātakaphācca’ iti pā.; tatra ‘niḥsañjñaḥ so+apatantrakaḥ’ ityanena kaphaja‘vātikaḥ’ iti pā. ucyate; ‘vāyunā dāruṇaṃ prāhuḥ’ ityanena vāyunā janitamapatantrakamevāpatānakamāhuḥ| tasya dāruṇatvaṃ dāruṇavātārabdhatvāditi vyākhyeyam| tathaiva suśrute vātavyādhāvatantrakaḥ paṭhitaḥ||12-15||
div.quote: pīḍayan hṛdayaṃ gatvā śiraḥ śaṅkhau ca pīḍayan
(namayeccākṣipeccāṅgānyucchvāsaṃ ayamardhaśloko hastalikhitapustake na paṭhyate; niruṇaddhi ca)
kṛcchreṇa cāpyucchvasiti stabdhākṣo+atha nimīlakaḥ ‘ucchvasiti ca kṛcchreṇa stabdhākṣo+athānimīlanaḥ’ iti pā.;
dṛṣṭiṃ saṃstambhya sañjñāṃ ca hatvā kaṇṭhena kūjati
hṛdi mukte naraḥ svāsthyaṃ yāti mohaṃ vṛte punaḥ

div.p: tāsviti cetanāvahāsu dhamanīṣu| yavakvāthāmbuneti yavaiḥ ṣaḍaṅgavidhinā śṛtapānīyena| hṛdroganud vātakaphaghnaṃ yat karma taddhitamapatantrake| śodhanā ityādau “kṛtsnaśaḥ śodhanā na hitāḥ’ iti vacanena śodhanārthastokanirūhadānaṃ, bhūriśodhananirūhadāne tu vātakṣobhaḥ syāditi bhāvaḥ||16-20||
div.quote: tīkṣṇaiḥ pradhamanaiḥ sañjñāṃ tāsu muktāsu vindati
tumburūṇyabhayā‘hiṅgu tumburu pathyā ca’ iti pā. hiṅgu pauṣkaraṃ lavaṇatrayam
yavakvāthāmbunā peyaṃ hṛdgrahe cāpatantrake ‘hṛtpārśvārtyapatantrake’ iti pā.
śodhanā‘śodhane’ iti pā. bastayastīkṣṇā na hitāstasya kṛtsnaśaḥ

div.p: madhurasnigdhetyādinā tandrālakṣaṇaṃ cikitsitaṃ ca kecit paṭhanti||21-24||
div.quote: kaphaghnaṃ tatra kartavyaṃ śodhanaṃ śamanāni ca

div.p: hṛdrogamabhidhāya bastirogānāha- mūtraukasāda ityādi| ete ca mūtradoṣā mūtrakṛcchrādbhinnā eveti trimarmīya eva pratipāditam||25-26||

pittaṃ kapha ityādinā mūtraukasādamāha| ayaṃ ca vātakapha-pittavāta-tridoṣairjanyata ityuktaṃ bhavati| saṃhanyate iti saṃhate raktapītavarṇatā pittena, śvetavarṇatā kaphena, kaphapittalakṣaṇatā kaphapittābhyāṃ, vāyustu sarvānugata eva| atra vāyorāvaraṇakṛta eva kopaḥ; tena pittakaphayoreva cikitsoktā ‘pittaśleṣmaharairjayet’ ityanena, vāyostvāvaraṇajayādeva jayo bhavatīti bhāvaḥ||27-28||
div.quote: pittaṃ kapho dvāvapi‘dvayaṃ vā+api’ iti pā. vā bastau saṃhanyate yadā
mārutena tadā mūtraṃ raktaṃ pītaṃ ghanaṃ sṛjet
mūtraukasādaṃ‘mūtraikasādaṃ’ iti pā. taṃ vidyāt pittaśleṣmaharairjayet

div.p: animittarugiti alakṣyamāṇanimittaruk| mūtravairecanīmiti mūtravirecanīyadaśakaprayogarūpām| hiṅgudviruttaraṃ tu ‘dviruttaraṃ hiṅguvacā’ (ci.a.26) ityādinoktaṃ, hiṅgu dviruttaraṃ yasmin taddhiṅgudviruttaram||29-31||
div.quote: hanyānmūtrodarānāhamādhmānaṃ ‘hanyānmūtrādisaṅghātaṃ vyādhiṃ ca gudameḍhrayoḥ’ iti pā.; gudameḍhrayoḥ

div.p: mūtritasyeti mūtravegagatasya, mūtravegayuktasyeti yāvat| cyutamiti svasthānāccyutam| vātoddhatamiti vātavikṣiptam| etallakṣaṇāntarayuktameva kṛcchraṃ; mūtrakṛcchramito+anyadeva, bhinnakṣaṇatvāt| kiñciditi stokam| uccheṣaguruśephasa iti pravṛddhamūtrāvaśeṣeṇa sthitena guruśephasa iti| vātākṛtirityādi saṅkṣayalakṣaṇam‘saṅkṣepalakṣaṇam’ iti pā.| vātākṛtiriti vātalakṣaṇayuktaḥ| vidhāraṇāditi mūtravegarodhāt| ūṣmaṇeti pittoṣmaṇā| śoṣayanniti ūṣmaṇā sahito vāta eva mūtraṃ śoṣayan| gatisaṅgādityādinā vātakuṇḍalikāmāha| mūtrasya gatisaṅgādudāvṛtto vāyurmūtrasthānamārgayorbhagnavyāviddhakuṇḍalī mūtrayati; bhagnaḥ pratihataḥ, vyāviddhaḥ vakrī, kuṇḍalīti āvartamānatayā sthitaḥ; īdṛśaṃ vāyorupasthānaṃ mūtramārga eva bhavati| vātakuṇḍalikālakṣaṇamāha- saṃstambhetyādi| bhaṅgaḥ bhaṅgākāravedanā| raktaṃ granthiṃ kuryāt vātakaphābhyāṃ duṣṭamiti yojyam| viḍyukto vighāto viḍvighātaḥ| drutādhvetyādinā bastikuṇḍalamāha| udvṛtta iti parāvṛttamukhaḥ| pīḍita iti hastādibhiḥ| śleṣmaruddhabilo bastirna sidhyati, tathā pittodīrṇaśca na sidhyati| avibhrāntabila iti aruddhadvāraḥ| kuṇḍalīkṛta iti vartulīkṛtaḥ| vartulīkṛtasyaiva lakṣaṇānyāha- syādbastāvityādi||32-48||-
div.quote: pūrvaṃ mūtrasya paścādvā sravet kṛcchraṃ taducyate
ciraṃ dhārayato mūtraṃ tvarayā na pravartate
mehamānasya mandaṃ vā mūtrātītaḥ sa ucyate
mūtraṃ‘mūtramādhārayedvastau’ iti pā. dhārayato bastau vāyuḥ kruddho vidhāraṇāt
granthiṃ kuryāt sa kṛcchreṇa sṛjenmūtraṃ tadāvṛtam
śleṣmaṇā gauravaṃ‘cāvṛte’ iti pā. śophaḥ snigdhaṃ mūtraṃ ghanaṃ sitam
avibhrāntabilaḥ sādhyo na tu yaḥ kuṇḍalīkṛtaḥ
syādvastau kuṇḍalībhūte hṛnmohaḥ‘tṛṇmohaḥ’ iti pā. śvāsa eva ca

div.p: cikitsāmāha- doṣādhikyamityādi| mūtrakṛcchraharaiḥ prayogairdoṣādhikyamavekṣya prayuktairjayedityarthaḥ||49||-

uttarabastiṃ dāpayedityuktaṃ, tata uttarabastividhimāha- puṣpanetramityādi| puṣpanetramityuttarabastinetrasya sañjñā; uttarabastisañjñā uttaramārgadīyamānatayā, kiṃvā śreṣṭhaguṇatayā uttarabastiḥ| jātyaśvahanavṛntena samamiti jāteraśvahanasya ca puṣpayorvṛntenāgrasamam; uktaṃ hi hārīte “kundasya vṛntapratimaṃ tathā+agre” iti; aśvahanaḥ karavīraḥ| sarṣapacchidramiti sarṣapavāhicchidram| dvikarṇikamiti netre‘pūrṇe(rve)’ iti pā. bastibandhanārthamekataḥ karṇikā, aparā+agre śephaḥpramāṇaṣaḍaṅgulādau karṇikā kartavyā| trikarṇikam’ iti vā pāṭhaḥ| yathāvayoviśeṣeṇa snehamātrāṃ vikalpya ceti yathoktasnehaḥ pañcaviṃśativarṣasya, tatastvarvāgvayobhedavikalpenāpakarṣaḥ kartavyaḥ; uktaṃ hi suśrute “snehapramāṇaṃ paramaṃ prakuñcaścātra kīrtitaḥ| pañcaviṃśativarṣāṇāmarvāgbuddhivikalpitam” (su.ci.a.37) iti| hṛṣṭe iti stabdhe, yadyapratihatā vrajecchalākā, tatra puṣpanetraṃ śephaḥpramāṇasamaṃ praveśanīyam| śalākayā prathamamanveṣaṇaṃ mārgavijñānārtham| gudavaditi gude yathā netrākampanādiguṇayuktaṃ praveśyate tathā meḍhre+api| atigataṃ liṅgapramāṇātirekapraviṣṭaṃ netraṃ bastiṃ hiṃsyāt| ūne iti liṅgamānastokapraviṣṭe||50-57||
div.quote: jātyaśvahanavṛntena‘jātīpuṣpasya vṛntena’ iti pā. samaṃ gopucchasaṃsthitam
hiṃsyādatigataṃ‘hiṃsyādbastigataṃ’ iti pā. bastimūne sneho na gacchati
pratyāgate dvitīyaṃ ca tṛtīyaṃ ca pradāpayet

div.p: pippalītyādinā vyuṣite+apyanāgacchataḥ snehasya pravartikāṃ vartimāha| iyaṃ ca vartirguḍapākena kaṭhinā kartavyā yathā ślakṣṇā bhavati| paścārdhe iti mūle; aṅguṣṭhasannibhāmiti pāyau snehapravṛttyarthaṃ dīyamānā+aṅguṣṭhasamānā kartavyā| tābhyāmiti meḍhragudābhyāṃ dattavartibhyām| uttarabasteranuvāsanavat sevyaparihāravyāpatsamyagdattalakṣaṇānyatidiśannāha- ānuvāsaniko vidhirityādi||58-61||

ārtavakāle tvautsargikatayoktaṃ ‘tvautsargikakāloktaṃ’ iti, ‘tvautsargikaṃ noktaṃ’ iti ca pā.; strīṇāmuttarabastidānamārtavakāle vidhatte| ārtavakāladāne hetumāha- garbhāsanetyādi| garbhāsanā garbhaśayyā, garbhāśaya ityarthaḥ; anye tu yonimāhuḥ| ādatta iti samyag gṛhṇāti| apāvṛteti apagatasañcitarajorūpāvaraṇā||62-64||-
div.quote: garbhaṃayamardhaśloko hastalikhitapustake na paṭhyate yonistadā śīghraṃ jite gṛhṇāti mārute
aprasravati mūtre ca binduṃ binduṃ sravatyapi

div.p: puṣpanetrapramāṇaṃ tvityādi| mudgasroto+anuvāhīti mūdgavāhicchidram| apatyamārge vidheyaṃ caturaṅgulamiti apatyamārge snehayitavye caturaṅgulapraveśanaṃ‘caturaṅgulapraveśanamantaḥ kartavyam’ iti pā. prāptayauvanānāmeva nārīṇāṃ kartavyaṃ, mūtramārge tu snehayitavye dvyaṅgulapraveśanaṃ prāptayauvanānāmeva nārīṇāṃ kartavyam| bālāyāḥ svalpapramāṇatayā ekāṅgulapraveśanameva mūtramārgaprayogārthaṃ kartavyaṃ; bālānāṃ tvapatyamārge na dīyata eva, tāsāmapatyamārgasyāvṛtatvāt| vartiḥ pīnatarā bhavediti snehapratyāgamanārthā vartiḥ pīnatarā kartavyā| snehamātrā cātra “snehasya prasṛtaṃ cātra svāṅgulīmūlasammitam” (su.ci.a.37) ityanena suśrutoktā jñeyā||65-69||-
div.quote: mūtrasrotaḥparīṇāhaṃ mudgasroto+anuvāhi ‘mudgasrotonupāti ca’ iti pā.; ca
bastau ‘bastiṃ bastau praṇīte ca vartiścānantarā bhavet’ iti pā.; , bastau praṇīte ca vartiḥ pīnatarā bhavet

div.p: kramāgataśirovikārajñānārthaṃ trimarmīyāvistṛtān vaktumāha- ata ityādi| dāruṇa iti āśukārī| paraṃ tryahājjīvatītyādikaḥ prabhāvo+ayaṃ śaṅkhakasya| pratyākhyāyācaret kriyāmityanena utpannamātra eva pratyākhyānapūrvikā cikitsā kartavyā+asya||70-73||
div.quote: sa śiro viṣavadvegī nirudhyāśu galaṃ tathā
